rules.fencingCost: You can build any number of fences, paying 1 wood for each new fence you build.
rules.fencingPastures: You may fence a stable, or divide an existing pasture into several smaller ones by building fences on the fence spaces inside the pasture.
rules.sow: Sow: place 1 grain or vegetable from your supply onto an empty field, then add more from the supply (grain fields hold 3, vegetable fields hold 2).
rules.bakeBread: Bake bread: turn grain from your supply (not from your fields) into food using a Fireplace, Cooking Hearth or other baking improvement.
rules.improvement: You can either build 1 major improvement or play 1 minor improvement.
rules.growthWithRoom: You can only grow your family here if you currently have more rooms than people, regardless of whether those people are still at home or on action spaces.
rules.growthRequired: You may not skip the family growth only to play a minor improvement.
rules.growthWithoutRoom: The number of rooms in your house does not matter for this effect.
rules.growthLaterRoom: Note: if you grow your family here and build a single room later, you will not be able to use "Wish for Children".
rules.growthOccupancy: The new room is immediately occupied by the person who did not have a room of their own yet.
rules.cultivation: You can plow one field and then immediately sow grain or vegetables in all of your empty fields, including the one you just plowed.
rules.houseRenovateFirst: You may only build a major improvement or play a minor improvement if you renovate first.
rules.houseRenovationOnce: You are not allowed to renovate your house twice in a single action.
rules.farmRenovateFirst: You can only build fences if you renovate first.
rules.farmRenovationOnce: You are not allowed to renovate twice in a single action.

future-meeples.name: Future Resources
future-meeples.description: Place future resources on upcoming rounds

pass-minor-card-to-left.name: Pass minor improvement
pass-minor-card-to-left.description: Pass a minor improvement to the player on the left

season-summer-farmers-market.name: Farmer's Market
season-summer-farmers-market.description: Plow and/or bake bread or sell grain

season-autumn-thanksgiving.name: Thanksgiving
season-autumn-thanksgiving.description: Private field phase and/or gain 1 vegetable

moor-infirmary.name: Infirmary
moor-infirmary.description: Gain 1 food. Sick workers may only use this space.

moor-special-action-apply.name: Moor special action
moor-special-action-apply.description: Resolve a Farmers of the Moor special action

meeting-place.name: Meeting Place
meeting-place.description: Become start player and optionally play 1 improvement
meeting-place.rules: Taking this space moves the Start Player Marker immediately, but the current round work order remains unchanged; the new start player acts first from the next round.

farm-expansion.name: Farm Expansion
farm-expansion.description: Build any number of rooms and/or stables. New rooms must be adjacent to existing rooms. Stables can be built anywhere with at most one per farm space.

resource-market.name: Resource Market
resource-market.description: Take 1 reed or 1 stone, plus 1 food

lessons-56-variable.name: Lessons
lessons-56-variable.description: Play 1 occupation; first two cost 1 food, later ones cost 2 food

modest-wish-children-56.name: Wish for Children
modest-wish-children-56.description: From round 5, grow family only if you have room

riverbank-forest-56.name: Riverbank Forest
riverbank-forest-56.description: Accumulate 1 wood each round and gain 1 reed

animal-market-56.name: Animal Market
animal-market-56.description: Choose sheep plus food, boar, or pay 1 food for cattle

farm-supplies-6.name: Farm Supplies
farm-supplies-6.description: Pay 1 food to plow and/or pay 1 food for grain

resource-trade-6.name: Resource Trade
resource-trade-6.description: Gain 1 food, then choose reed or stone and wood or clay

corral-6.name: Corral
corral-6.description: Gain the first animal type you do not have: sheep, boar, then cattle

side-job-6.name: Side Job
side-job-6.description: Build exactly 1 stable and/or bake bread

improvement-6.name: Improvement
improvement-6.description: Rounds 1-4: minor only. Round 5 onward: major or minor

wish-children.name: Wish for Children
wish-children.description: Grow family only if you have more rooms than people (even if they are on action spaces). You may not skip growth just to play a minor improvement.

improvement.name: Improvement
improvement.description: Build a major improvement or play a minor improvement

draw-ordinary-cards.name: Draw Cards
draw-ordinary-cards.description: Draw ordinary cards directly into your hand

fencing.name: Fencing
fencing.description: Build fences to form a pasture

complete-parent-father.name: Complete Father
complete-parent-father.description: Complete a satisfied father side quest

reorganize.name: Reorganize Animals
reorganize.description: Reassign animals among pastures, house, and stables.

salter-pick.name: Salt animals
salter-pick.description: Convert board animals (sheep/boar/cattle) into future round food

return-to-space.name: Return Resource
return-to-space.description: Return resources from your supply to the current action space

bonus-vp.name: Gain Bonus VP
bonus-vp.description: Gain 1 bonus victory point for the source card

breed.name: Breed
breed.description: Breed animals (internal action used by harvest and breed-shaped cards)

take-from-card.name: Take From Card
take-from-card.description: Move stored resources from the source card to your supply

claim-farmyard-goods-tokens.name: Claim Farmyard Goods
claim-farmyard-goods-tokens.description: Move the goods on your newly used farmyard spaces to your supply

claim-field-goods-tokens.name: Claim Field Goods
claim-field-goods-tokens.description: Move the goods on your sown fields to your supply

grain-thief-protect.name: Protect Grain
grain-thief-protect.description: Skip reaping the grain field and gain 1 grain instead

scythe-harvest-field.name: Scythe Harvest
scythe-harvest-field.description: Harvest the entire top stack of one field at once

swap-field-grain-to-veg.name: Swap Field Crop
swap-field-grain-to-veg.description: Trade a fully sown grain field for 1 vegetable

activate-card-effect.name: Activate Card Effect
activate-card-effect.description: Run an internal card effect hook

activate-extra-turn.name: Activate Extra Turn
activate-extra-turn.description: Run an internal extra-turn provider hook

recall-placed-worker.name: Recall Placed Worker
recall-placed-worker.description: Return one of your placed workers back home

reserve-fence-supply.name: Select Card Fences
reserve-fence-supply.description: Select card-held ordinary fence pieces for this fence action

store-on-card.name: Store On Card
store-on-card.description: Place resources on the source card

renovate-house.name: Renovate House
renovate-house.description: Upgrade your house to the next material tier

card-choice.name: Card Choice
card-choice.description: Make a choice from card options

selection.name: Selection
selection.description: Select positions or cards from hand

set-first-player.name: Set First Player
set-first-player.description: Mark this player as the new starting player

moor-special-action-choice.name: Moor Special Action Choice
moor-special-action-choice.description: Choose and resolve a Moor special action follow-up

discard-goods.description: Return goods from your supply to the general supply
discard-goods.name: Discard goods

marketplace.name: Marketplace
marketplace.description: Transfer goods to or from teammates. For each kind of goods, the giver pays 1 extra of the same kind.

Major_ClayOven.name: Clay Oven
Major_ClayOven.description:
[__Bake Bread__ action:]
<GRAIN> <ARROW-1X> 5<FOOD>
[When you build it, you can Bake immediately]

Major_StoneOven.name: Stone Oven
Major_StoneOven.description:
[__Bake Bread__ action:]
<GRAIN> <ARROW-2X> 4<FOOD>
[When you build it, you can Bake immediately]

Major_Well.name: Well
Major_Well.description: [Put 1 <FOOD> on the 5 next turns. At the start of each turn, collect the <FOOD>]

Major_Moor_PeatCharcoalKiln.name: Peat-charcoal Kiln
Major_Moor_PeatCharcoalKiln.description:
[Special action: __moor:cut-peat|Cut Peat__]
+1<FUEL> if you have 0<HORSE>; +2<FUEL> if you have at least 1<HORSE>.
[Scoring]
3/5<FUEL> <ARROW-1X> 1/2<SCORE>

Major_Moor_ForestersLodge.name: Forester's Lodge
Major_Moor_ForestersLodge.description:
[Special action: __moor:fell-trees|Fell Trees__]
Gain 1 extra <WOOD>, or 2 extra <WOOD> if you have at least 1<HORSE>.
[Scoring]
Gain 1 <SCORE> for each <FOREST> in your farmyard.

Major_Moor_RidingStables.name: Riding Stables
Major_Moor_RidingStables.description:
Place 1 <FOOD> on each remaining round space.
At the start of each round, gain that <FOOD> if you have at least 2<HORSE>.

Major_Moor_MuseumOfTheMoors.name: Museum of the Moors
Major_Moor_MuseumOfTheMoors.description:
These major improvements cost you 1 building resource less:
Well 1 <STONE>      Clay Oven 1 <CLAY>
Joinery 1 <WOOD>      Stone Oven 1 <STONE>
Pottery 1 <CLAY>      Forester's Lodge 1 <CLAY>
Basketmaker's Workshop 1 <REED>

Major_Moor_HeatingOven.name: Heating Oven
Major_Moor_HeatingOven.description:
Immediately gain 2<FUEL>.
When heating, heat 1 fewer room than you have.

Major_Moor_TiledOven.name: Tiled Oven
Major_Moor_TiledOven.description: Regardless of house size, you need at most 1<FUEL> to heat your entire home.

Major_ClayOven2.name: Clay Oven
Major_ClayOven2.description:
[__Bake Bread__ action:]
<GRAIN> <ARROW-1X> 5<FOOD>
[When you build it, you can Bake immediately]

Major_StoneOven2.name: Stone Oven
Major_StoneOven2.description:
[__Bake Bread__ action:]
<GRAIN> <ARROW-2X> 4<FOOD>
[When you build it, you can Bake immediately]

Major_Well2.name: Well
Major_Well2.description: [Put 1 <FOOD> on the 5 next turns. At the start of each turn, collect the <FOOD>]

A010_WoodenShed.name: Wooden Shed
A010_WoodenShed.description: This card can only be played via a __Major Improvement__ action. It provides room for one person. You may no longer renovate.

A106_SlurrySpreader.name: Slurry Spreader
A106_SlurrySpreader.description: In the field phase of each harvest, each time you take the last <GRAIN>/<VEGETABLE> from a field, you also get 2 <FOOD>/1 <FOOD>.

A128_RiparianBuilder.name: Riparian Builder
A128_RiparianBuilder.description: Each time another player uses the __Reed Bank__ accumulation space, you can build a room: if you build a clay/stone room, you get a discount of 1 <CLAY>/2 <STONE>.

A136_DrudgeryReeve.name: Drudgery Reeve
A136_DrudgeryReeve.description: If there are still 1/3/6/9 complete rounds left to play, you immediately get 1/2/3/4 <WOOD>. During scoring, each player with 1+/2+/3+ building resources of each type gets 1/3/5 bonus <SCORE>.

A014_CarpentersHammer.name: Carpenter's Hammer
A014_CarpentersHammer.description: Each time you build at least 2 wood/clay/stone rooms at once, you get a total discount of 2 <REED> as well as 2 <WOOD>/3 <CLAY>/4 <STONE>.

A017_ReclamationPlow.name: Reclamation Plow
A017_ReclamationPlow.description: After the next time you take animals from an accumulation space and accommodate all of them on your farm, you can plow 1 field.

A022_Telegram.name: Telegram
A022_Telegram.description: Add 1 to the current round for each fence in your supply and mark the corresponding round space. In that round only, you can place a person from your supply.

A023_StoneCompany.name: Stone Company
A023_StoneCompany.description: Immediately after each time you use a __space:western-quarry,eastern-quarry|Quarry__ accumulation space, you get a __Major or Minor Improvement__ action during which you must spend at least 1 <STONE>.

A028_ForestSchool.name: Forest School
A028_ForestSchool.description: You can consider the __space:lessons,lessons-3,lessons-4,lessons-56-2f,lessons-56-variable|Lessons__ action spaces not occupied. You can replace each <FOOD> that an occupation costs with <WOOD>.

A029_AleBenches.name: Ale-Benches
A029_AleBenches.description: In the returning home phase of each round, you can pay exactly 1 <GRAIN> from your supply to get 1 bonus <SCORE>. If you do, each other player gets 1 <FOOD>.

A003_PaperKnife.name: Paper Knife
A003_PaperKnife.description: Select 3 occupations in your hand. Select one of them randomly, which you can play immediately without paying an occupation cost.

A037_Bucksaw.name: Bucksaw
A037_Bucksaw.description: Each time you renovate, you can also pay 1 <WOOD> to get 1 bonus <SCORE> and 1 <GRAIN>.

A039_Chapel.name: Chapel
A039_Chapel.description: This is an action space for all. A player who uses it gets 3 bonus <SCORE>. If another player uses it, they must first pay you 1 <GRAIN>.

A040_PottersYard.name: Potter's Yard
A040_PottersYard.description: Immediately place 1 <CLAY> on each unused space in your farmyard. Each time you turn a space into a used space, you get the clay and you can immediately exchange it for 2 <FOOD>.

A041_VegetableSlicer.name: Vegetable Slicer
A041_VegetableSlicer.description: Each time you upgrade a Fireplace to a Cooking Hearth, you immediately get 2 <WOOD> and 1 <VEGETABLE> (not retroactively).

A053_Claypipe.name: Claypipe
A053_Claypipe.description: In the returning home phase of each round, if you gained at least 7 building resources in the preceding work phase, you get 2 <FOOD>.

A055_JunkRoom.name: Junk Room
A055_JunkRoom.description: Each time after you build an improvement, including this one, you get 1 <FOOD>.

A058_AsparagusKnife.name: Asparagus Knife
A058_AsparagusKnife.description: In the returning home phase of rounds 8, 10, and 12, you can take 1 <VEGETABLE> from exactly 1 vegetable field. You can immediately exchange it for 3 <FOOD> and 1 bonus <SCORE>.

A064_BarleyMill.name: Barley Mill
A064_BarleyMill.description: In the field phase of each harvest, you get 1 <FOOD> for each grain field that you harvest.

A065_SeedPellets.name: Seed Pellets
A065_SeedPellets.description: Each time before you take an unconditional __Sow__ action, you get 1 <GRAIN>.

A070_LiftingMachine.name: Lifting Machine
A070_LiftingMachine.description: At the end of each round that does not end with a harvest, you can move 1 <VEGETABLE> from one of your fields to your supply. (This is not considered a field phase.)

A071_ClearingSpade.name: Clearing Spade
A071_ClearingSpade.description: At any time, you can move 1 crop from a planted field containing at least 2 crops to an empty field.

A072_CalciumFertilizers.name: Calcium Fertilizers
A072_CalciumFertilizers.description: Each time you use a __space:western-quarry,eastern-quarry|Quarry__ accumulation space, add 1 additional good of the respective type to each of your planted fields growing a single type of crop.

A074_StableTree.name: Stable Tree
A074_StableTree.description: Each time you build 1 or more stables on your turn, place 1 <WOOD> on each of the next 3 round spaces. At the start of these rounds, you get the <WOOD>.

A079_GardenHoe.name: Garden Hoe
A079_GardenHoe.description: Each time you take an unconditional __Sow__ action planting <VEGETABLE> in at least 1 field, you get 1 <CLAY> and 1 <STONE>.

A081_InterimStorage.name: Interim Storage
A081_InterimStorage.description: Each time you use a clay/reed/stone accumulation space, place 1 <WOOD>/<CLAY>/<REED> on this card. At the start of rounds 7, 11, and 14, move all the goods on this card to your supply.

A082_WorkCertificate.name: Work Certificate
A082_WorkCertificate.description: Each time after you use an action space, you can take 1 building resource from a building resource accumulation space with at least 4 building resources on it.

A083_ShepherdsCrook.name: Shepherd's Crook
A083_ShepherdsCrook.description: Each time you fence a new pasture covering at least 4 farmyard spaces, you immediately get 2 sheep on this pasture.

A084_Silage.name: Silage
A084_Silage.description: In each returning home phase after which there is no harvest, you can pay exactly 1 <GRAIN> - even from a field - to breed exactly one type of animal.

A092_AdoptiveParents.name: Adoptive Parents
A092_AdoptiveParents.description: For 1 <FOOD>, you can take an action with offspring in the same round you get it. If you do, the offspring does not count as \ .

B010_Caravan.name: Caravan
B010_Caravan.description: This card provides room for 1 person.

B015_CarpentersBench.name: Carpenter's Bench
B015_CarpentersBench.description: Immediately after each time you use a wood accumulation space, you can use the taken wood (and only that) to build exactly 1 pasture. If you do, one of the fences is free.

B019_MoldboardPlow.name: Moldboard Plow
B019_MoldboardPlow.description: Place 2 field tiles on this card. Twice this game, when you use the __space:farmland|Farmland__ action space, you can also plow 1 field from this card.

B002_MiniPasture.name: Mini Pasture
B002_MiniPasture.description: Immediately fence a farmyard space, without paying <WOOD> for the fences. (If you already have pastures, the new one must be adjacent to an existing one.)

B021_HayloftBarn.name: Hayloft Barn
B021_HayloftBarn.description: Place 4 <FOOD> on this card. Each time you obtain at least 1 <GRAIN>, you also get 1 <FOOD> from this card. Once it is empty, you get a __Family Growth Even without Room__ action.

B023_FinalScenario.name: Final Scenario
B023_FinalScenario.description: Reveal the action space card for round 14. Only you can use it until round 14 starts.

B003_Moonshine.name: Moonshine
B003_Moonshine.description: Randomly select an occupation in your hand. Either play it for an occupation cost of 2 <FOOD>, or give it to the next player.

B034_SpecialFood.name: Special Food
B034_SpecialFood.description: The next time you take animals from an accumulation space and accommodate all of them on your farm, you get 1 bonus <SCORE> for each of these animals.

B038_FutureBuildingSite.name: Future Building Site
B038_FutureBuildingSite.description: Up until all other farmyard spaces are used, you cannot use the unused spaces that are orthogonally adjacent to your house (not even to build rooms).

B042_ForestInn.name: Forest Inn
B042_ForestInn.description: This is an action space for all. A player who uses it can exchange 5/7/9 <WOOD> for 8 <WOOD> and 2/4/7 <FOOD>. When another player uses it, they must first pay you 1 <FOOD>.

B048_ForestStone.name: Forest Stone
B048_ForestStone.description: Place 2 <FOOD> on this card. Each time you use a wood accumulation space, move 1 of these <FOOD> to your supply. Each time you use a stone accumulation space, add 2 <FOOD> to this card.

B055_MaintenancePremium.name: Maintenance Premium
B055_MaintenancePremium.description: Place 3 <FOOD> on this card. Each time you use a wood accumulation space, you get 1 <FOOD> from this card. Each time you renovate restock this card to 3 <FOOD>.

B065_GrainDepot.name: Grain Depot
B065_GrainDepot.description: If you paid <WOOD>/<CLAY>/<STONE> for this card, place 1 <GRAIN> on each of the next 2/3/4 round spaces. At the start of these rounds, you get the <GRAIN>.

B067_HandTruck.name: Hand Truck
B067_HandTruck.description: Each time before you take a __Bake Bread__ action, you also get 1 <GRAIN> for each of your people occupying an accumulation space.

B075_WoodWorkshop.name: Wood Workshop
B075_WoodWorkshop.description: Each time before you play or build an improvement, you get 1 <WOOD>.

B076_Ceilings.name: Ceilings
B076_Ceilings.description: Place 1 <WOOD> on the next 5 round spaces. At the start of these rounds, you get the <WOOD>. Remove the <WOOD> promised by this card from future round spaces the next time you renovate.

B081_Handcart.name: Handcart
B081_Handcart.description: Before each work phase, you can take 1 building resource from at most one <WOOD>/<CLAY>/<REED>/<STONE> accumulation space containing at least 6/5/4/4 building resources of the same type.

B094_StockProtector.name: Stock Protector
B094_StockProtector.description: Each time before you use the __Fencing__ action space, you get 2 <WOOD>. Immediately after that __Fencing__ action, you can place another person.

C001_Overhaul.name: Overhaul
C001_Overhaul.description: Immediately raze all of your fences, add up to 3 fences from your supply, and rebuild them. (You do not lose any animals during this.)

C010_BunkBeds.name: Bunk Beds
C010_BunkBeds.description: Once you have 4 rooms, your house can hold 5 people.

C013_WoodSlideHammer.name: Wood Slide Hammer
C013_WoodSlideHammer.description: On your first renovation, if you have at least 5 wood rooms, you can renovate to stone directly and you get a discount of 2 <STONE> on the renovation cost.

C130_OutskirtsDirector.name: Outskirts Director
C130_OutskirtsDirector.description: Each time you use the __Grove__ or __Hollow__ accumulation space, you can place 2 <REED> from the general supply on the other space. If you do, you can immediately place another person.

C168_AnimalCatcher.name: Animal Catcher
C168_AnimalCatcher.description: Each time you use the __Day Laborer__ action space, instead of 2 <FOOD>, you can get 3 different animals from the general supply. If you do, you must pay 1 <FOOD> each harvest left to play.

C017_NewlyPlowedField.name: Newly-Plowed Field
C017_NewlyPlowedField.description: When you play this card, you can immediately plow 1 field, which needs not be adjacent to another field.

C018_RollOverPlow.name: Roll-Over Plow
C018_RollOverPlow.description: At any time, if you have at least 3 planted fields, you can discard all goods from one of those fields to plow 1 field.

C019_SwingPlow.name: Swing Plow
C019_SwingPlow.description: Place 4 field tiles on this card. Each time you use the __space:farmland|Farmland__ action space, you can also plow up to 2 fields from this card.

C022_BasketChair.rules: Only an adult person can be moved to this card; a newborn remains on its action space.
C022_BasketChair.description: When you play this card, you can immediately move the first person you placed this work phase to this card (unless it is on __space:meeting-place|Meeting Place__). If you do, immediately afterward, you can place another person.

C023_JobContract.name: Job Contract
C023_JobContract.description: If both are unoccupied, you can use the __space:day-laborer|Day Laborer__ and the adjacent __space:lessons,lessons-3,lessons-4,lessons-56-2f,lessons-56-variable|Lessons__ action space with a single person (in that order). Afterward, both spaces are considered occupied.

C024_BedintheGrainField.name: Bed in the Grain Field
C024_BedintheGrainField.description: At the start of the next harvest, you get a __Family Growth__ action if you have room for the newborn.

C025_SteamMachine.name: Steam Machine
C025_SteamMachine.description: Each work phase, if the last action space you use is an accumulation space, you can immediately afterward take a __Bake Bread__ action.

C027_Blueprint.name: Blueprint
C027_Blueprint.description: You can build the major improvements __Joinery__, __Pottery__, and __Basketmaker\\

C029_BeerTable.name: Beer Table
C029_BeerTable.description: At the end of the field phase of each harvest, you can pay 1 <GRAIN> from your supply to get 2 bonus <SCORE>. If you do, all other players get 1 <FOOD> each.

C031_WritingChamber.name: Writing Chamber
C031_WritingChamber.description: During scoring, you get a number of bonus <SCORE> equal to the total of negative points you have, to a maximum of 7 <SCORE>.

C037_DwellingMound.name: Dwelling Mound
C037_DwellingMound.description: From now on, you must pay 1 <FOOD> for each new field tile that you place in your farmyard.

C051_FishingNet.name: Fishing Net
C051_FishingNet.description: Each time another player uses the __space:fishing|Fishing__ accumulation space, they must first pay you 1 <FOOD>. Then, in the returning home phase of that round, place 2 <FOOD> on __space:fishing|Fishing__.

C052_HuntsmansHat.name: Huntsman's Hat
C052_HuntsmansHat.description: For each new <PIG> you get from the effect of an action space, you also get 1 <FOOD>.

C057_Crudite.name: Crudité
C057_Crudite.description: When you play this card, you can immediately buy exactly 1 <VEGETABLE> for 3 <FOOD>. At any time, you can discard 1 <VEGETABLE> on top of another <VEGETABLE> in a field to get 4 <FOOD>.

C060_SmallPottersOven.name: Small Potter's Oven
C060_SmallPottersOven.description: When you play this card, you immediately get 5 <FOOD>. Each time before you get a __Bake Bread__ action, you can build the __Clay Oven__ or __Stone Oven__ major improvement.

C063_CraftBrewery.name: Craft Brewery
C063_CraftBrewery.description: In the feeding phase of each harvest, you can use this card to exchange 1 <GRAIN> from your supply plus 1 <GRAIN> from a field for 2 bonus <SCORE> and 4 <FOOD>.

C071_Slurry.name: Slurry
C071_Slurry.description: In the breeding phase of each harvest, if you get newborn animals of at least two types, you also get a __Sow__ action.

C075_Firewood.name: Firewood
C075_Firewood.description: In the returning home phase of each round, place 1 <WOOD> on this card. Each time after you build a Fireplace, Cooking Hearth, or oven, move up to 4 <WOOD> from this card to your supply.

C008_PlantFertilizer.name: Plant Fertilizer
C008_PlantFertilizer.description: In each field with exactly 1 good, you can immediately place 1 additional good of the same type.

C084_PerennialRye.name: Perennial Rye
C084_PerennialRye.description: Each round that does not end with a harvest, you can pay 1 <GRAIN> to breed exactly 1 type of animal. (This is not considered a breeding phase.)

D010_StorksNest.name: Stork's Nest
D010_StorksNest.description: In the returning home phase of each round, if you have more rooms than people, you can pay 1 <FOOD> to take a __Family Growth__ action.

D014_HammerCrusher.name: Hammer Crusher
D014_HammerCrusher.description: Immediately before you renovate to stone, you get 2 <CLAY> and 1 <REED> and you can take a __Build Rooms__ action.

D164_PetGrower.name: Pet Grower
D164_PetGrower.description: Each time you use an animal accumulation space, if afterward you have no animal in your house, you also get 1 <SHEEP>.

D020_TurnwrestPlow.name: Turnwrest Plow
D020_TurnwrestPlow.description: Place 2 field tiles on this card. Each time you use the __space:farmland|Farmland__ or __space:cultivation|Cultivation__ action space, you can also plow up to 2 fields from this card.

D022_WorkPermit.name: Work Permit
D022_WorkPermit.description: Add 1 to the current round for each building resource you have and place 1 person from your supply on the corresponding round space. In that round, you can use the person.

D023_PioneeringSpirit.name: Pioneering Spirit
D023_PioneeringSpirit.description: This card is an action space for you only. In rounds 3-5, it provides a __Renovation__ action. In rounds 6-8, it provides your choice of 1 <VEGETABLE>, <PIG>, or <CATTLE>.

D025_WitchesDanceFloor.name: Witches' Dance Floor
D025_WitchesDanceFloor.description: This card is a field that you can sow in, an occupation, and the "Fireplace" major improvement with all of its effects. You can play it only via a __Minor Improvement__ action.

D026_CarpentersYard.name: Carpenter's Yard
D026_CarpentersYard.description: You can build the __Joinery__ and __Well__ major improvement even when taking a __Minor Improvement__ action, or you can build both with a single __Major Improvement__ action.

D027_Retraining.name: Retraining
D027_Retraining.description: At the end of each turn in which you renovate, you can exchange your __Joinery__ for the __Pottery__ or your __Pottery__ for the __Basketmaker\\

D036_BreedRegistry.name: Breed Registry
D036_BreedRegistry.description: During scoring, if you gained at most 2 <SHEEP> from sources other than breeding during the game and have not turned any sheep into food, you get 3 bonus <SCORE>.

D051_Archway.name: Archway
D051_Archway.description: This card is an action space for all. A player who uses it immediately gets 1 <FOOD>. Immediately before the returning home phase, they can use an unoccupied action space with the person from this card.

D053_TeaHouse.name: Tea House
D053_TeaHouse.description: Once per round, you can skip placing your second person and get 1 <FOOD> instead. (You can place the person later that round.)

D055_NewMarket.name: New Market
D055_NewMarket.description: Each time you use an action space card on round spaces 8 to 11, you get 1 additional <FOOD>.

D066_PotterCeramics.name: Potter Ceramics
D066_PotterCeramics.description: Each time before you take a __Bake Bread__ action, you can exchange 1 <CLAY> for 1 <GRAIN>.

D070_StrawManure.name: Straw Manure
D070_StrawManure.description: Before the field phase of each harvest, you can pay 1 <GRAIN> from your supply to add 1 <VEGETABLE> to each of up to 2 vegetable fields.

D071_Changeover.name: Changeover
D071_Changeover.description: At any time, if a field contains exactly 1 good as a result of a harvest, you can discard that good and immediately take a __Sow__ action limited to that field.

D072_StableManure.name: Stable Manure
D072_StableManure.description: In the field phase of each harvest, you can harvest 1 additional good from a number of fields equal to the number of unfenced stables you have.

D074_RoyalWood.name: Royal Wood
D074_RoyalWood.description: At the end of each turn in which you use the __space:farm-expansion|Farm Expansion__ action space or build an improvement, you get 1 <WOOD> back for every 2 <WOOD> paid during those actions (rounded down).

D092_ChildOmbudsman.name: Child Ombudsman
D092_ChildOmbudsman.description: From round 5 on, if you have room in your house, at the end of each person action, you can take a __Family Growth__ action with that person. If you do, you get 2 negative <SCORE>.

E010_StrawHat.name: Straw Hat
E010_StrawHat.description: At the end of the work phases of rounds 3 and 6, you can move your person from the __space:farmland|Farmland__ action space to an unoccupied action space and take that action, or get 1 <FOOD>.

E016_BriarHedge.name: Briar Hedge
E016_BriarHedge.description: You do not need to pay wood for fences that you build on the edge of your farmyard board.

E022_GuestRoom.name: Guest Room
E022_GuestRoom.description: Immediately place any amount of <FOOD> from your supply on this card. Once per round, you can discard 1 <FOOD> from this card to place a person from your supply in that round.

E027_PiggyBank.name: Piggy Bank
E027_PiggyBank.description: At the end of each work phase, you can place 1 <FOOD> on this card, irretrievably. At any time, you can discard 6 <FOOD> from this card to build a major improvement at no cost.

E030_ChildsToy.name: Child's Toy
E030_ChildsToy.description: During the feeding phase of each harvest, your newborns require 2 <FOOD> (instead of 1).

E033_BeaverColony.name: Beaver Colony
E033_BeaverColony.description: From now on, one of your pastures with stable cannot hold animals. Each time you get <REED> from an action space, you get 1 bonus <SCORE>.

E036_HerbalGarden.name: Herbal Garden
E036_HerbalGarden.description: From now on, at least one of your pastures must contain no animals.

E004_Thunderbolt.name: Thunderbolt
E004_Thunderbolt.description: Immediately remove all <GRAIN> from one of your fields to the general supply. Gain 2 <WOOD> for each <GRAIN> you just removed.

E005_NightLoot.name: Night Loot
E005_NightLoot.description: Immediately remove 2 different building resources total from accumulation spaces and place them in your supply.

E051_WhaleOil.name: Whale Oil
E051_WhaleOil.description: Each time you use __space:fishing|Fishing__, place 1 <FOOD> from the general supply on this card. Each time before you play an occupation, you get <FOOD> equal to the amount on this card.

E052_Cubbyhole.name: Cubbyhole
E052_Cubbyhole.description: For each room that you add to your house, place 1 <FOOD> from the general supply on this card. At the start of each feeding phase, you get <FOOD> equal to the amount on this card.

E053_BoarSpear.name: Boar Spear
E053_BoarSpear.description: Each time you get at least 1 <PIG> outside of the breeding phase of a harvest, you can immediately turn them into 4 <FOOD> each.

E062_SourDough.name: Sour Dough
E062_SourDough.description: Once per round, if all players have at least 1 person left to place, you can skip placing a person and take a __Bake Bread__ action instead.

E071_CowPatty.name: Cow Patty
E071_CowPatty.description: Each time you sow in a field that is orthogonally adjacent to a pasture, you can place 1 additional good of the planted type in it.

E073_Scythe.name: Scythe
E073_Scythe.description: During the field phase of each harvest, you can select exactly one of your fields and harvest all the crops planted in it.

E074_AshTrees.name: Ash Trees
E074_AshTrees.description: When you play this card, immediately place (up to) 5 fences from your supply on it. When you build fences, fences taken from this card cost you nothing.

E075_StoneAxe.name: Stone Axe
E075_StoneAxe.description: Each time you use a wood accumulation space, you can return 1 <STONE> to the general supply to get an additional 3 <WOOD>.

E076_LumberPile.name: Lumber Pile
E076_LumberPile.description: When you play this card, you can immediately return up to 3 <STABLE> from your farmyard board to your supply and get 3 <WOOD> for each.

E078_SleightofHand.name: Sleight of Hand
E078_SleightofHand.description: When you play this card, you can immediately exchange up to 4 building resources for an equal number of other building resources.

E081_AlchemistsLab.name: Alchemists Lab
E081_AlchemistsLab.description: This card is an action space for all. A player who uses it gets 1 building resource of each type they already have. If another player uses it, they must first pay you 1 <FOOD>.

E082_Profiteering.name: Profiteering
E082_Profiteering.description: When you play this card, you immediately get 1 <FOOD>. Each time you use the __space:day-laborer|Day Laborer__ action space, you can exchange 1 building resource for another building resource.

E084_DollysMother.name: Dolly's Mother
E084_DollysMother.description: You only require 1 <SHEEP> to breed sheep during the breeding phase of a harvest. This card can hold 1 <SHEEP>.

M027_GardenPath.rules: During scoring, the player holding the __Garden Path__ token loses 1 <SCORE>. There is only one token: each time this card is played, move it to the player to the left. The previous holder no longer has it.

A018_WheelPlow.description: Once this game, when you use the __space:farmland|Farmland__ or __space:cultivation|Cultivation__ action space with the first person you place in a round, you can plow 2 additional <FIELD>.

A024_ThreshingBoard.description: Each time you use the __space:farmland|Farmland__ or __space:cultivation|Cultivation__ action space, you get an additional __Bake Bread__ action.

A025_Bassinet.description: You can place a(nother) person on the first non-accumulating action space used in each work phase, if there is only 1 person, including newborns, on that space. (There can never be two people on __space:meeting-place|Meeting Place__.)

A026_SleepingCorner.description: You can use any __space:wish-children,urgent-wish-children,modest-wish-children-56|Wish for Children__ action space even if it is occupied by one other player's person.

A035_SwimmingClass.description: In the returning home phase of each round, if you return a person from the __space:fishing|Fishing__ accumulation space, you get 2 bonus <SCORE> for each newborn that you return home.

A042_ForestLakeHut.description: Each time you use the __space:fishing|Fishing__/__space:forest|Forest__ accumulation space, you also get 1 <WOOD>/<FOOD>.

A046_ClawKnife.description: Each time you use the __space:sheep-market|Sheep Market__ accumulation space, place 1 <FOOD> on each of the next 2 round spaces. At the start of these rounds, you get the <FOOD>.

A049_NestSite.description: Each time 1 <REED> is placed on a non-empty __space:reed-bank|Reed Bank__ accumulation space during the preparation phase, you get 1 <FOOD>.

A050_MilkJug.description: Each time any player (including you) uses the __space:cattle-market|Cattle Market__ accumulation space, you get 3 <FOOD>, and each other player gets 1 <FOOD>.

A051_DriftNetBoat.description: Each time you use the __space:fishing|Fishing__ accumulation space, you get an additional 2 <FOOD>.

A052_ThrowingAxe.description: Each time you use a <WOOD> accumulation space while there is at least 1 <PIG> on the __space:pig-market|Pig Market__ accumulation space, you also get 2 <FOOD>.

A067_CornScoop.description: Each time you use the __space:grain-seeds|Grain Seeds__ action space, you get 1 additional <GRAIN>.

A077_Hod.description: When you play this card, you immediately get 1 <CLAY>. Each time any player (including you) uses the __space:pig-market|Pig Market__ accumulation space, you immediately get 2 <CLAY>.

A078_Canoe.description: Each time you use the __space:fishing|Fishing__ accumulation space, you get an additional 1 <FOOD> and 1 <REED>.

B024_Lasso.description: You can place exactly two people immediately after one another if at least one of them uses the __space:sheep-market|Sheep Market__, __space:pig-market|Pig Market__, or __space:cattle-market|Cattle Market__ accumulation space.

B026_AgrarianFences.description: Each time you use the __space:grain-utilization|Grain Utilization__ action space, you can take a __Build Fences__ action instead of one of the two actions provide by the action space.

B028_ForestryStudies.description: Each time after you use the __space:forest|Forest__ accumulation space, you can return 2 <WOOD> to that space to play 1 occupation without paying an occupation costs.

B029_CookeryLesson.description: Each time you use a __space:lessons,lessons-3,lessons-4,lessons-56-2f,lessons-56-variable|Lessons__ action space and a cooking improvement on the same turn, you get 1 bonus <SCORE>.

B040_BreweryPond.description: Each time you use the __space:fishing|Fishing__ or __space:reed-bank|Reed Bank__ accumulation space, you also get 1 <GRAIN> and 1 <WOOD>.

B043_Chophouse.description: Each time you use the __space:grain-seeds,vegetable-seeds|Grain/Vegetable Seeds__ action space, place 1 <FOOD> on each of the next 3/2 round spaces. At the start of these rounds, you get the <FOOD>.

B047_HerringPot.description: Each time you use the __space:fishing|Fishing__ accumulation space, place 1 <FOOD> on each of the next 3 round spaces. At the start of these rounds, you get the <FOOD>.

B056_Brook.description: Each time you use one of the four action spaces above the __space:fishing|Fishing__ accumulation space, you get 1 additional <FOOD>.

B059_FoodChest.description: If you play this card on the __space:major-improvement|Major Improvement__ action space, you immediately get 4 <FOOD>. Otherwise, you get only 2 <FOOD>.

B060_BrewingWater.description: Each time you use the __space:fishing|Fishing__ accumulation space, you can pay 1 <GRAIN> to place 1 <FOOD> on each of the next 6 round spaces. At the start of these rounds, you get the <FOOD>.

B062_Pitchfork.description: Each time you use the __space:grain-seeds|Grain Seeds__ action space, if the __space:farmland|Farmland__ action space is occupied you also get 3 <FOOD>.

B063_Tasting.description: Each time you use a __space:lessons,lessons-3,lessons-4,lessons-56-2f,lessons-56-variable|Lessons__ action space, before paying the occupation cost, you can exchange 1 <GRAIN> for 4 <FOOD>.

B064_MillWheel.description: Each time you use the __space:grain-utilization|Grain Utilization__ action space while the __space:fishing|Fishing__ accumulation space is occupied, you get an additional 2 <FOOD>.

B077_LoamPit.description: Each time you use the __space:day-laborer|Day Laborer__ action space, you also get 3 <CLAY>.

C015_Trellis.description: Each time before you use the __space:pig-market|Pig Market__ accumulation space, you can take a __Build Fences__ action. (You must pay <WOOD> for the <FENCE> as usual.)

C020_MolePlow.description: Each time you use the __space:farmland|Farmland__ or __space:cultivation|Cultivation__ action space, you can plow 1 additional <FIELD>.

C021_HeartofStone.description: Each time a __space:western-quarry,eastern-quarry|Quarry__ accumulation space is revealed, if you have room in your house, you can immediately take a __Family Growth__ action without placing a person.

C026_Flail.description: When you play this card, you immediately get 2 <FOOD>. Each time you use the __space:farmland|Farmland__ or __space:cultivation|Cultivation__ action space, you can also take a __Bake Bread__ action.

C028_TeachersDesk.description: Each time you use the __space:major-improvement|Major Improvement__ or __space:house-redevelopment|House Redevelopment__ action space, you can also play 1 occupation at an occupation cost of 1 <FOOD>.

C039_StudioBoat.description: Each time you use the __space:traveling-players,traveling-players-56|Traveling Players__ accumulation space, you also get 1 bonus <SCORE>. In games with 1-3 players, this card is considered __space:traveling-players,traveling-players-56|Traveling Players__ (same effect as __space:fishing|Fishing__).

C042_RavenousHunger.description: Immediately after each time you use the __space:vegetable-seeds|Vegetable Seeds__ action space, you can place another person on an accumulation space and get 1 additional good of the accumulating type.

C045_Stew.description: Each time you use the __space:day-laborer|Day Laborer__ action space, also place 1 <FOOD> on each of the next 4 round spaces. At the start of these rounds, you get the <FOOD>.

C082_HardwareStore.description: Each time after you use the __space:day-laborer|Day Laborer__ action space, you can pay 2 <FOOD> total to buy 1 <WOOD>, 1 <CLAY>, 1 <REED>, and 1 <STONE>.

D016_WoodenWheyBucket.description: Each time before you use the __space:sheep-market|Sheep Market__/__space:cattle-market|Cattle Market__ accumulation space, you can build exactly 1 <STABLE> for 1 <WOOD>/at no cost.

D018_SteamPlow.description: Immediately after each returning home phase, you can pay 2 <WOOD> and 1 <FOOD> to use the __space:farmland|Farmland__ action space without placing a person.

D028_WritingDesk.description: Each time you use a __space:lessons,lessons-3,lessons-4,lessons-56-2f,lessons-56-variable|Lessons__ action space, you can play 1 additional occupation for an occupation cost of 2 <FOOD>.

D054_TroutPool.description: At the start of each work phase, if there are at least 3 <FOOD> on the __space:fishing|Fishing__ accumulation space, you get 1 <FOOD> from the general supply.

D068_SmallBasket.description: Each time after you use the __space:reed-bank|Reed Bank__ accumulation space, you can pay 1 <REED> to get 1 <VEGETABLE>. If you do in a game with 4+ players, place that 1 <REED> on the accumulation space.

D073_SupplyBoat.description: Each time after you use the __space:fishing|Fishing__ accumulation space, you can choose to buy 1 <GRAIN> for 1 <FOOD>, or 1 <VEGETABLE> for 3 <FOOD>.

D082_HuntingTrophy.description:
To play this card, you must return or cook 1 <PIG>.
Improvements built on __space:house-redevelopment|House Redevelopment__ cost you 1 building resource of your choice less. <FENCE> built on __space:farm-redevelopment|Farm Redevelopment__ cost you a total of 3 <WOOD> less.

D083_Pigswill.description: Each time you use the __space:fencing|Fencing__ action space, you also get 1 <PIG>.

E003_TeaTime.description: Immediately return your person on the __space:grain-utilization|Grain Utilization__ action space home; you can place it again later this round.

E017_SkimmerPlow.description: Each time you use the __space:farmland|Farmland__ or __space:cultivation|Cultivation__  action space, you can plow 2 <FIELD> instead of 1. Each time you sow, you must place 1 fewer good on each <FIELD> you sow.

E019_OxGoad.description: Each time after you use the __space:cattle-market|Cattle Market__ accumulation space, you can pay 2 <FOOD> to plow 1 <FIELD>.

E020_IronHoe.description: At the end of each work phase, if you occupy both the __space:grain-seeds|Grain Seeds__ and __space:vegetable-seeds|Vegetable Seeds__ action spaces, you can plow 1 <FIELD>.

E021_SheepRug.description: You can use any __space:wish-children,urgent-wish-children,modest-wish-children-56|Wish for Children__ action space, even if it is occupied by another player's person.

E038_RodCollection.description: Each time you use __space:fishing|Fishing__, you can place up to 2 <WOOD> on this card, irretrievably. During scoring, each such <WOOD> is worth 1 bonus <SCORE>, except the 1st, 4th, 7th, and 10th.

E040_BeeStatue.description: Pile (from bottom to top) 1 <VEGETABLE>, 1 <STONE>, 1 <GRAIN>, 1 <STONE>, 1 <GRAIN> on this card. Each time you use the __space:day-laborer|Day Laborer__ action space, you get the top good.

E055_StoneWeir.description: Each time you use the __space:fishing|Fishing__ accumulation space, if there are 0/1/2/3 <FOOD> on the space, you get an additional 4/3/2/1 <FOOD> from the general supply.

E059_CombandCutter.description: Each time you use the __space:day-laborer|Day Laborer__ action space, you get 1 additional <FOOD> for each <SHEEP> on the __space:sheep-market|Sheep Market__ accumulation space, up to a maximum of 4 additional <FOOD>.

E066_BarnShed.description: Each time another player (or, in a solo game, you) uses the __space:forest|Forest__ accumulation space, you get 1 <GRAIN>.

E067_GrainBag.description: Each time you use the __space:grain-seeds|Grain Seeds__ action space, you get 1 additional <GRAIN> for each <BAKE>-improvement you have.

M041_CattleCollar.description: Each time after you use the __space:farmland|Farmland__ or __space:cultivation|Cultivation__ action space or take the __moor:slash-and-burn|Slash and Burn__ special action, if you have at least 1 <CATTLE>, you can plow 1 additional <FIELD>.

M042_DeepPlow.description: You can immediately place 1 <MOOR> on an unused farmyard space. Each time you use the __space:farmland|Farmland__ or __space:cultivation|Cultivation__ action space, you can also exchange 1 <MOOR> for 1 <FIELD> tile.

M046_Thicket.description: Choose up to 2 of your <FOREST> and place 1 additional <FOREST> on top of each of them. You cannot take the __moor:slash-and-burn|Slash and Burn__ special action on these farmyard spaces unless you remove a tile with a __moor:fell-trees|Fell Trees__ special action first.

M047_BogForest.description: Place 1 <FOREST> each on as many of your <MOOR> as you wish. You cannot take the __moor:slash-and-burn|Slash and Burn__ special action or use the covered <MOOR> on these farmyard spaces unless you remove the <FOREST> with a __moor:fell-trees|Fell Trees__ special action first.

M048_ForestSwamp.description: Each time you take the __moor:cut-peat|Cut Peat__ special action, add 4 to the current round and place 1 <FOREST> on the corresponding round space. At the start of that round, you can place the <FOREST> on an unused farmyard space.

M054_AgriculturalImplement.description: Immediately after each time you use the __space:farmland|Farmland__ or __space:cultivation|Cultivation__ action space, you can take a face-up special action card. The special action card costs 0 or 2 <FOOD>, as usual.

M055_ToolShed.description: Once per round, immediately before or after you take the __moor:slash-and-burn|Slash and Burn__ or __moor:cut-peat|Cut Peat__ special action, you can also take the respective other special action.

M056_PeatCuttingRights.description: Add 4 and 7 to the current round and place 1 <FUEL> on each corresponding round space. At the start of these rounds, you can discard the <FUEL> and take the __moor:cut-peat|Cut Peat__ special action by taking the appropriate special action card.

M058_PeatFertilizer.description: Each time after you take the __moor:cut-peat|Cut Peat__ special action, you can also take a __Sow__ action.

M059_NaturesFertilizer.description: Each time after you take the __moor:slash-and-burn|Slash and Burn__ special action, you also get a __Sow__ action for the new <FIELD> only. This also applies when you exchange 1 <MOOR> for 1 <FIELD> tile via a minor improvement.

M070_MoorArchaeology.description: Each time you take the __moor:cut-peat|Cut Peat__ special action, you can place 1 <FENCE> from your supply on the emptied farmyard space. That space counts as used but it is blocked for the rest of the game. During scoring, it is worth 1 additional bonus <SCORE>.

M077_DryingField.description: Each time you take the __moor:cut-peat|Cut Peat__ special action, add 3 to the current round and place 2 <FUEL> on the corresponding round space. At the start of that round, you get the <FUEL>.

M083_CoalSeam.description: When you play this card, you immediately get 1 <FUEL>. Each time you take the __moor:hiring-fair|Hiring Fair__ special action or use the __space:day-laborer|Day Laborer__ action space, you also get 1 <FUEL>.

M087_PeatBarge.description: Each time you use the __space:fishing|Fishing__ accumulation space, you also get 2 <FUEL>.

M092_AridField.description: Each time you take the __moor:cut-peat|Cut Peat__ special action, place 1 <FUEL> and 1 <FOOD> on the emptied farmyard space. This farmyard space is still considered unused. You get the goods once the farmyard space is no longer unused.

M096_FallowLand.description: Each time you take the __moor:fell-trees|Fell Trees__ or __moor:cut-peat|Cut Peat__ special action, place 1 <FOOD> on the emptied farmyard space. This farmyard space is still considered unused. Once the farmyard space is no longer unused, you get the <FOOD>.

M098_FishSmokehouse.description: Each time you use the __space:fishing|Fishing__ accumulation space, you can pay 1 <FUEL> to get an additional 3 <FOOD>.

M109_Malthouse.description: Each time you take the __moor:cut-peat|Cut Peat__ special action, you can also turn exactly 1 <GRAIN> into 4 <FOOD>.

M112_PeatAshFertilizer.description: Each time before you take the __moor:cut-peat|Cut Peat__ special action, you can place 1 additional crop of the same type on all <FIELD> and farmyard spaces containing <GRAIN> or <VEGETABLE>. Do not place any crops on empty <FIELD> and farmyard spaces.

M114_RiversideWoods.description: With this card, each time you use the __space:fishing|Fishing__ accumulation space, you also get 1 <WOOD> for each of your farmyard spaces containing at least 1 <FOREST>, up to a maximum of 3 <WOOD>.

M116_MoorBirchTrees.description: Each time you take the __moor:cut-peat|Cut Peat__ special action, you also get 2 <WOOD>.

M118_TimberMill.description: Each time you take the __moor:fell-trees|Fell Trees__ special action or take at least 4 <WOOD> from an accumulation space, you get 1 additional <WOOD>. If you pay 1 <FUEL>, you get 2 additional <WOOD> instead of 1.

M119_AlderSwamp.description: Each time you take the __moor:fell-trees|Fell Trees__ special action, you also get your choice of 1 <WOOD> or 1 <REED>.

M120_RiverClay.description: Each time you use the __space:fishing|Fishing__ accumulation space, you also get 2 <CLAY>.

M121_Loam.description: In each work phase, if you have placed all but one of your people when taking the __moor:hiring-fair|Hiring Fair__ special action, you also get 1 <CLAY>.

M122_WillowBank.description: Each time you take the __moor:fell-trees|Fell Trees__ special action, you also get 1 <REED>.

M123_StoneQuarry.description: Place 5 <STONE>--only 3 <STONE> in 3-player games--on this card. Each time you take the __moor:hiring-fair|Hiring Fair__ special action, you also get 1 <STONE> from this card.

M124_StoneWagon.description: Each time you use the __space:day-laborer|Day Laborer__ action space, you also get 1 <STONE>.

M127_Wheelbarrow.description: Each time you take at least 4 of the same building resource from an accumulation space, you also get 1 <FUEL>. Each time you take the __moor:cut-peat|Cut Peat__ special action, you also get 1 building resource of your choice.

M129_PlowhorseMarket.description: Each time you use the __space:farmland|Farmland__ or __space:cultivation|Cultivation__ action space, you can also buy exactly 1 <HORSE> for 1 <FOOD>.

M130_Nosebag.description: Each time you use the __space:grain-seeds|Grain Seeds__ action space, you also get 1 <HORSE>.

OLD_BI01_SparrenCastle.name: 施帕仁堡
OLD_BI01_SparrenCastle.description: 每当任意玩家使用木头/石头积累行动格时，从游戏供应区放置1木头/1石头到此卡上。每当你使用提供“翻修”行动的行动格前，你可以将此卡上至多5个资源放入个人供应区。游戏结束计分前，移除此卡上的所有资源。

OLD_BI02_BielefeldCards.name: 扑克牌
OLD_BI02_BielefeldCards.description: 每次你从积累行动格获得资源时，将获得的所有资源放在此卡上。每当此卡上有4个相同的资源时，将4个该种资源移入你的个人供应区。当你使用动物积累行动格时，无论你能否将动物转换为食物/农场是否有饲养空间，必须把所有动物放置在此卡上。当此卡上有4个相同动物时，将4个动物转换为食物/移入农场，否则将它们丢弃。此卡上的动物不能参与繁殖。当4个建筑资源移入你的个人供应区时，可以发动WM043资源放贷者效果。

OLD_BI03_BakingPowder.name: 发酵粉
OLD_BI03_BakingPowder.description: 每当你使用播种和/或烤面包行动格时，在你的每张主要发展卡上放置1份小麦。每当你打出职业卡时，将这些小麦移入你的个人供应区。如果有主要发展卡被你视作次要发展卡，此时仍可当作主要发展卡。游戏结束计分前，移除此卡上的所有资源。

OLD_BI04_Spielwiese.name: 游乐场
OLD_BI04_Spielwiese.description: 从牌库中随机抽取2张职业卡加入手牌。查看这两张牌的适用玩家数(如1+,3+,或4+)并取较小值，你获得等同于该数量的由你选择的不同种类的建筑资源。使用后请将此卡交给下家，此卡将加入他的手牌。

OLD_BI05_HomeZoo.name: 私家动物园
OLD_BI05_HomeZoo.description: 此卡可容纳羊、猪、牛各一只。只有从积累行动格拿取的动物能放到此卡上。此卡上的动物不参与繁殖阶段，在最后一次收获阶段，你可以将此卡上的动物换成分数，每只1分。吉士1张带有炉子符号

OLD_BI06_Conspiracy.name: Bi扩卡牌
OLD_BI06_Conspiracy.description: 在每个丰收时节的收割阶段，你打出的每2张Bi扩卡牌使你获得1食物。游戏结束时，每位打出至少1/3/5张Bi扩卡牌的玩家获得1/3/5分。

OLD_BI07_BakingPowder.name: 亚麻纺织厂
OLD_BI07_BakingPowder.description: 打出此卡时，每位其他玩家可以选择获得2食物。有几个玩家如此做，你就可以支付几个相异的建筑资源获得等量的分数。

OLD_BI08_Custard.name: 吉士
OLD_BI08_Custard.description: 打出此卡时，你获得等同于之后完整丰收时节数量的食物。每当你使用石头积累行动格后，你必须留下1石头在该行动格上。

OLD_BI09_Alm.name: 斗牛场
OLD_BI09_Alm.description: 打出此卡时，你可以从你的农场中退还1个马厩到个人供应区，并获得1只牛。此卡可以容纳任意数量的牛。

OLD_BI10_The52ndLatitude.name: 北纬52度
OLD_BI10_The52ndLatitude.description: 打出此卡时，从游戏供应区拿取1个石头放在你的农场1个空格上，这块空地视为被使用。游戏结束时，每块与该格正交相邻的空田使你获得1分。

OLD_BI11_SchlachterChurch.name: 大教堂
OLD_BI11_SchlachterChurch.description: 每当其他玩家使用炉子 符号发展卡将动物转换成食物时，将这些动物放到此卡上。限一次：任意时刻，你可以将此卡上的所有动物各转换成1食物。

OLD_BI12_Skybridge.name: 天空桥
OLD_BI12_Skybridge.description: 打出此卡时，从个人供应区拿取石头，在每两个正交相邻的房屋之间的交界处放置至多1个。每次丰收时节的喂养阶段，每个这样的石头使你获得1份小麦。游戏结束时，每个这样的石头使你获得1分。(可以放置任意数量的石头)

OLD_BI13_WoodenButtons.name: 木制纽扣
OLD_BI13_WoodenButtons.description: 立即获得等同于你空房间数量(卡牌提供的额外居住空间也算)的食客，并于本回合派遣。本回合结束时退还。本回合，你被食客占据的房间不能用于执行“生娃(需要空房间)”行动。使用后请将此卡交给下家，此卡将加入他的手牌。

OLD_C13_GoldenHands.name: 点金手
OLD_C13_GoldenHands.description: 每当你打出发展卡时，可以用1个任意建筑资源代替原本花费中的至多1个建筑资源。

OLD_C14_School.name: 校舍
OLD_C14_School.description: 每次你执行打出主发或打出次发的行动时，你可以选择将其改成支付1食物并打一张职业卡打次发行不行

OLD_C15_BeerFestival.name: 啤酒节
OLD_C15_BeerFestival.description: 打出时获得一次“烤面包”行动。计分阶段，如果你拥有3/6/9份食物，你获得1/2/3分

OLD_C16_Wagenburg.name: 厢体货车
OLD_C16_Wagenburg.description: 打出此卡时，你可以为每块空地支付1根木头并在上面放1根栅栏条。你可以随时取回这些栅栏。有栅栏的这些空地视为已使用。

OLD_C17_Chapel.name: 教堂
OLD_C17_Chapel.description: 这是一个全体玩家都可以使用的额外行动格。使用此行动格的玩家可以弃掉至多2张乞讨卡，每张需支付1石头到此卡上。游戏结束时，此卡上每一石头使你获得1分。

OLD_C18_HopField.name: 啤酒花田
OLD_C18_HopField.description: 立即支付1至4根木头，获得等量的食物，并将对应数量的栅栏条放到1块空田上(视为已播种)。游戏结束时，每根这样的栅栏使你获得1分

OLD_C19_WineCellar.name: 酒窖
OLD_C19_WineCellar.description: 将至多1个圈地外的马厩放倒视作酒窖，其失去马厩的功能，该格依然视为已使用。每个丰收时节的收割阶段，你获得2份食物。你仍然可以将酒窖圈在圈地中

OLD_C20_Golem.name: 炉
OLD_C20_Golem.description: 在此卡上放置2砖，在之后两回合开始时，你退还1砖到游戏供应区，并且在本回合你的第一位家庭成员使用行动格时，可以执行两次对应的效果(如果是积累行动格则额外获得积累1次的量)

OLD_C21_VenusFigure.name: 维纳斯雕像
OLD_C21_VenusFigure.description: 你使用生儿育女行动格时，可以额外获得一次“生娃(需要空房间)”行动生娃打出次发打出此卡，不能立即发动。

OLD_C22_Bible.name: 圣经
OLD_C22_Bible.description: 在丰收时节前的那一回合，你使用了犁田/粮食耕种[犁播]/小麦种子/蔬菜种子/临时工行动格的家庭成员，在这个丰收时节的喂养阶段可以少喂养1食物

OLD_C23_HungerWall.name: 饥饿墙
OLD_C23_HungerWall.description: 每个喂养阶段，所有玩家都可以支付至多1砖来喂养1名家庭成员，支付的砖头放在此卡上。游戏结束时，此卡上每有2块砖你便获得1分。

OLD_C24_FiveYearPlan.name: 五年计划
OLD_C24_FiveYearPlan.description: 打出此卡时，将一个指示物放在1块空田上，该田无法播种，计分时不算作田，但仍视为已使用的格子。你获得一次"播种"行动，并且此次播种能使新种上的作物额外多叠放2个。

OLD_E11_Field.name: 走耕
OLD_E11_Field.description: 立即犁1块田。使用后请将此卡交给下家，此卡将加入他的手牌。

OLD_E12_FishingRod.name: 鱼竿
OLD_E12_FishingRod.description: 每当你使用钓鱼积累行动格时，额外获得1份食物。从第8回合起，改为额外获得2份食物。

OLD_E13_Axe.name: 斧头
OLD_E13_Axe.description: 你建造每间木屋只需花费2根木头和2捆芦苇。

OLD_E14_BakersOven.name: 烘焙师烤炉
OLD_E14_BakersOven.description: 打出此卡时，你获得1次“烤面包”行动。每次你执行“烤面包”行动时，你可以将至多2份小麦各转换成5份食物。

OLD_E15_BakingTray.name: 烤盘
OLD_E15_BakingTray.description: A5砖造烤炉和A6石造烤炉对你来说是次要发展卡。当你打出A5砖造烤炉、A6石造烤炉、E27木造烤炉时，可以减少任意1个建筑资源花费。

OLD_E16_BuildingMaterial.name: 建筑材料
OLD_E16_BuildingMaterial.description: 立即获得1木/1砖。使用后请将此卡交给下家，此卡将加入他的手牌。

OLD_E17_Windmill.name: 风车磨坊
OLD_E17_Windmill.description: 任意时刻，你可以将1份小麦转换成2份食物。(这不属于“烤面包”行动)

OLD_E18_BeanField.name: 豆田
OLD_E18_BeanField.description: 此卡视为1块田地，但此卡只能种植蔬菜。

OLD_E19_GypsysCrock.name: 三足锅
OLD_E19_GypsysCrock.description: 每当你使用A1/A2火炉、A3/A4/E128壁炉、E20简易火炉、I85烹饪角将任意物品转化成食物时，每转化2个物品你就额外获得1份食物。

OLD_E21_HalftimberedHouse.name: 半木梁房
OLD_E21_HalftimberedHouse.description: 游戏结束时，你的每间石屋都额外获得1分。

OLD_E22_Raft.name: 木筏
OLD_E22_Raft.description: 每当你使用钓鱼积累行动格时，额外获得1份食物/1捆芦苇。

OLD_E23_Manger.name: 食槽
OLD_E23_Manger.description: 游戏结束时，若你所有的圈地总计覆盖了6/7/8/9+农场格子，额外获得1/2/3/4分。

OLD_E24_AnimalPen.name: 畜栏
OLD_E24_AnimalPen.description: 打出此卡时，在之后的每个回合行动格上各放2份食物。这些回合开始时，你获得对应的食物。

OLD_E25_Spices.name: 调味料
OLD_E25_Spices.description: 每当你使用A3/A4/E128壁炉、A1/A2火炉、E20简易火炉、I85烹饪角将蔬菜转换成食物时，每份蔬菜都额外获得1份食物。

OLD_E26_Plane.name: 木工刨
OLD_E26_Plane.description: 每当你使用A7家具工坊、K122大家具工坊、I258家具匠将1个木头转化成食物时，额外获得1份食物，或额外将1根木头转化成2份食物。

OLD_E27_WoodredOven.name: 木造烤炉
OLD_E27_WoodredOven.description: 打出此卡时，你获得1次“烤面包”行动。每次你执行“烤面包”行动时，你可以将任意数量的小麦各转换成3份食物。

OLD_E28_Clogs.name: 木靴
OLD_E28_Clogs.description: 游戏结束时，如果你的房屋等级是砖屋/石屋，你便额外获得1/2分。

OLD_E30_Canoe.name: 独木舟
OLD_E30_Canoe.description: 每当你使用钓鱼积累行动格时，额外获得1份食物和1捆芦苇。

OLD_E31_CarpPond.name: 鲤鱼池
OLD_E31_CarpPond.description: 打出此卡时，在之后的每个奇数回合行动格上各放1份食物。这些回合开始时，你获得对应的食物。

OLD_E32_PotatoDibber.name: 土豆挖掘器
OLD_E32_PotatoDibber.description: 每当你播种蔬菜时，在每块新播种的菜田上额外叠放1份蔬菜。

OLD_E338_FeedPellets.name: 饲料颗粒
OLD_E338_FeedPellets.description: 每个丰收时节的喂养阶段，你可以支付1份蔬菜，获得至多1只你已有的动物。

OLD_E33_Ceramics.name: 陶器
OLD_E33_Ceramics.description: 打出此卡时，你获得2份食物。从现在起，A8陶艺工坊对你来说是一张免费的次要发展卡。

OLD_E34_Basket.name: 篮子
OLD_E34_Basket.description: 每当你从行动格上取得不少于2根木头时，可以留下2根木头在所使用的行动格上，额外获得3份食物。(通过卡牌获得的木头不算)

OLD_E35_CornScoop.name: 谷物铲
OLD_E35_CornScoop.description: 每当你使用小麦种子行动格时，额外获得1份小麦。

OLD_E36_ClayRoof.name: 砖造屋顶
OLD_E36_ClayRoof.description: 每当你扩建/翻修时，对于每间房屋和每次翻修，你可以用至多2砖代替等量的芦苇。

OLD_E37_ClaySupports.name: 砖造支柱
OLD_E37_ClaySupports.description: 每当你扩建砖屋时，你的每间砖屋可改用2块砖头+1根木头+1捆芦苇进行建造。

OLD_E38_MadonnaStatue.name: 圣母像
OLD_E38_MadonnaStatue.description: 打出此卡时，你必须弃掉2张你已打出的发展卡。

OLD_E39_MarketStall.name: 货摊
OLD_E39_MarketStall.description: 立即获得1份蔬菜。使用后请将此卡交给下家，此卡将加入他的手牌。

OLD_E40_MiniPasture.name: 迷你圈地
OLD_E40_MiniPasture.description: 立即免费将你的1个农场格子围成圈地。（遵守围建栅栏的一般规则，且不能分割原有圈地。）使用后请将此卡交给下家，此卡将加入他的手牌。

OLD_E41_Millstone.name: 磨盘
OLD_E41_Millstone.description: 每次你执行“烤面包”行动时，额外获得2份食物。

OLD_E42_HelpfulNeighbours.name: 邻里互助
OLD_E42_HelpfulNeighbours.description: 立即获得1芦苇/1石头。使用后请将此卡交给下家，此卡将加入他的手牌。

OLD_E43_FruitTree.name: 果树
OLD_E43_FruitTree.description: 打出此卡时，在之后的第8到第14回合行动格上各放1份食物。这些回合开始时，你获得对应的食物。

OLD_E44_Outhouse.name: 无水厕所
OLD_E44_Outhouse.description: 至少有1个其他玩家的职业数量≤1时，你才能打出此卡。

OLD_E45_PrivateForest.name: 私有林地
OLD_E45_PrivateForest.description: 打出此卡时，在之后的每个偶数回合行动格上各放1根木头。这些回合开始时，你获得对应的木头。

OLD_E46_SackCart.name: 运粮推车
OLD_E46_SackCart.description: 打出此卡时，在第5,8,11,14回合行动格上各放1份小麦。这些回合开始时，你获得对应的小麦。

OLD_E47_LettucePatch.name: 莴苣田
OLD_E47_LettucePatch.description: 此卡视为1块田地，但此卡只能种植蔬菜。从此卡上收割的每份蔬菜可以立即被转化成4份食物。

OLD_E48_ReedPond.name: 芦苇塘
OLD_E48_ReedPond.description: 打出此卡时，在之后的3个回合行动格上各放1捆芦苇。这些回合开始时，你获得对应的芦苇。

OLD_E49_WritingDesk.name: 写字台
OLD_E49_WritingDesk.description: 每当你使用技能培训行动格打出1张职业卡时，你可以额外支付2份食物作为技能培训费再打出1张职业卡。

OLD_E50_BuildersTrowel.name: 泥铲
OLD_E50_BuildersTrowel.description: 你可以随时将木屋翻修成砖屋。(正常支付翻修费用)。

OLD_E51_Spindle.name: 纺锤
OLD_E51_Spindle.description: 每个丰收时节的收割阶段，你有3/5+只羊，额外获得1/2份食物。(卡牌提供的“收割阶段”不算，如：I92肥料)

OLD_E52_Stable.name: 小马厩
OLD_E52_Stable.description: 立即免费建造1个马厩。使用后请将此卡交给下家，此卡将加入他的手牌。

OLD_E53_ButterChurn.name: 黄油桶
OLD_E53_ButterChurn.description: 每个丰收时节的收割阶段，你每拥有3只羊/2头牛，便可额外获得1份食物。(卡牌提供的“收割阶段”不算，如：I92肥料)

OLD_E54_Quarry.name: 采石场
OLD_E54_Quarry.description: 每当你使用临时工行动格时，额外获得3个石头。

OLD_E55_StoneHouseExtension.name: 扩建石屋
OLD_E55_StoneHouseExtension.description: 立即免费扩建1间石屋。使用后请将此卡交给下家，此卡将加入他的手牌。

OLD_E56_StoneTongs.name: 夹石钳
OLD_E56_StoneTongs.description: 每当你使用石头积累行动格时，额外获得1个石头。

OLD_E57_Dovecote.name: 鸽舍
OLD_E57_Dovecote.description: 打出此卡时，在第10至14回合行动格上各放1份食物。这些回合开始时，你获得对应的食物。

OLD_E58_AnimalYard.name: 兽笼
OLD_E58_AnimalYard.description: 此卡可以容纳两只任意种类的动物。（可被E59饮水槽和E29兽角笛扩充容量）

OLD_E59_DrinkingTrough.name: 饮水槽
OLD_E59_DrinkingTrough.description: 每个圈地（无论是否有马厩）可以多容纳2只动物。可扩充容量：E58兽笼、I102野生保护区、G070畜栏。不可扩充容量：BI05私家动物园、E208马厩管理员、E306驯兽师、WM013西部牛仔、FR105改革家、NL064牧羊人。

OLD_E60_CattleMarket.name: 牛市
OLD_E60_CattleMarket.description: 立即获得1头牛。使用后请将此卡交给下家，此卡将加入他的手牌。

OLD_E61_RidingPlough.name: 车犁
OLD_E61_RidingPlough.description: 在此卡上放4个田地板块。限2次：每当你使用犁田/粮食耕种[犁播]行动格时，你可以使用此卡上2块田，改为犁3块田。每次使用犁田/粮食耕种[犁播]行动格时，只能使用1个犁/I68耙的效果。

OLD_E62_TurnwrestPlough.name: 转犁
OLD_E62_TurnwrestPlough.description: 在此卡上放2个田地板块。限1次：每当你使用犁田/粮食耕种[犁播]行动格时，你可以使用此卡上2块田，改为犁3块田。每次使用犁田/粮食耕种[犁播]行动格时，只能使用1个犁/I68耙的效果。

OLD_FL001_FarmCart.name: 农用推车
OLD_FL001_FarmCart.description: 每当你执行“播种”行动时，你可以在麦田/菜田上播种至多1份蔬菜/小麦(每个田至多额外播种1份)原来的麦田仍然视为麦田卡牌田

OLD_FL002_BeguineCourtyard.name: 比利时庭院
OLD_FL002_BeguineCourtyard.description: 一旦你的房子呈现出如下图的形状，你立即将供应区的所有家庭成员移入你的房子，并于本回合开始派遣(看作成年人)

OLD_FL003_BelgianShepherd.name: 比利时牧羊犬
OLD_FL003_BelgianShepherd.description: 你可以在至多1格空地上饲养2只羊，仍视作未使用。你的房屋里不能再饲养动物

OLD_FL004_EducationalBuilding.name: 教学楼
OLD_FL004_EducationalBuilding.description: 此卡是只有你能使用的行动格。你在游戏中第一次派遣你的第3/4名家庭成员时，都可以将其派遣到此卡上，然后在之后回合行动格上依次放置1木头和1石头，先放木头，这些回合开始时，你获得对应的资源

OLD_FL005_Brabant.name: 人间乐园
OLD_FL005_Brabant.description: 游戏结束时，如果你有恰好2或3种动物的得分是-1分，则你获得5分

OLD_FL006_EndiveField.name: 菊苣田
OLD_FL006_EndiveField.description: 打出时获得1份蔬菜，在以丰收时节为结束的回合结束时，你可以在此卡上播种蔬菜

OLD_FL007_DiamondTradingPost.name: 钻石交易所
OLD_FL007_DiamondTradingPost.description: 从游戏供应区拿取3个石头放在此卡上，任意时刻你可以将这3个石头移入个人供应区。每个丰收时节开始时，如果你个人供应区里的石头比此卡上的多，你可以支付1石头到此卡上并获得动物。第1/2/3次发动时分别获得2只羊/2只猪/2头牛。

OLD_FL008_WoodenDraisine.name: 木制自行车
OLD_FL008_WoodenDraisine.description: 你可以将1个家庭成员派遣到同一版图上两个相邻的积累行动格之间，视为同时占用两格，但必须各留下1个资源在两格上黄发男孩4回合

OLD_FL009_EbonyShoe.name: 乌木鞋
OLD_FL009_EbonyShoe.description: 打出时若距离游戏结束还有1/3/6/9个完整回合，则你立即获得1/2/3/4块砖头。下一位填满自己农场的玩家获得3分

OLD_FL010_StuckCart.name: 停靠的马车
OLD_FL010_StuckCart.description: 立即派遣你剩下的所有家庭成员使用后请将此卡交给下家，此卡将加入他的手牌。

OLD_FL011_Towhead.name: 黄发男孩
OLD_FL011_Towhead.description: 第5回合行动格翻开时，将生儿育女行动格调整到第6回合(通过交换两张牌的位置)，在第5回合，你可以先使用第6回合的生儿育女行动格

OLD_FL012_Cart.name: 马车
OLD_FL012_Cart.description: 如果某个行动格上有至少6木/5砖/4芦苇/3石头，则只有你可以派遣第一名家庭成员使用该格W

OLD_FL013_GiftTable.name: 礼品桌
OLD_FL013_GiftTable.description: 按右图所示将这些物品排列于此卡上，你可以在任意时刻支付1食物来买走最上方的物品。此卡上购买的羊直接进入你的供应区且可以随时转化为2份食物，参与计分但不参与繁殖撒尿女童像

OLD_FL014_JeneverDistillery.name: 荷兰琴酒厂
OLD_FL014_JeneverDistillery.description: 打出时从你的个人供应区拿取1至4根木头放在此卡上，你可以随时取回任意数量的木头。每个丰收时节的收割阶段，你获得等同于此卡上木头数量的食物

OLD_FL015_CourtyardGarden.name: 避暑宅院
OLD_FL015_CourtyardGarden.description: 在计分时，若你居住在石屋内，则你的每块与房间正交相邻的空地都使你获得2分。（你仍然会因这些空地而扣分）

OLD_FL016_JannekenPis.name: 撒尿女童像
OLD_FL016_JannekenPis.description: 你的井变成只有你能使用的行动格。当你使用井时，你再次触发其效果(井指以“井”字作为结尾的卡)

OLD_FL017_BobbinTable.name: 梭形桌
OLD_FL017_BobbinTable.description: 此卡是只有你能使用的额外行动格。使用此卡后，直到下个丰收时节开始前，所有行动格对你而言视为未被占用(起始玩家每回合只变动一次)爱情花园存在生娃行动

OLD_FL019_LanternWonder.name: 灯笼奇观
OLD_FL019_LanternWonder.description: 游戏结束时，你手中每剩1张卡牌便扣1分。无论如何，你都不能弃除手中的卡牌了。若你已通过某种方式弃除过卡牌，则不能打出此卡。

OLD_FL020_LoveGarden.name: 爱情花园
OLD_FL020_LoveGarden.description: 每个工作阶段结束时，如果所有提供“生娃”和“扩建房屋”行动的行动格都被占用，你立即执行1次“生娃(需要空房间)”行动

OLD_FL021_LionsMound.name: 山顶的狮子
OLD_FL021_LionsMound.description: 在1/2/3/4/5人游戏中，此卡只能在第13/11/9/7/4回合或之后打出。每个工作阶段结束时，如果没有其他玩家占用的行动格回合数比你占用的小，则你获得1分

OLD_FL022_CornMaze.name: 麦田迷宫
OLD_FL022_CornMaze.description: 每回合开始时，如果你有2×2布置的麦田，你获得1根木头+1捆芦苇。

OLD_FL023_CarrotMuseum.name: 胡萝卜博物馆
OLD_FL023_CarrotMuseum.description: 在第8,10,12回合结束时，你的每块菜田使你获得1块石头，你个人供应区中的每份蔬菜使你获得1根木头

OLD_FL024_LoversTryst.name: 情人幽会
OLD_FL024_LoversTryst.description: 如果你在聚会场所行动格打出此卡，你可以选择不移动起始玩家标记并执行一次“生娃(需要空房间)”行动。使用后请将此卡交给下家，此卡将加入他的手牌。

OLD_FL025_Cockaigne.name: 安乐乡
OLD_FL025_Cockaigne.description: 限1次：如果你有1食物+1小麦+1蔬菜+1羊+1猪+1石头，你可以选择在本回合不放置任何家庭成员并获得7分

OLD_FL026_SpeculoosBakery.name: 焦糖饼干店
OLD_FL026_SpeculoosBakery.description: 每当你通过行动格执行“烤面包”行动时，你可以支付1份小麦并获得1名食客标记，食客于当回合使用后退还

OLD_FL027_TrappistBeer.name: 修道院啤酒
OLD_FL027_TrappistBeer.description: 每个丰收时节开始时，你可以支付1份小麦跳过本次丰收时节的结算

OLD_FL028_HashwithFries.name: 肉丁土豆泥
OLD_FL028_HashwithFries.description: 立即将1份小麦+1份蔬菜+1头牛转化为5份食物+3分使用后请将此卡交给下家，此卡将加入他的手牌。

OLD_FL029_BirdTrap.name: 捕鸟器
OLD_FL029_BirdTrap.description: 每个丰收时节的收割阶段，你获得1份食物，并且可以从至多1块田上额外收割至多1份作物

OLD_FL030_WildBoarHunt.name: 野猪狩猎
OLD_FL030_WildBoarHunt.description: 在每个偶数回合的资源补充阶段，在猪市场积累行动格上额外补充1只猪。每回合中，其他玩家只能通过第1位家庭成员使用猪市场积累行动格

OLD_FL061_BlacklegChicken.name: 布拉克尔鸡
OLD_FL061_BlacklegChicken.description: 把花费的2份食物放在此卡上。每个丰收时节开始时，如果此卡上有至少2份食物，则1份食物。你可以在任意时刻使用此卡上的食物，游戏结束时，如果此卡上有至少4份食物，则你获得2分乞援信

OLD_FR001_AbandonedWillow.name: 遗弃的柳树
OLD_FR001_AbandonedWillow.description: 立即移除一块空田并获得4木(保持田相邻)使用后请将此卡交给下家，此卡将加入他的手牌。

OLD_FR002_Absinthe.name: 苦艾酒
OLD_FR002_Absinthe.description: 在接下来的5个回合行动格上各放置1份食物，这些回合开始时，你将这份食物放到任意一个行动格上，第一个使用该格的玩家获得这份食物。

OLD_FR003_AmusementPark.name: 游乐园
OLD_FR003_AmusementPark.description: 如果你有1/2/3/4+个圈地，在接下来的2/3/4/5个回合行动格上各放置1份食物，这些回合开始时，你获得这份食物

OLD_FR004_AppleGarden.name: 苹果园
OLD_FR004_AppleGarden.description: 游戏结束时，如果你没有小麦或蔬菜，则你获得至多2分(仍会因为缺少此种作物而扣分)

OLD_FR005_ArtistsGarden.name: 艺术花园
OLD_FR005_ArtistsGarden.description: 在每回合的回家阶段，你可以对每块田进行一次收割

OLD_FR006_Badger.name: 獾
OLD_FR006_Badger.description: 立即在一个非额外行动格上放置一个标记，每回合开始时，你必须将此标记移动到一个正交相邻的行动格，任意玩家使用此行动格前获得1份食物

OLD_FR007_Baguette.name: 法式长面包
OLD_FR007_Baguette.description: 每个丰收时节的喂养阶段开始时，你可以支付1根木头执行一次“烤面包”行动

OLD_FR008_Barbershop.name: 理发店
OLD_FR008_Barbershop.description: 打出时获得等同于之后完整丰收时节数的分数

OLD_FR009_Bathroom.name: 浴室
OLD_FR009_Bathroom.description: 每当你把小麦或蔬菜转化为食物时，你可以将被转化的作物放到此卡上。每当你对田地板块进行播种时，可以额外拿取此卡上作物叠放到新播种的对应的田上

OLD_FR010_BreakfastOutdoors.name: 户外早餐
OLD_FR010_BreakfastOutdoors.description: 在每个丰收时节的喂养阶段，你获得1份食物

OLD_FR011_Brickyard.name: 砖厂
OLD_FR011_Brickyard.description: 每回合开始前，如果你的个人供应区里没有砖头，则在此卡上补充1砖，每当此卡上有至少4块砖，你获得这些砖，你不能无故弃掉砖头。

OLD_FR012_Camembert.name: 法式奶酪
OLD_FR012_Camembert.description: 在3个你选择的不同行动格上各放置1份食物，下一个使用这些行动格的玩家获得这份食物

OLD_FR013_Chameleon.name: 变色龙
OLD_FR013_Chameleon.description: 打出时获得1只猪。你可以在每个饲养羊的圈地里饲养至多1只猪(总容量不变)卡牌提供的圈地玉米垛

OLD_FR014_Chocolade.name: 巧克力
OLD_FR014_Chocolade.description: 从游戏供应区拿取4份食物放到此卡上，你在支付职业培训费时可以使用此卡上的食物

OLD_FR015_CoeeBreak.name: 茶歇
OLD_FR015_CoeeBreak.description: 在此卡上放置5食物，每回合开始时，你获得1份食物。当你打出职业卡时，移除之后未获得的食物

OLD_FR016_Cornrick.name: 玉米垛
OLD_FR016_Cornrick.description: 在第7和9回合的行动格上各放置1份小麦，这些回合开始时，你获得这份小麦

OLD_FR017_Diary.name: 日记本
OLD_FR017_Diary.description: 每当你打出1张职业卡时，你额外获得1根木头。如果打出某张职业卡时同时打出此卡，可获得此木头。

OLD_FR018_EncirclingWall.name: 环绕围墙
OLD_FR018_EncirclingWall.description: 打出时你可以将你农场里的一格免费围成圈地(需遵循圈地规则，算作一次“围栅栏”行动)。

OLD_FR019_EveningPrayer.name: 晚祷
OLD_FR019_EveningPrayer.description: 如果你有1/2个田地板块，则立即支付1/2份食物作为技能培训费打出1/2张职业卡

OLD_FR020_FiveRings.name: 五环
OLD_FR020_FiveRings.description: 如果你打出此卡时将木头/石头放在五环上，则你打出每张发展卡的费用减少1根木头/1个石头

OLD_FR021_FlatHill.name: 平坦小山
OLD_FR021_FlatHill.description: 免费将你的木屋翻修成砖屋包括卡牌田。

OLD_FR022_FullbottomedWig.name: 法式假发
OLD_FR022_FullbottomedWig.description: 你翻修时不需支付芦苇

OLD_FR023_Goblet.name: 高脚杯
OLD_FR023_Goblet.description: 对你而言，A10水井是次要发展卡。你打出井时改为在之后5回合各放置2份食物

OLD_FR024_GoldenRose.name: 金玫瑰
OLD_FR024_GoldenRose.description: 你支付职业培训费/打次发时可以少支付至多2份食物包括职业卡的额外花费

OLD_FR025_GrainMillOven.name: 麦磨烤炉
OLD_FR025_GrainMillOven.description: 打出时获得1次“烤面包”行动。砖造烤炉和石造烤炉对你而言是次发，下次你打出烤炉时可以弃掉此卡来免费打出。此卡不属于烤炉。

OLD_FR026_Grotto.name: 石窟
OLD_FR026_Grotto.description: 从游戏公用区放置3块砖头+2个石头在此卡上。每回合结束时，你可以支付2份食物获得此卡上的1个资源。此卡上没有资源时，此卡可以容纳一名家庭成员。

OLD_FR027_GroundPickaxePlow.name: 界镐犁
OLD_FR027_GroundPickaxePlow.description: 限1次：当你使用犁田/粮食耕种[犁播]行动格时，你可以从你的供应区拿取木头，放在1/2个与该行动格正交相邻的行动格上各1个，然后额外犁1/2块田。

OLD_FR028_Hammock.name: 吊床
OLD_FR028_Hammock.description: 你的至多一间房屋可以额外容纳一名家庭成员。

OLD_FR029_HayRake.name: 干草耙
OLD_FR029_HayRake.description: 每个工作阶段，你的第三位家庭成员可以使用犁田行动格，即使该格已被占用。自己的家庭成员/对手

OLD_FR030_Haystack.name: 干草堆
OLD_FR030_Haystack.description: 在接下来的3个回合行动格上各放置1份食物，这些回合开始时，你获得这份食物卡牌动物怎么算呢

OLD_FR031_Heatwave.name: 热浪
OLD_FR031_Heatwave.description: 免费打出火炉或将火炉升级成壁炉使用后请将此卡交给下家，此卡将加入他的手牌。

OLD_FR032_Homework.name: 家庭作业
OLD_FR032_Homework.description: 立即免费打出两张职业卡。仍需要额外支付职业卡效果的花费灯塔

OLD_FR033_KidsCorner.name: 儿童天地
OLD_FR033_KidsCorner.description: 你的房间可以额外容纳1只任意动物。任意类型的动物

OLD_FR034_KitchenTable.name: 厨房餐桌
OLD_FR034_KitchenTable.description: 对你而言，“烤面包”行动变成“烤面包/支付1份食物到此卡”行动。任意时刻，你可以弃掉此卡上的1份食物来执行一次“烤面包”行动

OLD_FR035_Lighthouse.name: 灯塔
OLD_FR035_Lighthouse.description: 此卡可容纳一名家庭成员

OLD_FR036_March.name: 三月
OLD_FR036_March.description: 打出时你可以支付2只不同动物并犁2块田

OLD_FR037_Necklace.name: 项链
OLD_FR037_Necklace.description: 每个工作阶段结束时，如果你占用了两个正交相邻的行动格（大小相同，则你获得1份食物

OLD_FR038_Orchard.name: 果园
OLD_FR038_Orchard.description: 计算的已播种的田的数量，在之后等同于此数的回合行动格上各放置1份食物。这些回合开始时，你获得对应食物

OLD_FR039_ParForceHunting.name: 骑马狩猎
OLD_FR039_ParForceHunting.description: 当前回合数加4和7，在对应回合行动格上各放置1只猪，这些回合开始时，你可以支付1份食物获得对应的猪。

OLD_FR040_ParkCemetary.name: 公墓
OLD_FR040_ParkCemetary.description: 从游戏供应区拿取3个石头，放到犁田行动格上，使用此格的玩家可以拿走1个石头。如果石头被拿光，你可以犁一块田

OLD_FR042_RockPyramid.name: 山洲
OLD_FR042_RockPyramid.description: 你每扩建1间石屋，你可以犁1块田，如果你在扩建石屋时实际支付了至少1个石头，则改为2块田

OLD_FR043_Sofa.name: 沙发
OLD_FR043_Sofa.description: 游戏结束时，如果你有至多2/3间房子，你获得4/2分

OLD_FR044_StarClassicationMeal.name: 星级料理
OLD_FR044_StarClassicationMeal.description: 在之后的回合行动格上各放置1份<FOOD>，这些回合开始时，你获得这份<FOOD>

OLD_FR045_StoneHouseReconstruction.name: 重建石屋
OLD_FR045_StoneHouseReconstruction.description: 你可以在任意时刻将你的砖屋翻修成石屋(正常支付)

OLD_FR046_StrawThatchedHut.name: 茅草小屋
OLD_FR046_StrawThatchedHut.description: 你扩建砖屋的费用可以改为2砖+1小麦+1食物勒阿佛尔港

OLD_FR047_SundaySchool.name: 周日学校
OLD_FR047_SundaySchool.description: 在下一回合放置1个箭头指示物，在该回合你少派遣一名家庭成员，并在回合结束时免费打两张职业卡使用后请将此卡交给下家，此卡将加入他的手牌。

OLD_FR048_SwimmingStudio.name: 游泳工作室
OLD_FR048_SwimmingStudio.description: 每当你执行钓鱼积累行动格时，你可以将至多1根木头转化为3份食物。如果你执行钓鱼积累行动格打出此卡，则可以发动此效果。

OLD_FR049_ThePortLeHavre.name: 勒阿佛尔港
OLD_FR049_ThePortLeHavre.description: 每当你执行“烤面包”行动时，你可以将至多2块砖头转化为等量石头

OLD_FR050_ThreshingMachinePlow.name: 打谷犁
OLD_FR050_ThreshingMachinePlow.description: 限1次：当你使用犁田行动格时，可以改为将你农场中心的3格犁成田(中心3格位置如图)

OLD_FR051_Timetable.name: 时间表
OLD_FR051_Timetable.description: 从游戏供应区拿取4种建筑资源各1个放到此卡上，你打次发时可以使用此卡上的资源来支付费用

OLD_FR052_TreesfortheCitizens.name: 公有树林
OLD_FR052_TreesfortheCitizens.description: 如果你有A7家具工坊/K122大家具工坊，则打出此卡时你无需支付木头。游戏结束时，每2张费用包含木头的发展卡使你获得1分

OLD_FR053_TriptotheLake.name: 散步湖畔
OLD_FR053_TriptotheLake.description: 每当你使用钓鱼积累行动格时，你额外获得1根木头+1份食物

OLD_FR054_TuileriesGarden.name: 杜乐丽花园
OLD_FR054_TuileriesGarden.description: 每当你使用犁田行动格时，你可以获得1份小麦/蔬菜并将其播种

OLD_FR055_VegetableHarvest.name: 丰收菜园
OLD_FR055_VegetableHarvest.description: 如果你有烤炉，你可以随时将1份蔬菜转化为4份食物

OLD_FR056_WateringCan.name: 洒水壶
OLD_FR056_WateringCan.description: 立即在你所有已播种的田上额外放置1份对应作物麦子/蔬菜有效使用后请将此卡交给下家，此卡将加入他的手牌。

OLD_FR057_WildGame.name: 野味
OLD_FR057_WildGame.description: 获得5份食物使用后请将此卡交给下家，此卡将加入他的手牌。

OLD_FR058_WinterDeadwood.name: 冬季朽木
OLD_FR058_WinterDeadwood.description: 选择一项：支付1根木头获得1分；或获得1根木头并将此卡传递给下家

OLD_FR059_WitchesDanceGround.name: 女巫领域
OLD_FR059_WitchesDanceGround.description: 你选择一项：将2个相邻的空格(用此卡代替)拼接在你的农场边缘作为你的新空地，并获得1分；或移除你农场中2个相邻的空格(用此卡盖住)，不再视作你农场的一部分

OLD_FR060_WoodSaw.name: 木锯
OLD_FR060_WoodSaw.description: 每当所有其他玩家的家庭成员都比你多时，你可以在任意时刻执行1次“建造房屋”行动

OLD_G061_Almanac.name: 历书
OLD_G061_Almanac.description: 立即执行1次收割阶段和繁殖阶段使用后请将此卡交给下家，此卡将加入他的手牌。

OLD_G062_AnimalFarm.name: 动物农场
OLD_G062_AnimalFarm.description: 每回合限1次：那你可以支付1只任意动物获得1个食客，你可以在本回合中派遣该食客，回合结束退还至游戏供应区。

OLD_G063_BakingField.name: 烘焙田
OLD_G063_BakingField.description: 你可以在此卡上播种小麦，此卡上收割的小麦必须立刻通过“烤面包”行动转化成食物。

OLD_G064_BarteringHut.name: 交易小屋
OLD_G064_BarteringHut.description: 打出时你可以购买至多2只任意动物。羊/猪/牛分别花费2/3/4个建筑资源使用后请将此卡交给下家，此卡将加入他的手牌。

OLD_G065_BeehiveOven.name: 蜂窝烤炉
OLD_G065_BeehiveOven.description: 打出时你获得一次“烤面包”行动。你执行“烤面包”行动时可以使用此卡将至多1份小麦转换成4份食物，当你在“烤面包”行动中不使用此卡时，你额外获得1份食物

OLD_G066_Birthstone.name: 诞生石
OLD_G066_Birthstone.description: 每次你执行“生娃”行动时，你可以支付1石头获得1分。如果你在打出此卡的回合执行过“生娃”行动，你也可以支付1石头获得1分

OLD_G067_BountifulHarvest.name: 丰收
OLD_G067_BountifulHarvest.description: 在每个丰收时节，如果你收割了至少2个资源且繁殖了至少1只动物，从游戏供应区拿取1份食物放在此卡上，任何时候你可以使用此卡上的食物。游戏结束时，此卡上的每份食物使你获得1分

OLD_G068_Chronicle.name: 编年史
OLD_G068_Chronicle.description: 在每个未打出的主要发展卡上各放置1份食物，当这些主要发展卡被打出时，你获得上面对应的食物。

OLD_G069_ClearCutting.name: 皆伐
OLD_G069_ClearCutting.description: 你每犁一块田就获得1根木头。卡牌田不算。

OLD_G070_Corral.name: 畜栏
OLD_G070_Corral.description: 你的每个与房屋正交相邻的空田可以容纳2只同种动物。游戏结束时，每个如此饲养有动物的空田额外获得1分。

OLD_G071_CowBell.name: 牛铃
OLD_G071_CowBell.description: 你可以在你未使用的每个空格上饲养至多2只牛，如此饲养的牛不能超过4只。(空地仍视作未使用)

OLD_G072_Dunghill.name: 粪肥
OLD_G072_Dunghill.description: 在作物收割阶段，如果你有2/3种动物，则你可以在1/2块已播种的田地上添加一份对应资源

OLD_G073_ErrantOven.name: 移动烤炉
OLD_G073_ErrantOven.description: 立即获得1次“烤面包”行动。使用后请将此卡交给下家，此卡将加入他的手牌。

OLD_G074_ExtraEort.name: 额外努力
OLD_G074_ExtraEort.description: 打出时你可以打出一张主要发展卡(正常支付)使用后请将此卡交给下家，此卡将加入他的手牌。

OLD_G075_FarmersMarket.name: 农夫市场
OLD_G075_FarmersMarket.description: 打出时你获得1个蔬菜使用后请将此卡交给下家，此卡将加入他的手牌。

OLD_G076_GardeningTools.name: 花园工具
OLD_G076_GardeningTools.description: 每当其他玩家执行“播种”行动时，你可以支付1份食物到游戏供应区并执行一次“播种”行动

OLD_G077_Gimlet.name: 手钻
OLD_G077_Gimlet.description: 你建造的每间木屋/砖屋/石屋费用减少1木/砖/石头。每个轮次中，你建造的每个马厩费用减少1木，总花费至多减少2木

OLD_G078_GrainMarket.name: 小麦市场
OLD_G078_GrainMarket.description: 每次你收割了至少1个小麦后，你可以将1个小麦换成1个蔬菜打出条件麦田包括卡牌田

OLD_G079_Hammer.name: 锤子
OLD_G079_Hammer.description: 打出时你必须向其他每个至少建造了1个栅栏的玩家支付1木头，然后获得一次“围栅栏”行动使用后请将此卡交给下家，此卡将加入他的手牌。

OLD_G080_HarvestFeast.name: 秋收盛宴
OLD_G080_HarvestFeast.description: 打出时，所有人家都可以将各自田地里的任意数量作物移入各自的个人供应区(不算作收割阶段)

OLD_G081_Hayloft.name: 草棚
OLD_G081_Hayloft.description: 游戏结束时，如果你有3/4个马厩，则你获得1/2分

OLD_G082_HiredHelpers.name: 雇佣助手
OLD_G082_HiredHelpers.description: 每回合中，你可以选择获得1名食客并在回合结束时退还，若如此做，下一回合你必须少放置1名家庭成员。

OLD_G083_HolidayPresent.name: 节日礼物
OLD_G083_HolidayPresent.description: 选择立即弃掉1张乞讨卡，或立即获得1只动物。使用后请将此卡交给下家，此卡将加入他的手牌。

OLD_G084_HorseBarn.name: 马棚
OLD_G084_HorseBarn.description: 当你播种时，与一个马厩相邻的田地里可以多堆放一份农作物，与两个或更多的马厩相邻的田地可以多堆放两份农作物。(无论此马厩是否被围起来，以及是否还有原来的的功能)

OLD_G085_IrrigationCanal.name: 灌溉渠
OLD_G085_IrrigationCanal.description: 当你犁田时，若新犁的田地旁边邻接着一块已播种的田，你可以从已播种的那块田上拿下一份作物播种到新犁的田上。新播种的田比起正常播种要少堆放一份作物肉馅饼

OLD_G086_ItinerantLaborers.name: 流动雇工
OLD_G086_ItinerantLaborers.description: 打出时获得一次“播种”行动使用后请将此卡交给下家，此卡将加入他的手牌。

OLD_G087_MagicBeans.name: 魔法豌豆
OLD_G087_MagicBeans.description: 立即获得2份蔬菜使用后请将此卡交给下家，此卡将加入他的手牌。

OLD_G088_MeatPie.name: 肉馅饼
OLD_G088_MeatPie.description: 打出时你获得一次"烤面包"行动。每次你执行完"烤面包"行动后，你可以支付1份小麦+1只任意动物获得3分

OLD_G089_MigrantWorkers.name: 流动工人
OLD_G089_MigrantWorkers.description: 每次你使用临时工行动格后，你可以支付1份食物来犁一块田

OLD_G090_Paddocks.name: 草地围栏
OLD_G090_Paddocks.description: 立即在已有的圈地内部免费建造4根栅栏使用后请将此卡交给下家，此卡将加入他的手牌。

OLD_G091_PeltRoof.name: 毛皮屋顶
OLD_G091_PeltRoof.description: 你每将2羊/1猪/1牛转换成食物时，从游戏供应区拿取1芦苇放在此卡上，你在扩建/翻修房屋时可以使用此卡上的芦苇

OLD_G092_PineForest.name: 松树林
OLD_G092_PineForest.description: 每回合开始时，如果你没有木头，在此卡上补充1木头。当此卡上有5根木头时，将这些木头移入你的个人供应区。(你不能丢弃你的木头)

OLD_G093_PlentifulFields.name: 富产之地
OLD_G093_PlentifulFields.description: 打出时你每有一个田地版块就获得1份食物使用后请将此卡交给下家，此卡将加入他的手牌。

OLD_G094_PottersWheel.name: 陶艺轮车
OLD_G094_PottersWheel.description: 打出1张职业(支付此卡玩家1份食物)。这张牌是一个所有玩家共用的额外行动格。使用此卡的玩家...

OLD_G095_PrivateMarket.name: 私立市场
OLD_G095_PrivateMarket.description: 每回合限1次：你可以支付2份食物购买任意一个建筑资源

OLD_G096_PrivateSchool.name: 私立学校
OLD_G096_PrivateSchool.description: 打出1张职业(支付此卡玩家1份食物)这张牌是一个所有玩家共用的额外行动格。使用此卡的玩家必须支付你1份食物来打出一张职业卡

OLD_G097_Pulley.name: 滑轮
OLD_G097_Pulley.description: 每当你使用临时工行动格时，你可以建造至多1个房间(正常支付费用)

OLD_G098_PumpkinPie.name: 南瓜馅饼
OLD_G098_PumpkinPie.description: 打出时你获得一次“烤面包”行动。每次你执行完“烤面包”行动后，你可以支付1份小麦+1份蔬菜来获得3分

OLD_G099_ReedBeds.name: 芦苇河床
OLD_G099_ReedBeds.description: 每次你使用犁田行动格时，你额外获得1捆芦苇

OLD_G100_ReedSale.name: 芦苇甩卖
OLD_G100_ReedSale.description: 打出时你获得3份食物使用后请将此卡交给下家，此卡将加入他的手牌。

OLD_G101_Remodeling.name: 木屋改建
OLD_G101_Remodeling.description: 打出时你必须将农场中的一个马厩退还到个人供应区，然后免费扩建1间木屋使用后请将此卡交给下家，此卡将加入他的手牌。

OLD_G102_SausageGrinder.name: 香肠研磨机
OLD_G102_SausageGrinder.description: 每当你把动物转换成食物时，每只被转换的动物都使你额外获得1份食物对于哪些次发适用

OLD_G103_Scythe.name: 长柄镰刀
OLD_G103_Scythe.description: 你可以在已播种的田上播种同种资源，将新的资源叠放在原有每一列资源的上面。

OLD_G104_SeasonalPlants.name: 季节性作物
OLD_G104_SeasonalPlants.description: 每当你在偶数回合执行“播种”行动时，在你刚播种的田上额外放置一份对应的资源

OLD_G105_SeedSpreader.name: 种子撒布机
OLD_G105_SeedSpreader.description: 每当你使用犁田行动格后，你可以播种1份小麦或1份蔬菜

OLD_G106_SharedWall.name: 共享墙壁
OLD_G106_SharedWall.description: 你的房屋成为圈地的天然边界，你不能将你的房屋扩建到以此法围起的圈地中。你仍然可以建造15根栅栏

OLD_G107_SheepMarket.name: 羊市场
OLD_G107_SheepMarket.description: 每个丰收时节开始时，你可以把至多1个小麦或1个蔬菜换成1只羊，或者把至多1只羊换成1个小麦或1个蔬菜

OLD_G108_Sheepdog.name: 牧羊犬
OLD_G108_Sheepdog.description: 你可以在每个农场的空格上饲养至多2只羊(空格仍视作未使用)，你的家里只能饲养羊。每个喂养阶段，你需要为牧羊犬额外支付1份食物，否则领取1张乞讨卡

OLD_G109_SheepskinRug.name: 羊皮地毯
OLD_G109_SheepskinRug.description: 游戏结束时，如果你有火炉，则你获得2分

OLD_G110_Shovel.name: 铁锹
OLD_G110_Shovel.description: 每当你使用临时工行动格后，你可以执行一次“播种”行动

OLD_G111_Sickle.name: 镰刀
OLD_G111_Sickle.description: 游戏结束时，如果你至少有5个田地版块、8个小麦和4个蔬菜(包括田上的作物)，则你获得3分

OLD_G112_StoneCrane.name: 石头吊车
OLD_G112_StoneCrane.description: 其他玩家每扩建1间房间/翻修时，你可以扩建1间房间/翻修，而且对于每间房和每次翻修你可以减少一个任意资源花费

OLD_G114_StonecuttersHall.name: 石器工坊
OLD_G114_StonecuttersHall.description: 每个丰收时节，你可以使用此卡将至多1个石头转化为3份食物。游戏结束时，若你有2/4/5个石头，则你获得1/2/3分

OLD_G115_FishFarm.name: 养鱼场
OLD_G115_FishFarm.description: 每当其他玩家使用钓鱼积累行动格时，你可以从每块已播种的地上收割一个作物(这不算作收割阶段)

OLD_G116_TreeHouse.name: 树屋
OLD_G116_TreeHouse.description: 当你不住木屋，你的其中一个房间能额外容纳一名家庭成员。

OLD_G117_VegetableScoop.name: 蔬菜勺
OLD_G117_VegetableScoop.description: 每当你使用蔬菜种子行动格时，你额外获得1个蔬菜

OLD_G118_WinterGarden.name: 冬季花园
OLD_G118_WinterGarden.description: 你可以在至多一个房间上播种并收割作物。当你家中有动物时，需要将房间上的作物全部弃掉。在第6、8、10、12回合结束时，你可以收割一次房间上的作物。

OLD_G119_WoodenBridge.name: 木桥
OLD_G119_WoodenBridge.description: 每当你使用芦苇滩积累行动格时，你额外获得1份食物。每当你使用临时工行动格时，你额外获得1芦苇

OLD_I100_Tavern.name: 酒馆
OLD_I100_Tavern.description: +（+ ）此卡是所有玩家都能使用的额外行动格。其他玩家使用时获得3份食物，你使用时获得3份食物/2分。

OLD_I101_AnimalFeed.name: 畜食槽
OLD_I101_AnimalFeed.description: 计分阶段前，你每拥有1种动物就额外获得1只该种动物。(I101畜食槽可在E215动物租用人之前发动）（需要饲养空间，不能转化为食物)此卡牌打出条件"已播种田×4"包括卡牌田。

OLD_I102_WildlifeReserve.name: 野生保护区
OLD_I102_WildlifeReserve.description: 你可以在此卡上饲养至多1只羊+1只猪+1只牛。(可被E29兽角笛和E59饮水槽扩充容量)

OLD_I103_WaterMill.name: 水磨坊
OLD_I103_WaterMill.description: 每个丰收时节的收割阶段后，所有玩家都可以使用此卡将至多1份小麦转化为3份食物。（这不是“烤面包”行动）其他玩家如此做之后必须支付给你1份食物。可触发I103水磨坊效果：I92肥料、FR005艺术花园、G061历书、G118冬季花园、NL047早熟麦。不可触发I103水磨坊效果：NL104小麦收割工、G080秋收盛宴、G115养鱼场、WM014轮耕农。

OLD_I104_WeeklyMarket.name: 周末市场
OLD_I104_WeeklyMarket.description: 立即获得2份蔬菜。使用后请将此卡交给下家，此卡将加入他的手牌。

OLD_I337_ClayDeposit.name: 黏土矿床
OLD_I337_ClayDeposit.description: （+ ）此卡是所有玩家都能使用的额外行动格。其他玩家使用时必须先支付给你1份食物，然后获得5个砖头。你使用时获得5个砖头/2分。

OLD_I63_MoldboardPlough.name: 铧式犁
OLD_I63_MoldboardPlough.description: 在此卡上放2个田地板块。限2次：每当你使用犁田行动格时，你可以使用此卡上1块田，改为犁2块田。每次使用犁田/粮食耕种[犁播]行动格时，只能使用1个犁/I68耙的效果。

OLD_I64_Alms.name: 救济品
OLD_I64_Alms.description: 立即获得与已过完整回合数相等的食物。使用后请将此卡交给下家，此卡将加入他的手牌。

OLD_I65_BakersKitchen.name: 烘焙厨房
OLD_I65_BakersKitchen.description: 打出此卡时，你获得1次“烤面包”行动。每次你执行“烤面包”行动时，你可以将至多2份小麦各转换成5份食物。

OLD_I66_VillageWell.name: 村中水井
OLD_I66_VillageWell.description: 打出此卡时，在之后的3个回合行动格上各放1份食物。这些回合开始时，你获得对应的食物。井：A10水井、I66村中水井、WM062后院水井、WA019绵羊井、WA020人工水井、NL042提水井。（本卡牌可算作1张次发/1张主发，但只算作1张发展卡。例：FR014巧克力、G004学徒工）草莓园

OLD_I67_ThreshingBoard.name: 打谷板
OLD_I67_ThreshingBoard.description: 每当你使用犁田/粮食耕种[犁播]行动格时，可以获得1次“烤面包”行动。

OLD_I68_Harrow.name: 耙
OLD_I68_Harrow.description: 限1次：每当你使用犁田/粮食耕种[犁播]行动格时，可改为犁2块田。其他玩家可以支付给你2份食物使用此卡1次。每次使用犁田/粮食耕种[犁播]行动格时，只能使用1个犁/I68耙的效果。

OLD_I69_StrawberryPatch.name: 草莓园
OLD_I69_StrawberryPatch.description: 打出此卡时，在之后的3个回合行动格上各放1份食物。这些回合开始时，你获得对应的食物。此卡牌打出条件“菜田×2”包括卡牌田。

OLD_I70_Punner.name: 夯具
OLD_I70_Punner.description: 每当其他玩家使用犁或I68耙时，你可以犁1块田。
