OLD_I71_HolidayHouse.name: 度假屋
OLD_I71_HolidayHouse.description: 此卡只能在第13回合/之前打出。在第14回合，你不能派遣任何家庭成员(包括食客)。（准备好连续两次进行丰收时节，即第5次和第6次丰收）

OLD_I72_GoosePond.name: 鹅塘
OLD_I72_GoosePond.description: 打出此卡后，在之后的4个回合行动格上各放1份食物。这些回合开始时，你获得对应的食物。

OLD_I73_Guest.name: 客人
OLD_I73_Guest.description: 立即获得1名食客。该食客可以在下回合派遣，回合结束时退还。使用后请将此卡交给下家，此卡将加入他的手牌。

OLD_I74_GrainCart.name: 小麦推车
OLD_I74_GrainCart.description: 每当你使用小麦种子行动格时，额外获得2份小麦。

OLD_I75_HandMill.name: 手磨机
OLD_I75_HandMill.description: 每个丰收时节的喂养阶段，你可以将至多2份小麦各转化为2份食物。（这不算作“烤面包”行动）

OLD_I76_Rake.name: 钉耙
OLD_I76_Rake.description: 游戏结束时，如果你有至少5个田地板块，则你获得2分。如果你有I68耙、I70夯具、K124轭具或犁，则需要至少6个田地板块。

OLD_I77_ShepherdsCrook.name: 牧羊杖
OLD_I77_ShepherdsCrook.description: 每当你用栅栏围出1个占据不小于4个农场格子的圈地时，你立即获得2只羊。

OLD_I78_Copse.name: 木头地
OLD_I78_Copse.description: 你可以在此卡上播种2列木头。木头的播种和收割遵循小麦的一般规则。播种后视为2个已播种田地。(卡牌田)此卡上未收割的木头不算作你的资源，不参与计算任何职业卡和发展卡分数。

OLD_I79_WoodCart.name: 木头推车
OLD_I79_WoodCart.description: 每当你从行动格上获得木头时，额外获得2根木头。（5人局版图“芦+石+木”和通过卡牌获得的木头不算）

OLD_I80_Spinney.name: 灌木丛
OLD_I80_Spinney.description: 每当其他玩家使用森林[3木]行动格时，他必须给你1根木头。

OLD_I81_WoodenHutExtension.name: 扩建木屋
OLD_I81_WoodenHutExtension.description: 立即免费扩建1间木屋。使用后请将此卡交给下家，此卡将加入他的手牌。

OLD_I82_WoodenCrane.name: 木吊车
OLD_I82_WoodenCrane.description: 每当你使用石头积累行动格时，可以支付0/1份食物额外获得1/2个石头。

OLD_I83_WoodenPath.name: 木板路
OLD_I83_WoodenPath.description: 游戏结束时，拥有最有价值道路的玩家获得2分。(I94石板路>I89砖头路>I83木板路)

OLD_I84_ChickenCoop.name: 鸡舍
OLD_I84_ChickenCoop.description: 打出此卡时，在之后的8个回合行动格上各放1份食物。这些回合开始时，你获得对应的食物。

OLD_I86_CornStorehouse.name: 谷仓
OLD_I86_CornStorehouse.description: 每个丰收时节的收割阶段后，你可以在你的空田上播种小麦，如此播种时每列小麦少放置1份小麦。可触发I86谷仓效果：I92肥料、FR005艺术花园、G061历书、G118冬季花园、NL047早熟麦。不可触发I86谷仓效果：G115养鱼场、G080秋收盛宴、WM014轮耕农、NL104小麦收割工。

OLD_I87_Flagon.name: 大酒壶
OLD_I87_Flagon.description: 打出此卡时，场上每打出了1个井，你立即获得4份食物，其他每位玩家各获得1份食物。之后的游戏中，任意玩家每打出1个井，你立即获得4份食物，其他每位玩家各获得1份食物。井：A10水井、I66村中水井、WM062后院水井、WA019绵羊井、WA020人工水井、NL042提水井。

OLD_I88_Lasso.name: 套索
OLD_I88_Lasso.description: 轮到你行动时，你可以连续派遣2名家庭成员，只要这2名家庭成员中至少有1人使用了羊市场/猪市场/牛市场积累行动格。

OLD_I89_ClayPath.name: 砖头路
OLD_I89_ClayPath.description: 游戏结束时，拥有最有价值道路的玩家获得2分。(I94石板路>I89砖头路>I83木板路)

OLD_I90_PlanterBox.name: 播种筒
OLD_I90_PlanterBox.description: 每当你播种时，如果播种的田地板块与你的房屋板块正交相邻，每列小麦必须额外放置2份小麦，每列蔬菜必须额外放置1份蔬菜。

OLD_I91_Ladder.name: 梯子
OLD_I91_Ladder.description: 扩建每间房屋、翻修房屋和打出以下发展卡所需费用都减少1捆芦苇。E21半木梁房、I71度假屋、I84鸡舍、I86谷仓、I103水磨坊、K144豪宅。

OLD_I92_Manure.name: 肥料
OLD_I92_Manure.description: 每个不以丰收时节为结束的回合结束时，你可以执行1次丰收时节的收割行动。此“收割行动”可触发以下卡牌：I86谷仓、I103水磨坊(只能自用)、I226园丁。此卡牌打出条件“动物×2”不包括卡牌动物。

OLD_I93_MilkingShed.name: 挤奶棚
OLD_I93_MilkingShed.description: 每个丰收时节的收割阶段开始时，计算所有玩家农场中的羊和牛的总数，每有5只羊/3头牛，你额外获得1份食物。(卡牌提供的“收割阶段”不算，如：I92肥料)

OLD_I94_PavedRoad.name: 石板路
OLD_I94_PavedRoad.description: 游戏结束时，拥有最有价值道路的玩家获得2分。(I94石板路>I89砖头路>I83木板路)

OLD_I95_FishTrap.name: 鱼篓
OLD_I95_FishTrap.description: 每当你使用钓鱼积累行动格或从行动格上获得芦苇时，额外获得1份食物。

OLD_I96_ReedExchange.name: 芦苇交易
OLD_I96_ReedExchange.description: 立即获得2捆芦苇。使用后请将此卡交给下家，此卡将加入他的手牌。

OLD_I97_Slaughterhouse.name: 屠宰场
OLD_I97_Slaughterhouse.description: 每次其他玩家将至少1只动物转化为食物时，你获得1份食物。每个丰收时节的喂养阶段，你最后进行结算。K299屠宰工和I97屠宰场的拥有者按照正常(下1回合)顺序结算。

OLD_I98_SchnapsDistillery.name: 烈酒蒸馏器
OLD_I98_SchnapsDistillery.description: 每个喂养阶段，你可使用此卡将至多1份蔬菜转化为4份食物。游戏结束时，你的第5和第6份蔬菜各值1分。

OLD_I99_StrawthatchedRoof.name: 麦造屋顶
OLD_I99_StrawthatchedRoof.description: 从现在起，你建造房屋和翻修房屋时都不再需要芦苇了。此卡牌打出条件“麦田×3”包括卡牌田。

OLD_K105_Acreage.name: 一亩田
OLD_K105_Acreage.description: 每次播种时，你可以在此卡上播种至多2列小麦。(视作“2块麦田”)

OLD_K106_Bakehouse.name: 烘焙坊
OLD_K106_Bakehouse.description: 打出此卡时，你获得1次“烤面包”行动。每次你执行“烤面包”行动时，你可以将至多2份小麦各转换成5份食物。

OLD_K107_Lumber.name: 木料
OLD_K107_Lumber.description: 立即获得3根木头。使用后请将此卡交给下家，此卡将加入他的手牌。

OLD_K108_Beehive.name: 蜂巢
OLD_K108_Beehive.description: 打出此卡时，在之后的偶数回合行动格上各放1份食物。这些回合开始时，你获得对应的食物。

OLD_K109_SpitRoast.name: 烧烤叉
OLD_K109_SpitRoast.description: 每个丰收时节的喂养阶段，如果你将至少1只动物转化为食物，则你额外获得1份食物。

OLD_K110_Brewery.name: 酿酒厂
OLD_K110_Brewery.description: 每个丰收时节的喂养阶段，你可以使用此卡将至多1份小麦转化为3份食物。游戏结束时，你的第9份小麦额外获得1分。（田地里的小麦算作在内）

OLD_K111_BreadPaddle.name: 面包托铲
OLD_K111_BreadPaddle.description: 每当你打出1张职业卡后，额外获得1次“烤面包”行动。

OLD_K112_Bookshelf.name: 书架
OLD_K112_Bookshelf.description: 每当你打出1张职业卡前，首先获得3份食物。（在支付技能培训费之前）

OLD_K113_Flail.name: 连枷
OLD_K113_Flail.description: 每当你使用犁田/粮食耕种[犁播]行动格时，额外获得1次“烤面包”行动。

OLD_K114_DuckPond.name: 鸭塘
OLD_K114_DuckPond.description: 打出此卡时，在之后的3个回合行动格上各放1份食物。这些回合开始时，你获得对应的食物。

OLD_K115_SwingPlough.name: 摆杆步犁
OLD_K115_SwingPlough.description: 在此卡上放4个田地板块。限2次：每当你使用犁田行动格时，你可以使用此卡上2块田，改为犁3块田。每次使用犁田/粮食耕种[犁播]行动格时，只能使用1个犁/I68耙的效果。

OLD_K116_Granary.name: 粮仓
OLD_K116_Granary.description: 打出此卡时，在第8,10,12回合行动格上各放1份小麦。这些回合开始时，你获得对应的小麦。

OLD_K117_Greenhouse.name: 小型温室
OLD_K117_Greenhouse.description: 打出此卡时，将当前回合数加4和7，在对应回合行动格上各放1份蔬菜。这些回合开始时，你可支付1份食物，获得对应的蔬菜。

OLD_K118_LiquidManure.name: 水肥
OLD_K118_LiquidManure.description: 每当你执行"播种"行动时，在此次播种的田地上每列物品可以额外放置1份对应的物品。注：对任意播种资源和卡牌田有效。例：K278护林人、I78木头地、K105一亩田、Ö21葡萄园、WM104芦苇地此卡牌打出条件"动物×4"不包括卡牌动物。

OLD_K119_CrookedPlough.name: 钩状犁
OLD_K119_CrookedPlough.description: 在此卡上放2个田地板块。限1次：每当你使用犁田行动格时，你可以使用此卡上2块田，改为犁3块田。每次使用犁田/粮食耕种[犁播]行动格时，只能使用1个犁/I68耙的效果。

OLD_K120_HouseGoat.name: 家用山羊
OLD_K120_HouseGoat.description: 每个丰收时节的喂养阶段，你额外获得1份食物。无论如何，你的房子不能再容纳动物了。即使有卡牌允许你这样做，例：K306驯兽师。

OLD_K121_Sawhorse.name: 锯木架
OLD_K121_Sawhorse.description: 你的下1个马厩和第3、6、9、12、15根栅栏可以免费建造。（需满足围建栅栏的一般规则）

OLD_K122_Sawmill.name: 大家具工坊
OLD_K122_Sawmill.description: 每个丰收时节，你可以将至多1根木头转化为3份食物。游戏结束时，如果你有2/4/5+根木头，额外获得1/2/3分。(多余的木头不能再用于A7家具工坊的计分)（本卡牌可算作1张次发/1张主发，但只算作1张发展卡。

OLD_K123_WoodenStrongbox.name: 木制保险箱
OLD_K123_WoodenStrongbox.description: 游戏结束时，如果你有5/6+个房间板块，额外获得2/4分。

OLD_K124_Yoke.name: 轭具
OLD_K124_Yoke.description: 打出此卡时，场上每有1个犁或I68耙，你就能立即犁1块田。

OLD_K125_Broom.name: 扫帚
OLD_K125_Broom.description: 打出此卡时，立即弃掉你手中所有未打出的次要发展卡，从牌库中重新抽7张。然后你可以立即打出1张次要发展卡。(需满足条件并正常支付费用)

OLD_K126_LandingNet.name: 手网
OLD_K126_LandingNet.description: 每当你从行动格上获得芦苇时，额外获得2份食物。如果你从行动格上同时获得了其他建筑资源，则改为获得1份食物。

OLD_K127_Clapper.name: 响板
OLD_K127_Clapper.description: 每当你使用写有“生娃”行动的行动格时(或打出此卡时有家庭成员在其上)，在你的每个麦田上额外叠放1份小麦。（1）如果你使用五人局“技能培训/生娃“行动格执行“技能培训”行动，也可发动此效果。（从第5回合起）（2）对任意卡牌麦田有效。（3）对下列卡牌资源田有效：K278护林人、I78木头地、WM014芦苇地、NL048郁金香花田、Ö21葡萄园。

OLD_K128_CookingHearth.name: 壁炉
OLD_K128_CookingHearth.description: 任意时刻：“烤面包”行动：火炉：A1/A2火炉、E20简易火炉

OLD_K129_CornSheaf.name: 一捆小麦
OLD_K129_CornSheaf.description: 立即获得1份小麦。使用后请将此卡交给下家，此卡将加入他的手牌。

OLD_K130_HerbGarden.name: 药草园
OLD_K130_HerbGarden.description: 打出此卡时，在之后的5个回合行动格上各放1份食物。这些回合开始时，你获得对应的食物。此卡牌打出条件“菜田×1”包括卡牌田。

OLD_K131_ClayPit.name: 黏土坑
OLD_K131_ClayPit.description: 每当你使用临时工行动格时，额外获得3个砖头。

OLD_K132_ClayHutExtension.name: 扩建砖屋
OLD_K132_ClayHutExtension.description: 立即免费扩建1间砖屋。使用后请将此卡交给下家，此卡将加入他的手牌。

OLD_K133_MilkingStool.name: 挤奶凳
OLD_K133_MilkingStool.description: 每个丰收时节的收割阶段，若你有不少于1/3/5头牛，则你获得1/2/3份食物。游戏结束时，你每拥有2头牛便能额外获得1分。（卡牌提供的收割阶段不算）

OLD_K134_OxTeam.name: 公牛挽具
OLD_K134_OxTeam.description: 打出此卡时，计算剩余的完整回合数。你可以立即犁相等数量的田地板块，且至多3块。

OLD_K135_Horse.name: 马
OLD_K135_Horse.description: 游戏结束时，如果你缺少某1种动物，你可以获得2分。(仍然会因为没有该种动物扣分)（缺少多种动物，也只获得2分）

OLD_K136_BrushwoodRoof.name: 木造屋顶
OLD_K136_BrushwoodRoof.description: 每当你扩建/翻修时，对于每间房屋和每次翻修，你可以用至多2木代替等量的芦苇。

OLD_K137_TurnipField.name: 萝卜地
OLD_K137_TurnipField.description: 打出此卡时，你获得1次“播种”行动。此卡视为1块田地，但此卡只能种植蔬菜。

OLD_K138_ReedHut.name: 芦苇小屋
OLD_K138_ReedHut.description: 打出此卡时，如果你的个人供应区还有家庭成员，立即将1名个人供应区的家庭成员放在此卡上。可从本回合开始派遣此家庭成员。此家庭成员不算作你的家庭成员，需要喂养，可以通过其他家庭成员的“生娃”行动将其移入你个人农场的其他空间中。

OLD_K139_SleepingCorner.name: 卧室
OLD_K139_SleepingCorner.description: 即使已有其他1名玩家占据了写有“生娃”行动的行动格，你仍可使用此行动格。（1）你可占据五人局“技能培训/生娃“行动格，只执行”技能培训“行动（从第5回合起）。（2）被多名其他玩家占据，你不可以使用；被自己家庭成员占据，你不可以使用。（3）此卡牌打出条件“麦田×2”包括卡牌田。

OLD_K140_SwanLake.name: 天鹅湖
OLD_K140_SwanLake.description: 打出此卡时，在之后的5个回合行动格上各放1份食物。这些回合开始时，你获得对应的食物。

OLD_K141_BoarBreeding.name: 野猪
OLD_K141_BoarBreeding.description: 立即获得1头猪。使用后请将此卡交给下家，此卡将加入他的手牌。

OLD_K142_StoneCart.name: 石头推车
OLD_K142_StoneCart.description: 打出此卡时，在之后的偶数回合行动格上各放1个石头。这些回合开始时，你获得对应的石头。

OLD_K143_StoneExchange.name: 石头交易
OLD_K143_StoneExchange.description: 立即获得2个石头。使用后请将此卡交给下家，此卡将加入他的手牌。

OLD_K144_Mansion.name: 豪宅
OLD_K144_Mansion.description: 游戏结束时，你的每间石屋都额外获得2分。

OLD_K145_ForestPasture.name: 林间牧场
OLD_K145_ForestPasture.description: 此卡可以容纳任意数量的猪。

OLD_K146_Loom.name: 织布机
OLD_K146_Loom.description: 每个丰收时节的收割阶段，若你有不少于1/4/7只羊，则你获得1/2/3份食物。游戏结束时，你每拥有3只羊便能额外获得1分。（卡牌提供的收割阶段不算）

OLD_K339_Pelts.name: 毛皮
OLD_K339_Pelts.description: 每当你将动物转化成食物时，对于每只被转化的动物，你可支付1份食物（从个人供应区拿取）放置到你的1个房间板块上。每个房间板块至多放置1份这样的食物，食物不可再次被使用。游戏结束时，每有1个这样的食物你便额外获得1分。

OLD_NL001_DutchWindmill.name: 荷兰风车
OLD_NL001_DutchWindmill.description: 每当你在以丰收时节为结束的回合里执行了“烤面包”行动，你额外获得2份食物

OLD_NL002_Parlor.name: 起居室
OLD_NL002_Parlor.description: 立即免费将一间房屋换成石屋(你无需再翻修此屋子，其他屋子不变，不改变你所住房子的等级)

OLD_NL003_YearofDisaster.name: 灾荒之年
OLD_NL003_YearofDisaster.description: 在下次和下下次丰收时节之间的回合结束时，每位其他玩家必须支付1食物到游戏供应区或者扣1分

OLD_NL004_CheeseMarket.name: 起司市场
OLD_NL004_CheeseMarket.description: 在每个不以丰收时节为结束的回合开始时，羊为1分，牛为2分，以此计分总积分最高的玩家获得1份小麦。如果你和其他人平手，只有你获得小麦，其他玩家平手或所有人积分都为0，则没人得小麦卡牌羊 公羊 是否计算

OLD_NL005_Studio.name: 工作室
OLD_NL005_Studio.description: 每个喂养阶段，你可以使用此卡将至多1个资源转化成食物。每个木头/砖头能转换成2食物，每个石头能转换成3食物

OLD_NL006_Backyard.name: 后院
OLD_NL006_Backyard.description: 如果你的农场有2×2的空地且其中一个与房屋正交相邻，则这块空地可以容纳一名家庭成员。一旦其中一格被占用，你需要将该家庭成员移入空房间或个人供应区

OLD_NL007_Stage.name: 舞台
OLD_NL007_Stage.description: 每个工作阶段结束时，如果三个游戏版图都有你的家庭成员，则你额外获得1份食物。

OLD_NL008_WaterHouse.name: 水上小屋
OLD_NL008_WaterHouse.description: 每回合资源补充阶段，在钓鱼积累行动格上额外补充1份食物，其他玩家使用钓鱼积累行动格后必须支付你2份食物痰盂

OLD_NL009_JunkRoom.name: 杂物房
OLD_NL009_JunkRoom.description: 每当你打出1张发展卡（包括此卡）后，你获得1份食物你有小溪家庭成员

OLD_NL010_LoveLetter.name: 情书
OLD_NL010_LoveLetter.description: 如果你在当前回合数加1/2/3的回合中使用生儿育女行动格，你得到2/3/5份食物(标记打出时的回合)蚱蜢

OLD_NL011_Spittoon.name: 痰盂
OLD_NL011_Spittoon.description: 此卡只能在不以丰收时节为结束的回合打出。你可以从左边或右边的玩家处拿走2份食物，然后将此卡传给他。以丰收时节结束的回合：479111314壕沟家庭

OLD_NL012_Brook.name: 小溪
OLD_NL012_Brook.description: 每当你使用钓鱼积累行动格上方的森林[3木]、土矿[1砖]和芦苇滩积累行动格时，你都额外获得1份食物

OLD_NL013_GrasshopperBundles.name: 蚱蜢
OLD_NL013_GrasshopperBundles.description: 繁殖阶段时，如果你可以繁殖羊/猪/牛，且你刚好有0-3/4-7/8+份田地里的小麦，则你额外获得1只新生的羊/猪/牛。

OLD_NL014_Ditch.name: 壕沟
OLD_NL014_Ditch.description: 每当你犁一块田，你可以把蔬菜播种在两块直角相邻的田的交界处。

OLD_NL015_RowBoat.name: 划艇
OLD_NL015_RowBoat.description: 每当其他玩家使用钓鱼积累行动格时，你可以将你一位已派遣的家庭成员移动到钓鱼积累行动格并获得1食物(这不算使用钓鱼)

OLD_NL016_Caravan.name: 房车
OLD_NL016_Caravan.description: 此卡可以为1名家庭成员提供居住空间

OLD_NL017_MonasticVows.name: 修士誓言
OLD_NL017_MonasticVows.description: 每个工作阶段结束时，你可以获得1张乞讨卡+3食物+1名食客，你立即放置该食客然后将其退还。

OLD_NL018_FrontGarden.name: 前庭花园
OLD_NL018_FrontGarden.description: 游戏结束时，每个与房屋正交相邻或对角相邻的空地都使你获得1分(但仍会因为空地扣分)

OLD_NL019_MilkJug.name: 牛奶罐
OLD_NL019_MilkJug.description: 每当任意玩家（包括你）使用牛市场积累行动格时，你获得3份食物，而其他每位玩家各获得1份食物

OLD_NL020_BeachChair.name: 海滩椅
OLD_NL020_BeachChair.description: 每当其他玩家使用钓鱼积累行动格时，他们可以支付你1食物来获得1分

OLD_NL021_LargeGreenhouse.name: 大型温室
OLD_NL021_LargeGreenhouse.description: 将当前回合数加5,7,9，在这些回合的行动格上各放1份蔬菜，这些回合开始时，你获得这份蔬菜

OLD_NL022_Bookcase.name: 书柜
OLD_NL022_Bookcase.description: 每当你打出1个职业后，你额外获得1份蔬菜如果通过职业打出此卡，可以获得此蔬菜。

OLD_NL023_StoneBank.name: 石头银行
OLD_NL023_StoneBank.description: 每当你使用石头积累行动格时，你可以只拿1石头，并将这个石头放在此卡上。你打出发展卡时所需的石头数量减掉此卡上的石头数量

OLD_NL024_ParkBench.name: 公园长椅
OLD_NL024_ParkBench.description: 你下家(左手边玩家)选择一块1你的未使用空格，从游戏供应区拿取1木放在该格上，之后该格视为已使用且不能被用作其他用途

OLD_NL025_Reqplayinround4orbefore.name: 最低薪资
OLD_NL025_Reqplayinround4orbefore.description: 每回合限1次：当你没有食物时，你得到1份食物

OLD_NL026_GardenWood.name: 庭院木头
OLD_NL026_GardenWood.description: 每有一个与你房屋正交相邻的空地，你便获得1木头使用后请将此卡交给下家，此卡将加入他的手牌。丘陵宅院第2回合或

OLD_NL027_GrainSheaves.name: 麦捆
OLD_NL027_GrainSheaves.description: 每当你打出一张次发卡后(不包括此卡)，你获得1份小麦

OLD_NL028_CutWillows.name: 修剪柳树
OLD_NL028_CutWillows.description: 从游戏供应区拿2木到此卡上，每次你从积累行动格获得木头时，从游戏供应区此卡上增加1木。当你在一次行动（非卡牌效果支付）中需要花费至少1木时，可以用此卡上的1木支付

OLD_NL029_DwellingMound.name: 丘陵宅院
OLD_NL029_DwellingMound.description: 从现在起，无论使用何种方式，你每犁1块田之前，都必须先额外支付1份食物

OLD_NL030_DutchClaypipe.name: 陶制烟斗
OLD_NL030_DutchClaypipe.description: 在每回合的回家阶段，若你在当回合工作阶段获得了不少于7份建筑资源，则你获得2份食物

OLD_NL031_VegetableGarden.name: 蔬菜园
OLD_NL031_VegetableGarden.description: 打出此卡时，将2个蔬菜叠放在此卡上，收割完后你可以在此卡上种蔬菜(此卡不视为农田)

OLD_NL032_WoodenShoes.name: 木鞋
OLD_NL032_WoodenShoes.description: 每当你使用第1至第4回合的行动格时，你可以先翻开下一回合的行动卡，且本回合只有你能使用。

OLD_NL033_HerringPot.name: 烹鱼锅
OLD_NL033_HerringPot.description: 每当你使用钓鱼积累行动格时，在之后3个回合的行动格上各放1份食物，在这些回合开始时，你获得这份食物

OLD_NL034_GoldenEarring.name: 金色耳环
OLD_NL034_GoldenEarring.description: 每一回合中，你可以将你的第2位家庭成员放置在此卡上，并从游戏供应区拿取1小麦放在此卡上。游戏结束时，若此卡上有2份小麦，则你获得7分。拱门罂粟花田未使用空

OLD_NL035_WoodenGable.name: 木造三角墙
OLD_NL035_WoodenGable.description: 游戏结束时，如果你的每间房屋都刚好住位家庭成员，则你获得3分

OLD_NL036_SingleSidedPlow.name: 单面犁
OLD_NL036_SingleSidedPlow.description: 放置1块田在此卡上，每当你使用犁田行动格时，你可以用此卡上的田地来额外犁1块田，若如此做，你可以立即在这个田上播种蔬菜

OLD_NL037_PoppyField.name: 罂粟花田
OLD_NL037_PoppyField.description: 你立即获得1份小麦+1份蔬菜。下家在你农场中用箭头标记一个未使用空格，在其他区域未使用前，你不能使用此格使用后请将此卡交给下家，此卡将加入他的手牌。

OLD_NL038_Undergrowth.name: 灌木丛
OLD_NL038_Undergrowth.description: 立即获得2根木头使用后请将此卡交给下家，此卡将加入他的手牌。

OLD_NL039_Stockpile.name: 空投飞机
OLD_NL039_Stockpile.description: 每当翻开新的回合行动卡时，如果你恰好有0-1/2-3/4-5/6+份食物，你获得1木/砖/芦苇/石头(你可以在任意时刻丢弃食物)

OLD_NL040_OxCart.name: 牛车
OLD_NL040_OxCart.description: 在你第一次拥有牛时，你可以立即犁等同于之后丰收时节数量的田

OLD_NL041_Canal.name: 运河
OLD_NL041_Canal.description: 每当你使用钓鱼积累行动格时，你可以获得至多2个你个人供应区没有的不同建筑资源

OLD_NL042_DrawWell.name: 提水井
OLD_NL042_DrawWell.description: 在之后的偶数回合行动格上各放置1食物，这些回合开始时，你获得对应的食物。这是1个井。

OLD_NL043_Bottles.name: 玻璃瓶
OLD_NL043_Bottles.description: 在打出此卡时，你每拥有1名家庭成员就需要支付1块砖头和1份食物

OLD_NL044_PancakePan.name: 煎饼锅
OLD_NL044_PancakePan.description: 如果你有 发展卡，你可以随时将1份小麦转换成2份食物

OLD_NL045_DutchMountains.name: 荷兰山
OLD_NL045_DutchMountains.description: 立即获得1石头使用后请将此卡交给下家，此卡将加入他的手牌。

OLD_NL046_Poorhouse.name: 救济院
OLD_NL046_Poorhouse.description: 每回合开始时，你从食物最少的玩家中选择一位，这位玩家获得1食物

OLD_NL047_EarlyGrain.name: 早熟麦
OLD_NL047_EarlyGrain.description: 立刻从你的每个麦田上各收割1份小麦。算不算收割呢使用后请将此卡交给下家，此卡将加入他的手牌。

OLD_NL048_Req1emptyfield.name: 郁金香花田
OLD_NL048_Req1emptyfield.description: 从游戏供应区拿取4食物叠放在你的一块空田上，每个收割阶段你从上面拿下1份到你的个人供应区，食物拿完前你无法用这块田播种使用后请将此卡交给下家，此卡将加入他的手牌。

OLD_NL049_Lumbermill.name: 锯木厂
OLD_NL049_Lumbermill.description: 每张发展卡所需的木头花费于你而言都减少1

OLD_NL050_NightWatch.name: 夜巡
OLD_NL050_NightWatch.description: 此卡是一个额外行动格。每回合在此卡上补充1份小麦。使用此行动格的玩家需要支付2食物到游戏供应区，并获得此卡上的所有小麦，并且可以将其中任意数量的小麦换成等量的分数

OLD_NL051_CarriageTrip.name: 马车之旅
OLD_NL051_CarriageTrip.description: 立即派遣一位你的家庭成员。使用后请将此卡交给下家，此卡将加入他的手牌。
OLD_NL051_CarriageTrip.prerequisite: 工作阶段 家中有人

OLD_NL052_EastIndiaCompany.name: 东印度公司
OLD_NL052_EastIndiaCompany.description: 在此卡上放置1份小麦、蔬菜、羊、猪、牛、木、砖、芦苇和石头。接下来每回合翻开新的回合行动格前，你可以从此卡上随机拿取1份物品。

OLD_NL053_HouseBoat.name: 船屋
OLD_NL053_HouseBoat.description: 放置2个食客标记在此卡上。每个回家阶段，你可以使用其中1名食客去使用钓鱼积累行动格，然后返还该食客未使不可能的盒子用栅栏

OLD_NL054_HorseDrawnBoat.name: 马拉船
OLD_NL054_HorseDrawnBoat.description: 在之后每个回合的行动格上交替放置1份食物和1只羊，先放食物。在这些回合开始时，你获得相应的物品

OLD_NL055_GoldenHelmet.name: 金制头盔
OLD_NL055_GoldenHelmet.description: 每个以丰收时节为结束的回合限1次：你可以在放置1个家庭成员的行动完成后，从游戏供应区拿取1食物放在任意行动格上，下一个使用该行动格的玩家获得该食物白柏树家庭成

OLD_NL056_ImpossibleCrate.name: 不可能的盒子
OLD_NL056_ImpossibleCrate.description: 当前回合数加3，在该回合行动格上放置12根栅栏条，该回合开始时，你可以拿回栅栏条并执行一次“围建栅栏”行动。(正常支付)

OLD_NL057_JoyHouse.name: 欢乐屋
OLD_NL057_JoyHouse.description: 工作阶段结束后，你可以支付1份食物将你的一位家庭成员放在此卡上(此卡上最多1人)。此后当你派遣此卡上的家庭成员时，你可以支付1份食物来使用垂直相邻的两个行动格，先执行上方的行动格(此卡上的家庭成员依然占用你的房间)

OLD_NL058_Cypress.name: 白柏树
OLD_NL058_Cypress.description: 将打出此卡的家庭成员移出游戏。此卡只能通过行动格打出，且不能用食客打出

OLD_NL059_BeanBasket.name: 豆篮
OLD_NL059_BeanBasket.description: 打出此卡时，从游戏供应区拿取2份蔬菜放置在此卡上。每当你犁一块田，你可以从此卡上获得1份蔬菜，每当你使用小麦种子行动格时，此卡上补充1份蔬菜

OLD_NL060_Shack.name: 简陋木屋
OLD_NL060_Shack.description: 每回合开始时，若你仍居住在木屋内，则你获得1份食物

OLD_O13_CoffeeHouse.name: 咖啡屋
OLD_O13_CoffeeHouse.description: + !（+ ）此卡是1个额外行动格。使用此行动格的玩家和你各获得1份食物(你使用时获得2份食物)，同时此格的家庭成员在下一回合可以先于起始玩家的第一个家庭成员进行派遣。先于I260试味员行动，I260试味员仍然需要支付给起始玩家1食物。

OLD_O14_Spielefest.name: 狂欢节
OLD_O14_Spielefest.description: （+ ）此卡是所有玩家都可使用的额外行动格。使用此格的玩家支付你1份食物获得2分，你使用则直接获得2分寄宿工人空房

OLD_O15_FarmersBall.name: 乡村舞会
OLD_O15_FarmersBall.description: 打出此卡时，所有玩家都可以选择支付5份食物并获得3分

OLD_O16_Neutrality.name: 中立主义
OLD_O16_Neutrality.description: 在打出此卡的下一回合，你只能在所有其他玩家派遣完所有家庭成员后才能开始派遣家庭成员。你每有一个家庭成员受此卡影响，你便获得1分。

OLD_O17_GuestWorker.name: 间×1
OLD_O17_GuestWorker.description: 你获得一个食客标记。下回合开始，你可以如同你的家庭成员一样派遣这名食客，该食客可以使用本回合新翻开的回合行动格，即使该格已被占用。该食客占用你1间房间，每次喂养阶段需喂养2份食物。空房间的意思：临时住宅、农干临时住宅

OLD_O18_SchnitzelMallet.name: 肉槌
OLD_O18_SchnitzelMallet.description: 每当你使用 发展卡将1头牛转换成食物时，你获得额外的1份食物+1分

OLD_O19_CompulsoryEducation.name: 义务教育
OLD_O19_CompulsoryEducation.description: 每当你执行“生娃”行动时，你可以支付1份食物并打出1张职业卡。若你同时打出1张次要发展卡，首先执行打出职业卡的效果。

OLD_O20_EmergencyHousing.name: 临时住宅
OLD_O20_EmergencyHousing.description: 你的一个你已建造的马厩失去其原有功能，并可以容纳1名家庭成员。计分时该马厩仍然视作马厩。

OLD_O21_Vineyard.name: 葡萄园
OLD_O21_Vineyard.description: 当你执行"播种"行动时，你可以将至多3份食物，如同小麦般播种到此卡上。每次收割作物时，将此卡上的食物如同小麦般收割。（视作3块"已播种田"）

OLD_O22_UnusualArchitecture.name: 特色建筑
OLD_O22_UnusualArchitecture.description: 你每扩建1间房屋，你获得2份食物。

OLD_O23_Lederhosen.name: 皮短裤
OLD_O23_Lederhosen.description: 你每将1只羊转换成食物，便从游戏供应区拿取1份食物放在此卡上。游戏结束时，若此卡上的食物不少于你家庭成员数量(食客不计算在内)的1/2倍，则你获得2/3分。

OLD_O24_StyrianOak.name: 老橡树
OLD_O24_StyrianOak.description: 从游戏供应区放置5份食物到此卡上。每回合开始时，你可以将此卡上的1食物退还至游戏供应区。游戏中限1次：任意时刻，你可以支付与此卡上等量的食物(0至5)，并获得6根木头。

OLD_PI13_AngryDuck.name: 愤怒鸭
OLD_PI13_AngryDuck.description: 打出此卡后，每当你获得你放置在未翻开回合行动格上的食物时，可以将其中任意数量的食物放在此卡上。游戏结束时，如果此卡上有1/2/3/5/8+份食物，则你获得1/2/3/4/5分。(你不能使用此卡上的食物)

OLD_PI14_FertilityShrine.name: 生育神殿
OLD_PI14_FertilityShrine.description:
每个丰收时节的动物繁殖阶段，如果你繁殖了2种及以上种类的新生动物，你可以将繁殖出的2
  只新生动物从你的农场中退还到游戏供应区并执行一次“生娃（无需空房间）”行动。（你必须有饲养空间容纳新生动物）

OLD_PI15_FishingPier.name: Animal Bedding
OLD_PI15_FishingPier.description: You can keep 1 additional animal (of the same type) in each of your unfenced <STABLE>, and 2 additional animals (of the same type) in each pasture with <STABLE>.

OLD_PI16_GardenersBothy.name: 园丁茅屋
OLD_PI16_GardenersBothy.description: 每当你使用犁田行动格后，你可以将该人立即移动到此卡上并获得1份小麦。每当你使用粮食耕种[犁播]行动格后，你可以将该人立即移动到此卡上并获得1份蔬菜。

OLD_PI17_Geode.name: Wood Saw
OLD_PI17_Geode.description: Each time all other players have more people than you, you can take a __Build Rooms__ action without placing a person.

OLD_PI18_LandscapeDesign.name: Landscape Design
OLD_PI18_LandscapeDesign.description: 你的田地板块不必相邻。但在1个轮次内放置的田地板块必须相邻。游戏结束时，如果你有3/4/5块不与其他田相邻的田地版块，则你额外获得1/2/3分。

OLD_PI19_MarketSquare.name: Briar Hedge
OLD_PI19_MarketSquare.description: You do not need to pay <WOOD> for <FENCE> that you build on the edge of your farmyard board.

OLD_PI20_MeetingPost.name: Skimmer Plow
OLD_PI20_MeetingPost.description: Each time you use the __Farmland__ or __Cultivation__  action space, you can plow 2 <FIELD> instead of 1. Each time you sow, you must place 1 fewer good on each <FIELD> you sow.

OLD_PI21_Pitchfork.name: 干草叉
OLD_PI21_Pitchfork.description: 每当你扩建或翻修房屋时，可以使用积累行动格上的芦苇进行支付。

OLD_PI22_Retirement.name: 退休
OLD_PI22_Retirement.description: 打出此卡时，你所有已打出的职业卡失效并面朝下(未来回合行动格上的逻辑照常结算)，但仍算作职业卡。之后只要你没有打出新的职业卡，每回合开始时你获得1份食物

OLD_PI23_ShelterintheField.name: Iron Hoe
OLD_PI23_ShelterintheField.description: At the end of each work phase, if you occupy both the __Grain Seeds__ and __Vegetable Seeds__ action spaces, you can plow 1 <FIELD>.

OLD_PI24_Spars.name: Sheep Rug
OLD_PI24_Spars.description: You can use any __Wish for Children__ action space, even if it is occupied by another player's person.

OLD_WA001_ClutchDrive.name: 离合器
OLD_WA001_ClutchDrive.description: 每当你使用回合行动格的数量等于你个人供应区的木头数量后，你额外获得1根木头。

OLD_WA002_Ardennes.name: 密林
OLD_WA002_Ardennes.description: 在之后的偶数回合行动格上各放置1根木头，这些回合开始时，你获得这根木头

OLD_WA003_BeggingLetter.name: 乞援信
OLD_WA003_BeggingLetter.description: 每个其他玩家必须给你1张次发卡，你从中选择1张加入手牌，将之后的手牌与此卡一起洗混随机发给其他玩家各1张，然后你获得1次“打次发”行动

OLD_WA004_BeerTable.name: 啤酒桌
OLD_WA004_BeerTable.description: 每个丰收时节的收割阶段结束时，你可以支付1份小麦来获得2分。若你如此做，其他玩家分别获得1份食物漫画店8或9

OLD_WA005_BeerMuseum.name: 啤酒博物馆
OLD_WA005_BeerMuseum.description: 每个丰收时节的喂养阶段，你可以使用此卡将此卡将至多1份小麦转化为6份食物，你将在下个丰收时节的收割阶段获得这些食物。

OLD_WA006_BeerParlor.name: 啤酒店
OLD_WA006_BeerParlor.description: 打出此卡时，你获得1份小麦。每个回合的回家阶段之前，如果当回合你的所有家庭成员都放在同一个游戏版图上，则你可以将至多1份小麦转化为3份食物

OLD_WA007_ComicShop.name: 漫画店
OLD_WA007_ComicShop.description: 此卡是所有玩家可用的额外行动格。只有家中无人时能使用此格，且直到回合结束家中不能有人。使用此格的玩家在之后2个回合中，每个轮次能派遣至多2名家庭成员。

OLD_WA008_SteamEngine.name: 蒸汽机
OLD_WA008_SteamEngine.description: 若你在每回合工作阶段使用的行动格是积累行动格，则你可在行动后立即执行1次“烤面包”行动和平岛田地

OLD_WA009_BowlerHat.name: 渔网
OLD_WA009_BowlerHat.description: 每当其他玩家使用钓鱼积累行动格前，他们必须先支付你1份食物。之后，在该回合的回家阶段，补充2份食物到钓鱼积累行动格上

OLD_WA010_FrankiPile.name: 弗兰基桩
OLD_WA010_FrankiPile.description: 从游戏供应区拿取石头放在任意数量的农场空格上各1个，这些空格仍视为未使用。你只能通过在这些格子扩建房屋来使用他们，如此做时，对于每间房屋你少花费1个任意建筑资源而且你获得上面的石头

OLD_WA011_IslandsofPeace.name: 和平岛
OLD_WA011_IslandsofPeace.description: 从游戏供应区拿取食物放到农场里每组2×2空地的公共点上，一旦你使用了周围的4格空地，你获得中间的这份食物

OLD_WA012_CastironOven.name: 铸铁烤炉
OLD_WA012_CastironOven.description: 每当你执行“烤面包”行动或在打出1张职业卡后，你可以使用此卡将至多1份小麦转化为4份食物

OLD_WA013_IdealLandscape.name: 理想景观
OLD_WA013_IdealLandscape.description: 游戏结束时，如果你有恰好4个圈地(总共6格)、5块田和4间房屋板块，则你获得4分

OLD_WA014_CatTongue.name: 猫舌饼干
OLD_WA014_CatTongue.description: 每当你执行“生娃”行动时，你获得1个食客标记，而且你可以在工作阶段立即派遣他使用钓鱼积累行动格。生娃打出此卡会怎么样呢。

OLD_WA015_NoSonofMan.name: 无人之子
OLD_WA015_NoSonofMan.description: 你获得1根木头并且可以立即派遣一名家庭成员使用后请将此卡交给下家，此卡将加入他的手牌。

OLD_WA016_NoPotato.name: 无土豆
OLD_WA016_NoPotato.description: 立即获得等同于之后丰收时节数的分数。你将蔬菜转化为食物时减少1份食物。乞讨卡也算在此卡条件中

OLD_WA017_GreyMatter.name: 智谋
OLD_WA017_GreyMatter.description: 打出时，对于每张你打出了但尚未使用其功能的发展卡，你都获得1根木头使用后请将此卡交给下家，此卡将加入他的手牌。

OLD_WA018_CloisterRuins.name: 修道院废墟
OLD_WA018_CloisterRuins.description: 在之后的回合行动格上各放置1份食物，这些回合开始时，你获得这份食物泥磨机其他玩家有水

OLD_WA019_LaGraceFountain.name: 绵羊井
OLD_WA019_LaGraceFountain.description: 在之后的n个回合行动格上各放置1份食物，n=你的羊的数量。这些回合开始时，你获得对应的食物。

OLD_WA020_MarketFountain.name: 人工水井
OLD_WA020_MarketFountain.description: 下一回合开始时，在接下来的6个回合行动格上各放置1份食物，这些回合开始时，你获得这份食物，此卡算作1张水井朝圣之地发展卡总计至

OLD_WA021_MarlyMachine.name: 泥磨机
OLD_WA021_MarlyMachine.description: 回合开始时，如果有至少1名玩家获得水井的食物，则你获得1份食物壁炉台砖屋或石

OLD_WA022_MaterneJam.name: 神奇果酱
OLD_WA022_MaterneJam.description: 每个丰收时节开始时，你可以展示并弃掉至多1张次发卡并获得1个此卡费用中的建筑资源萨克斯风

OLD_WA023_PilgrimageSite.name: 朝圣之地
OLD_WA023_PilgrimageSite.description: 此卡是所有玩家都可以使用的额外行动格。使用此卡的玩家需要支付你1份小麦获得1石头+1蔬菜+1分(你使用需支付到游戏供应区)

OLD_WA024_SmokingMantlepiece.name: 壁炉台
OLD_WA024_SmokingMantlepiece.description: 打出此卡时，距离游戏结束每之后1个完整回合，你就获得1分，你无法再翻修你的房屋

OLD_WA025_phase.name: 萨克斯风
OLD_WA025_phase.description: 你必须在工作阶段用你的第2名或之后的家庭成员打出此卡。你立即派遣之后所有的家庭成员到不同的行动格上，这些行动格必须在同一版图且不能与第一名家庭成员在同一版图使用后请将此卡交给下家，此卡将加入他的手牌。

OLD_WA026_HoveringStone.name: 悬浮的石头
OLD_WA026_HoveringStone.description: 统计你供应区的石头数量，每当你使用回合数等于该数的回合行动格后，你额外获得1个石头使用后请将此卡交给下家，此卡将加入他的手牌。

OLD_WA027_6thSenseAcademy.name: 第六感学院
OLD_WA027_6thSenseAcademy.description: 每个轮次限一次，在小麦/蔬菜/木/砖/芦苇/石头中，如果你恰好没有其中1种，则你获得1个该种资源。对于任意一种物品，如果该物品只剩1个，你不能将其转化为食物

OLD_WA028_FoieGras.name: 鹅肝
OLD_WA028_FoieGras.description: 每当其他玩家使用芦苇滩/钓鱼积累行动格时，如果另一格已经被你占用，则你获得2份食物

OLD_WA029_Archway.name: 拱门
OLD_WA029_Archway.description: 此卡视为全体玩家可用的行动格。使用该行动格的玩家立即获得1份食物，并可在当回合回家阶段开始前，派遣此卡上的家庭成员去使用1个空的行动格

OLD_WA030_RiverPort.name: 河运港口
OLD_WA030_RiverPort.description: 每回合工作阶段开始时，查看场上拥有单一资源最多的积累行动格，你可以支付1份食物购买至多1份此种资源(一样多则你选择1种资源)

OLD_WM056_Almshouse.name: 救济院
OLD_WM056_Almshouse.description: 每个丰收时节的喂养阶段后，你可以弃掉1张任意丰收时节因喂养家庭成员食物不足而领取的乞讨卡。

OLD_WM057_AnimalNursery.name: 动物哺育室
OLD_WM057_AnimalNursery.description: 你可以将繁殖出来的动物立即饲养在此卡上。此卡上的动物参与繁殖、计分和动物计数，不能移走或用作其他用途。

OLD_WM058_AppleTree.name: 苹果树
OLD_WM058_AppleTree.description: 从游戏供应区拿取1根木头放到1块空田上，该田视为已播种。每个丰收时节的收割阶段时，你获得1份食物。此卡牌打出条件“空田×1”必须是田地板块。此田可视为1块已播种田。

OLD_WM059_Apprenticeship.name: 实习签约
OLD_WM059_Apprenticeship.description: 如果你的职业数量比其他玩家都少，则你可以立即打出一张职业卡。使用后请将此卡交给下家，此卡将加入他的手牌。

OLD_WM060_Attic.name: 阁楼
OLD_WM060_Attic.description: 每当你扩建房屋时，对于每间新扩建的房屋板块，你可以支付个人供应区的1个木头到其上。游戏结束时，每有1个这样的木头，你便额外获得1分。

OLD_WM061_BackDoor.name: 后门
OLD_WM061_BackDoor.description: 立即派遣另一名家庭成员使用生儿育女(并打出1张次发卡)行动格，即使该格已被占用。使用后请将此卡交给下家，此卡将加入他的手牌。

OLD_WM062_BackyardWell.name: 后院水井
OLD_WM062_BackyardWell.description: 限1次：你可以随时从游戏供应区拿取1个石头，放在1个与房屋板块正交相邻的空格上，视作已使用。立即在之后3个回合行动格上各放1份食物。这些回合开始时，你获得对应的食物。注：若此卡升级成I66村中水井，则弃掉此卡，并移除农场上的石头，此空格视作未占用。放置的食物并不会丢弃。

OLD_WM063_Birdcage.name: 鸟笼
OLD_WM063_Birdcage.description: 每个丰收时节结束时，你可支付1份食物获得1分。无论如何，你的房子不能再容纳动物了。即使有卡牌允许你这样做，例：K306驯兽师。

OLD_WM064_Bonre.name: 篝火
OLD_WM064_Bonre.description: 从游戏供应区拿取1个木头放到你农场中的1格空地上。任意时刻，你可以退还此木头，在此回合内你可以将任意数量的动物转化为食物。

OLD_WM065_BoundaryStones.name: 界碑
OLD_WM065_BoundaryStones.description: 游戏结束时，如果你有2/3/4/5+个田地板块恰好只与1块田地板块正交相邻，则你额外获得1/2/3/5分。

OLD_WM066_Brazier.name: 火盆
OLD_WM066_Brazier.description: 每个丰收时节的喂养阶段，你可以使用此卡将以下至多1个物品转化为食物：备用计划备用计划马厩×1

OLD_WM067_BuriedTreasure.name: 地下宝藏
OLD_WM067_BuriedTreasure.description: 每当你使用犁田/粮食耕种[犁播]行动格时，额外获得1个石头。

OLD_WM068_CashCrop.name: 经济作物
OLD_WM068_CashCrop.description: 此卡视作1个田。你可以在此卡上播种任意作物，从此卡上收割的每份作物必须被立即转化为1分。注:（1）因其他卡牌效果弃置此卡时，不影响之前已获得的分数。例：E38圣母像。（2）此卡上的作物因其他卡牌效果移除、取走或丢弃（非收割）不能转化为分数。例：I223秋收帮工。

OLD_WM069_ChangingPlans.name: 备用计划
OLD_WM069_ChangingPlans.description: 立即退还至多2个马厩(从农场退还至个人供应区)，每退还1个马厩，你可以立即退还至多2个农场里的马厩，每退还1个马厩，你可以犁1块田。犁一块田使用后请将此卡交给下家，此卡将加入他的手牌。

OLD_WM070_ClockworkMan.name: 发条人
OLD_WM070_ClockworkMan.description: 此卡对次要发展卡和职业卡(例：E217地方官、E174家庭教师)的需求、功能、数量和计分来说，算作1个职业+1张次发卡。1. 打出此卡后，不影响后续打职业卡的花费。2. 此卡不触发以下卡牌（写有“职业卡”）：K112书架、WM094灯油、NL022书柜、K271教育家、FR080剑术大师等。3. 此卡可触发以下卡牌（写有“职业”）：FR087移民者的儿子等。

OLD_WM071_Cookies.name: 曲奇饼
OLD_WM071_Cookies.description: 每当你执行“烤面包”行动时，对于每份被转化的小麦，你可支付1份食物（从个人供应区拿取）到你的1个房屋板块上，每个房屋板块最多只能有1份这样的食物，食物不可再次被使用。游戏结束时，每有1个这样的食物你便额外获得1分。

OLD_WM072_Crib.name: 摇篮床
OLD_WM072_Crib.description: 每个回合的工作阶段结束时，如果你在本回合执行了“生娃”行动，则你可以额外获得2份食物 或 支付2份食物立即获得1分。

OLD_WM073_DiamondMine.name: 钻石矿车
OLD_WM073_DiamondMine.description: 打出此卡时，在之后的2个回合行动格上各放1个石头。这些回合开始时，你获得对应的石头。

OLD_WM074_Donkey.name: 毛驴
OLD_WM074_Donkey.description: 你的一个圈地不能再容纳动物。每当你使用犁田/粮食耕种[犁播]行动格时，你可以额外犁1块田。

OLD_WM075_Downsizing.name: 房屋拆迁
OLD_WM075_Downsizing.description: 限1次：当你围建至少1根栅栏条时，你可以退还1间木屋来免费多围建7根栅栏条。注:（1）该木屋板块附带/交接处的物品也被移除。例：K339毛皮、BI12天空桥、WM071曲奇饼。（2）计算房屋板块数量时，应计算移除后。例：WM029丘陵农夫。

OLD_WM076_DrainedPond.name: 引水渠
OLD_WM076_DrainedPond.description: 打出此卡时，将当前回合数加4，在该回合的行动格上放置1个田地板块。在此回合开始时，你可以支付1份食物来犁对应的田地板块。

OLD_WM077_EdibleRoots.name: 根茎植物
OLD_WM077_EdibleRoots.description: 每当你从1块田上收割下最后1个物品并放入你的供应区时，你获得1份食物。注：（1）此卡牌打出条件“田×3”包括卡牌田。（2）对于每张已播种多列物品的卡牌田，本卡只将其算作“田×1”。（3）对于每张已播种多列物品的卡牌田，每次最多获得1份食物。

OLD_WM078_FarmSchool.name: 农业学校
OLD_WM078_FarmSchool.description: 每个丰收时节的收割阶段，如果你至少收割了2个物品，则你可以支付2份食物来打出1张职业卡。注：（1）卡牌提供的“收割阶段”不算。（2）卡牌田/田地板块上收割的每份物品都可计算在内。

OLD_WM079_FestivalHall.name: 节日大厅
OLD_WM079_FestivalHall.description: 每个丰收时节的收割阶段后，你可以将至多1份小麦转化为2份食物+任意1个建筑资源。注：（1）“麦田x2”包括卡牌田。（2）卡牌提供的收割阶段不算。

OLD_WM080_FishHook.name: 鱼钩
OLD_WM080_FishHook.description: 每当你使用与钓鱼积累行动格正交相邻的行动格时，你可以立即从钓鱼积累行动格上取走1份食物。注：一般情况下是指芦苇积累行动格、临时工、第4回合行动格。

OLD_WM081_FishPond.name: 鱼塘
OLD_WM081_FishPond.description: 将1个砖头（从游戏供应区拿取）放到你农场中的1个空格上，该格视为已使用。每当你使用钓鱼积累行动格时，你可以将此钓鱼行动格上食物中任意数量的食物放置到此卡上。游戏结束时，如果此卡上有至少0/1/4/6/8份食物，则你额外获得-1/1/2/3/4分。注：（1）若此卡因其他卡牌效果弃置/翻面/失去效果，则移除此砖并移除此卡上食物。（2）只能放置钓鱼积累行动格上原有食物。

OLD_WM082_FlowerPots.name: 花盆
OLD_WM082_FlowerPots.description: 若你在第6回合/之前打出此卡，则在第8回合行动格上放置1份蔬菜。在第8回合开始时，你获得对应的蔬菜。

OLD_WM083_FreeRangeChickens.name: 散养鸡
OLD_WM083_FreeRangeChickens.description: 每回合开始时，如果你有至少1个麦田，拿取1份食物（从游戏供应区）到此卡上。此卡上的食物你可以随时使用。游戏结束时，如果此卡上有3/6+份食物，则你获得1/2分。注：“麦田×1”包括卡牌田。

OLD_WM084_FriendlyPastures.name: 友谊牧场
OLD_WM084_FriendlyPastures.description: 你每个有马厩的圈地能饲养不同种类的动物。(不改变原有饲养空间)

OLD_WM085_Fruitcake.name: 水果蛋糕
OLD_WM085_Fruitcake.description: 下一次丰收时节的喂养阶段，你的每个家庭成员(包括新生儿)少喂养1份食物。

OLD_WM086_GlassblowersShop.name: 大陶艺工坊
OLD_WM086_GlassblowersShop.description: 每个丰收时节，你可以将至多1块砖头转化为3份食物。游戏结束时，如果你有2/4/5+块砖头，额外获得1/2/3分。(多余的砖头不能再用于A8陶艺工坊的计分)（本卡牌可算作1张次发/1张主发，但只算作1张发展卡。）

OLD_WM087_GoldMedal.name: 金牌
OLD_WM087_GoldMedal.description: 打出此卡时，你从下列中选择1项：小麦/蔬菜/羊/猪/牛/田地/圈地/圈地内马厩。游戏结束时，该项分数最高的玩家们都额外获得2分。(不计算卡牌奖励分)

OLD_WM088_GrainElevator.name: 升降谷仓
OLD_WM088_GrainElevator.description: 每回合开始时，如果此卡上的小麦数量不等于玩家人数，则拿取1份小麦（从游戏供应区）到此卡上。每当你/其他玩家使用小麦种子行动格时，你获得/弃掉此卡上的所有小麦。

OLD_WM089_HomeGarden.name: 家庭花园
OLD_WM089_HomeGarden.description: 每当你翻修时(或打出此卡时当回合执行了“翻修”行动)，在接下来的3个回合行动格上各放置1份食物。这些回合开始时，你获得对应的食物。

OLD_WM090_Honeymoon.name: 蜜月旅行
OLD_WM090_Honeymoon.description: 在第14回合，你必须少派遣2名家庭成员。注：第14回合，你必须能够派遣至少2名家庭成员。

OLD_WM091_IronPlow.name: 铁犁
OLD_WM091_IronPlow.description: 在此卡上放1个田地板块。限1次：每当你使用犁田行动格时，你可以使用此卡上1块田，改为犁2块田，然后执行1次“播种”行动。每次使用犁田/粮食耕种[犁播]行动格时，只能使用1个犁/I68耙的效果。

OLD_WM092_Keys.name: 钥匙
OLD_WM092_Keys.description: 你可以使用农场扩建行动格，即使该格已被其他玩家占据。注：（1）被自己家庭成员占据则不可以使用。（2）不适用于5人版图“扩建1间房屋”行动格。

OLD_WM093_Kindling.name: 引火柴
OLD_WM093_Kindling.description: A1/A2火炉和A3/A4壁炉对你来说是次要发展卡，且花费减少1个砖头。

OLD_WM094_LampOil.name: 灯油
OLD_WM094_LampOil.description: 每次你打出1张职业卡前，你额外获得1份食物。注：本卡牌打出条件“动物×2”可为同种或不同种动物, 卡牌动物不算。

OLD_WM095_MountainCave.name: 山洞
OLD_WM095_MountainCave.description: 每次丰收时节，你可以将至多1个木头转换为1个石头。

OLD_WM096_OakCask.name: 橡木桶
OLD_WM096_OakCask.description: 打出此卡时，拿取1份食物（从游戏供应区）到此卡上。每个丰收时节的收割阶段，如果此卡上有食物，则额外补充1份食物。你可以随时使用此卡上的食物。

OLD_WM097_OpenGate.name: 散养区
OLD_WM097_OpenGate.description: 每个丰收时节的喂养阶段前，你可以支付至多1只羊并额外获得1分。

OLD_WM098_PettingZoo.name: 迷你动物园
OLD_WM098_PettingZoo.description: 游戏结束时，如果你拥有3种动物，(不包括卡牌动物)若你有至少2羊，额外获得1分；若你有至少2猪，额外获得1分。（可以分别/同时获得）

OLD_WM099_PigWallow.name: 退耕还牧
OLD_WM099_PigWallow.description: 立即退还已犁的1个空田板块，并免费围建农场1个空地。（需满足围建栅栏的一般规则）使用后请将此卡交给下家，此卡将加入他的手牌。注: 此田地板块附加物品随之移除，例: NL014壕沟。

OLD_WM100_PlumPatch.name: 葡萄干
OLD_WM100_PlumPatch.description: 计算你已播种的田地数量，在接下来的（等同于此数量）回合行动格上各放置1份食物。这些回合开始时，你获得对应的食物。注:（1）此卡牌打出条件包括卡牌田。（2）在本次计算时，每张已播种的卡牌田算作1块已播种的田。

OLD_WM101_PrizewinningSheep.name: 羊毛奖励
OLD_WM101_PrizewinningSheep.description: 立即获得1个任意建筑资源 。使用后请将此卡交给下家，此卡将加入他的手牌。

OLD_WM102_Ram.name: 公羊
OLD_WM102_Ram.description: 公羊参与羊计数、计分和繁殖。在第6/8/10/12回合结束时，你的羊会额外进行1次繁殖。每次家庭成员喂养阶段，必须喂养公羊1份食物或者获得一份乞讨卡。

OLD_WM103_Raspberries.name: 树莓
OLD_WM103_Raspberries.description: 从游戏供应区拿取食物，在你至多3个农场空格上各放置1份食物。当对应农场空格被占用时，你获得对应的食物。注：放置食物的农场空格仍视为未占用。

OLD_WM104_ReedNursery.name: 芦苇地
OLD_WM104_ReedNursery.description: 你可以在田地板块上如同小麦一样种植芦苇。游戏结束时，你可以将你个人供应区和田里的芦苇转化为分数，1/4/6/8+捆芦苇可转化为1/2/3/4分。

OLD_WM105_RotherhamPlow.name: 罗氏犁
OLD_WM105_RotherhamPlow.description: 每当你使用犁田行动格时，你可以额外犁一块田，但这两块田必须既不直角相邻也不对角相邻。仍需要满足所有田地板块相邻。每次使用犁田/粮食耕种[犁播]行动格时，只能使用1个犁/I68耙的效果。

OLD_WM106_Ruins.name: 废墟
OLD_WM106_Ruins.description: 打出时在此卡放置4个<STONE>，每个丰收时节的收割阶段，你从上获得1个<STONE>。

OLD_WM107_SlapdashRenovation.name: 仓促翻修
OLD_WM107_SlapdashRenovation.description: 每当你使用了提供“翻修”行动的行动格后，在该轮次结束时，你将该家庭成员遣返回家，并在之后的轮次中再派遣他卡牌提供的翻修行动/行动格不算。

OLD_WM109_SteelPlow.name: 金钢犁
OLD_WM109_SteelPlow.description: 限1次：在你使用犁田/粮食耕种[犁播]行动格时，可以改为犁至多4块田每次使用犁田/粮食耕种[犁播]行动格时，只能使用1个犁/I68耙的效果。

OLD_WM110_StorageShed.name: 工具间
OLD_WM110_StorageShed.description: 将你已建造的1个马厩放到此卡上，你不能再建造此马厩。每当你打出次要发展卡前，你可以获得1个任意建筑资源

OLD_WM111_UndisturbedPond.name: 原状池塘
OLD_WM111_UndisturbedPond.description: 计算已过的完整回合数，在接下来的这个数目的行动格上各放置1份食物，这些回合开始时，你获得这份食物

OLD_WM112_VillageSchool.name: 乡村学校
OLD_WM112_VillageSchool.description: 每轮次限1次：每当你需要支付费用时，你可以弃掉你1张手牌来少支付1个建筑资源

OLD_WM113_WildBreeding.name: 野外繁殖
OLD_WM113_WildBreeding.description: 在每个有至少2只动物的动物积累行动格上额外放置1只该动物，如果你有饲养空间，你可以拿走至多1只新放置的动物使用后请将此卡交给下家，此卡将加入他的手牌。

OLD_WM114_WineCloset.name: 酒窖
OLD_WM114_WineCloset.description: 打出时获得1份蔬菜。每回合限1次：你可以将1份蔬菜放到未来的行动格上，如果至少是5个回合后，则额外放一个蔬菜到此格上，在这回合开始时，你必须将上面的蔬菜各转换为2份食物/1分。

OLD_WM115_WormBait.name: 鱼饵
OLD_WM115_WormBait.description: 每当你使用犁田行动格时，从游戏供应区拿取2份食物放到此卡上，每当你使用钓鱼积累行动格时，你获得此卡上的所有食物。每个丰收时节开始时，你需要退还此卡上的1份食物。

OLD_Z313_StumpJumpPlough.name: 碟犁
OLD_Z313_StumpJumpPlough.description: 如果你不住在木屋，则每次你通过家庭成员执行行动获得木头时，你可以支付1份食物来犁一块田胸像

OLD_Z314_Keg.name: 木桶
OLD_Z314_Keg.description: 当前回合所有玩家的所有家庭成员被派遣完毕后，你获得1个食客标记，你可以派遣该食客，并在回合结束时退还该食客使用后请将此卡交给下家，此卡将加入他的手牌。

OLD_Z315_BrewersCopper.name: 酿酒师铜器
OLD_Z315_BrewersCopper.description: 在每个喂养阶段，你可以使用此卡将至多1份小麦转换成2份食物。游戏结束时，如果你有至少7份小麦，你获得1分

OLD_Z316_Bust.name: 胸像
OLD_Z316_Bust.description: 你必须在至少有一位其他玩家尚未打出他的第二张职业卡前打出此卡(3人游戏中改为第三张，2人游戏中改为第四张)

OLD_Z317_FamilyPortrait.name: 全家福
OLD_Z317_FamilyPortrait.description: 你可以为你的每名家庭成员支付2份食物，然后你获得4分使用后请将此卡交给下家，此卡将加入他的手牌。

OLD_Z318_Barbecue.name: 烧烤派对
OLD_Z318_Barbecue.description: 打出时，你每拥有一位家庭成员，你就可以将1只动物转换成食物：羊/猪/牛每只转换成3/4/5份食物使用后请将此卡交给下家，此卡将加入他的手牌。

OLD_Z319_PumpkinSeedOil.name: 南瓜籽油
OLD_Z319_PumpkinSeedOil.description: 游戏中限3次，每回合限1次：你可以支付1份蔬菜到此卡上并获得3份食物，此卡上的蔬菜参与计分

OLD_Z320_Maypole.name: 五朔节花柱
OLD_Z320_Maypole.description: 此卡只能在第四回合结束前打出。在你的一个空格上立直一根你供应区的栅栏。直到游戏结束，如果你自己没有弄倒过这根栅栏，则你获得2分(该格视为已使用)

OLD_Z321_Ranch.name: 大农庄
OLD_Z321_Ranch.description: 打出此卡时，距离游戏结束每剩1个完整回合，你便可获得1分+2份食物稻草人

OLD_Z322_DozingBull.name: 斗牛
OLD_Z322_DozingBull.description: 如果你有至少1只牛，则在任意时刻，你可以重新布置你的栅栏

OLD_Z323_GiantPumpkin.name: 巨无霸南瓜
OLD_Z323_GiantPumpkin.description: 将1份蔬菜支付到此卡上。任意时刻，你可以将该蔬菜转化为食物。游戏结束时，如果此卡上有蔬菜，则你获得2分(该蔬菜参与计分)

OLD_Z324_Scarecrow.name: 稻草人
OLD_Z324_Scarecrow.description: 每当你播种时，你可以支付1根木头，然后在至多一块空田上播种2列小麦。

A105_BarrowPusher.name: Barrow Pusher
A105_BarrowPusher.description: For each new field tile you get, you also get 1 <CLAY> and 1 <FOOD>.

A108_MushroomCollector.name: Mushroom Collector
A108_MushroomCollector.description: Immediately after each time you use a wood accumulation space, you can exchange 1 <WOOD> for 2 <FOOD>. If you do, place the <WOOD> on the accumulation space.

A109_SmallTrader.name: Small Trader
A109_SmallTrader.description: Each time you take a __Major or Minor Improvement__ action, if you play a card from your hand instead of taking a major improvement from the board, you also get 3 <FOOD>.

A110_Roughcaster.name: Roughcaster
A110_Roughcaster.description: Each time you build at least 1 clay room or renovate your house from clay to stone, you also get 3 <FOOD>.

A112_ScytheWorker.name: Scythe Worker
A112_ScytheWorker.description: When you play this card, you immediately get 1 <GRAIN>. In the field phase of each harvest, you can harvest 1 additional <GRAIN> from each of your grain fields.

A119_FirewoodCollector.name: Firewood Collector
A119_FirewoodCollector.description: Each time you use the __space:farmland|Farmland__, __space:grain-seeds|Grain Seeds__, __space:grain-utilization|Grain Utilization__, or __space:cultivation|Cultivation__ action space, at the end of that turn, you get 1 <WOOD>.

A123_FrameBuilder.name: Frame Builder
A123_FrameBuilder.description: Each time you build a room/renovate, but only once per room/action, you can replace exactly 2 <CLAY> or 2 <STONE> with 1 <WOOD>.

A126_MasterWorkman.name: Master Workman
A126_MasterWorkman.description: Each time before you use an action space card on round spaces 1/2/3/4, you get 1 <WOOD>/<CLAY>/<REED>/<STONE>.

A127_Lodger.name: Lodger
A127_Lodger.description: This card provides room for one person, but only until the returning home phase of round 9. If, by then, there is no room elsewhere for that person, remove it from play.

A137_RiverineShepherd.name: Riverine Shepherd
A137_RiverineShepherd.description: Each time you use the __space:sheep-market|Sheep Market__ or __space:reed-bank|Reed Bank__ accumulation space, you can also take 1 good from the respective other accumulation space, if possible.

A144_Sequestrator.name: Sequestrator
A144_Sequestrator.description: Place 3 <REED> and 4 <CLAY> on this card. The next player to have 3 pastures/5 field tiles gets the 3 <REED>/4 <CLAY> (not retroactively).

A148_Woolgrower.name: Woolgrower
A148_Woolgrower.description: This card can hold a number of <SHEEP> equal to the number of completed feeding phases.

A162_ForestTallyman.name: Forest Tallyman
A162_ForestTallyman.description: Each time both the __space:forest|Forest__ and __space:clay-pit|Clay Pit__ accumulation spaces are occupied, you can use this card as an action space to get 2 <CLAY> and 3 <WOOD>.

A165_PigBreeder.name: Pig Breeder
A165_PigBreeder.description: When you play this card, you immediately get 1 <PIG>. Your <PIG> breed at the end of round 12 (if there is room for the new <PIG>).

A085_Homekeeper.name: Homekeeper
A085_Homekeeper.description: Exactly one clay or stone room in your house can hold an additional person if the room is adjacent to both a field and a pasture.

A087_Conservator.name: Conservator
A087_Conservator.description: You can renovate your wooden house directly to stone without renovating it to clay first.

A088_HedgeKeeper.name: Hedge Keeper
A088_HedgeKeeper.description: Each time you take a __Build Fences__ action, you do not have to pay <WOOD> for 3 of the fences you build.

A089_StablePlanner.name: Stable Planner
A089_StablePlanner.description: Add 3, 6, and 9 to the current round. You can place 1 stable on each corresponding round space. At the start of these rounds (not earlier), you can build the stable at no cost.

A094_LazySowman.name: Lazy Sowman
A094_LazySowman.description: Each time you decline an unconditional __Sow__ action on your turn, you can immediately place another person on an action space of your choice (even if it is occupied).
A094_LazySowman.rules: The additional person cannot be placed on __space:meeting-place|Meeting Place__.

A097_Freshman.name: Freshman
A097_Freshman.description: Each time you get a __Bake Bread__ action, instead of taking the action, you can play an occupation without paying an occupation cost (at most once per turn).

B100_Clutterer.name: Clutterer
B100_Clutterer.description: During scoring, you get 1 bonus <SCORE> for each card played after this one that has \  in its text.

B103_FieldMerchant.name: Field Merchant
B103_FieldMerchant.description: When you play this card, you immediately get 1 <WOOD> and 1 <REED>. Each time you decline a __Minor/Major Improvement__ action, you get 1 <FOOD>/<VEGETABLE> instead.

B109_PaperMaker.name: Paper Maker
B109_PaperMaker.description: Immediately before playing each occupation after this one, you can pay 1 <WOOD> total to get 1 <FOOD> for each occupation you have in front of you.

B115_TinsmithMaster.name: Tinsmith Master
B115_TinsmithMaster.description: You can hold 1 additional animal in each pasture without a stable. Each time you sow in a field, you can place 1 additional crop of the respective type in that field.

B124_Trimmer.name: Trimmer
B124_Trimmer.description: In each work phase, after you enclose at least one farmyard space, you get 2 <STONE>. (Subdividing an existing pasture does not count.)

B136_HouseSteward.name: House Steward
B136_HouseSteward.description: If there are still 1/3/6/9 complete rounds left to play, you immediately get 1/2/3/4 <WOOD>. During scoring, each player with the most rooms gets 3 bonus <SCORE>.

B146_Illusionist.name: Illusionist
B146_Illusionist.description: Each time you use a building resource accumulation space, you can discard exactly 1 card from your hand to get 1 additional building resource of the accumulating type.

B149_OpenAirFarmer.name: Open Air Farmer
B149_OpenAirFarmer.description: When you play this card, you remove exactly 3 <STABLE> in your supply from play to build a pasture covering 2 farmyard spaces. You only need to pay a total of 2 <WOOD> for fences

B151_LittlePeasant.name: Little Peasant
B151_LittlePeasant.description: You immediately get 1 <STONE>. As long as you live in a wooden house with exactly 2 rooms, actions spaces—excluding Meeting Place—are not considered occupied for you.

B154_SheepKeeper.name: Sheep Keeper
B154_SheepKeeper.description: You can only play this card if you have less than 7 <SHEEP>. Once this game, when you have 7 <SHEEP> on your farm, you immediately get 3 bonus points and 2 <FOOD>.

B165_GameProvider.name: Game Provider
B165_GameProvider.description: Immediately before each harvest, you can discard 1/3/4 <GRAIN> from different fields to get 1/2/3 <PIG>.

B086_TruffleSearcher.name: Truffle Searcher
B086_TruffleSearcher.description: This card can hold a number of <PIG> equal to the number of completed feeding phases.

C115_Sower.name: Sower
C115_Sower.description: Each time you build a major improvement, place 1 <REED> from the general supply on this card. At any time, you can move the <REED> to your supply or exchange it for a __Sow__ action.

C120_AgriculturalLabourer.name: Agricultural Labourer
C120_AgriculturalLabourer.description: Place 8 <CLAY> on this card. For each <GRAIN> you obtain, you also get 1 <CLAY> from this card.

C133_Soldier.name: Soldier
C133_Soldier.description: During scoring, you get 1 bonus <SCORE> for each <STONE> + <WOOD> pair in your supply. You cannot score additional points for the resources scored with this card.

C138_AnimalFeeder.name: Animal Feeder
C138_AnimalFeeder.description: On the __space:day-laborer|Day Laborer__ action space, you also get your choice of 1 <SHEEP> or 1 <GRAIN>. Instead of that good, you can buy 1 <PIG> for 1 <FOOD> or 1 <CATTLE> for 2 <FOOD>.

C135_Constable.name: Constable
C135_Constable.description: If there are still 1/3/6/9 complete rounds left to play, you immediately get 1/2/3/4 <WOOD>. During scoring, each player with no negative points in any scoring line gets 3 bonus <SCORE>.

C142_MarketCrier.name: Market Crier
C142_MarketCrier.description: Each time you use the __space:grain-seeds|Grain Seeds__ action space, you can get an additional 1 <GRAIN> and 1 <VEGETABLE>. If you do, each other player gets 1 <GRAIN>.

C146_WorkshopAssistant.name: Workshop Assistant
C146_WorkshopAssistant.description: Place unique pairs of different building resources on this card, one for each improvement you have built. Each time another player renovates, you may move one such pair to your supply.

C148_MudWallower.name: Mud Wallower
C148_MudWallower.description: Every fourth time you use an accumulation space, you get 1 <PIG>, held by this card.

C156_HoofCaregiver.name: Hoof Caregiver
C156_HoofCaregiver.description: Immediately add 1 <CATTLE> from the general supply to the __space:cattle-market|Cattle Market__ accumulation space. Afterward, for each cattle on __space:cattle-market|Cattle Market__, you get 1 <GRAIN> plus 1 <FOOD>.

C162_ForestOwner.name: Forest Owner
C162_ForestOwner.description: This card is an action space for all. If another player uses it, they get 3 <WOOD> and must give you 1 <WOOD> from the general supply. If you use it, you get 4 <WOOD>.

C085_DenBuilder.name: Den Builder
C085_DenBuilder.description: When you live in a clay or stone house, you can pay 1 <GRAIN> and 2 <FOOD>. If you do, for the rest of the game, this card provides room for exactly one person.

C086_LivestockFeeder.name: Livestock Feeder
C086_LivestockFeeder.description: When you play this card, you immediately get 1 <GRAIN>. This card can hold 1 animal of any type for each <GRAIN> in your supply.

C087_Mason.name: Mason
C087_Mason.description: Place a stone room on this card. Once you have a stone house with at least 4 rooms, at any time, you can add that room without paying any building resources.

C088_CarpentersApprentice.name: Carpenter's Apprentice
C088_CarpentersApprentice.description: Wood rooms cost you 2 <WOOD> less. Your 3rd and 4th stable each cost you 1 <WOOD> less. Your 13th to 15th fence each cost you nothing.

C093_InnerDistrictsDirector.name: Inner Districts Director
C093_InnerDistrictsDirector.description: Each time you use the __space:forest|Forest__ or __space:clay-pit|Clay Pit__ accumulation space, you can place 1 <STONE> from the general supply on the other space. If you do, you can immediately place another person.

C096_Merchant.name: Merchant
C096_Merchant.description: Immediately after each time you take a __Major or Minor Improvement__ or __Minor Improvement__ action, you can pay 1 <FOOD> to take the action a second time.

C099_GardenDesigner.name: Garden Designer
C099_GardenDesigner.description: At the start of scoring, you can place <FOOD> in empty fields. You get 1/2/3 bonus <SCORE> for each field in which you place 1/4/7 <FOOD>.

C104_Collector.name: Collector
C104_Collector.description: This card is an action space for you only. When you use it for the 1st/2nd/3rd/4th time, you get 1 <BEGGING> marker and 6/7/8/9 different good of your choice.

D100_LordoftheManor.name: Lord of the Manor
D100_LordoftheManor.description: During scoring, you get 1 bonus <SCORE> for each scoring category in which you score the maximum 4 points. (The bonus point is also awarded for 4 fenced stables.)

D101_SugarBaker.name: Sugar Baker
D101_SugarBaker.description: Each time after you use the __space:grain-utilization|Grain Utilization__ action space, you can buy 1 bonus <SCORE> for 1 <FOOD>. Place the <FOOD> on the action space (for the next visitor).

D102_SampleStableMaker.name: Sample Stable Maker
D102_SampleStableMaker.description: At the start of each returning home phase, you can return a built stable to your supply to get 1 <WOOD>, 1 <GRAIN>, 1 <FOOD>, and a __Minor Improvement__ action.

D103_CanalBoatman.name: Canal Boatman
D103_CanalBoatman.description: Each time you use __space:fishing|Fishing__ or __space:reed-bank|Reed Bank__, you can pay 1 <FOOD> to immediately place another person on this card. If you do, you get your choice of 3 <STONE> or 1 <GRAIN> plus 1 <VEGETABLE>.

D107_Bellfounder.name: Bellfounder
D107_Bellfounder.description: In the returning home phase of each round, if you have at least 1 <CLAY>, you can use this card to discard all of your <CLAY> and get your choice of 3 <FOOD> or 1 bonus <SCORE>.

D115_FodderPlanter.name: Fodder Planter
D115_FodderPlanter.description: In the breeding phase of each harvest, for each newborn animal you get, you can sow crops in exactly 1 field.

D116_TreeInspector.name: Tree Inspector
D116_TreeInspector.description: This card is a 1 <WOOD> accumulation space for you only. Each time the newly revealed action space card is a __space:western-quarry,eastern-quarry|Quarry__ accumulation space, you must discard all <WOOD> from this card.

D124_Emissary.name: Emissary
D124_Emissary.description: At any time, you can place a good from your supply on this card to get 1 <STONE>. You must place different goods on this card. (<FOOD> is also considered a good.)

D126_FieldCultivator.name: Field Cultivator
D126_FieldCultivator.description: Pile 1 <WOOD>, 1 <CLAY>, 1 <REED>, 1 <STONE>, 1 <REED>, 1 <CLAY>, and 1 <WOOD> on this card. Each time you harvest a field tile, you can also take the top good from the pile.

D127_HardworkingMan.name: Hardworking Man
D127_HardworkingMan.description: This card is an action space for you only. If each other player has more rooms than you, it provides the __Day Laborer__, __Build Rooms__, and __Major Improvement__ actions (all three).

D131_CraftsmanshipPromoter.name: Craftsmanship Promoter
D131_CraftsmanshipPromoter.description: When you play this card, you immediately get 1 <STONE>. You can build any of the major improvements in the bottom row of the supply board even when taking a __Minor Improvement__ action.

D132_HideFarmer.name: Hide Farmer
D132_HideFarmer.description: During scoring, you can pay 1 <FOOD> each for any number of unused farmyard spaces. You do not lose points for these spaces.

D134_OysterEater.name: Oyster Eater
D134_OysterEater.description: Each time the __space:fishing|Fishing__ accumulation space is used, you get 1 bonus <SCORE> and must skip placing your next person that round. (You can place the person on a later turn.)

D137_TradeTeacher.name: Trade Teacher
D137_TradeTeacher.description: Each time after you use a __space:lessons,lessons-3,lessons-4,lessons-56-2f,lessons-56-variable|Lessons__ action space, you can buy up to 2 different goods: <GRAIN>, <STONE>, <SHEEP>, and <PIG> for 1 <FOOD> each; <CATTLE> and <VEGETABLE> for 2 <FOOD> each.

D150_GodlySpouse.name: Godly Spouse
D150_GodlySpouse.description: Each time you take a __Family Growth__ action with the second person you place in a round, return the first person you placed home, unless it is on the __space:meeting-place|Meeting Place__ action space.

D151_SpinDoctor.rules: No card, including this one, can allow you to use __space:meeting-place|Meeting Place__ if it is already occupied.
D151_SpinDoctor.description: Immediately after each time you use the __space:traveling-players,traveling-players-56|Traveling Players__ accumulation space, you can place another person on an action space of your choice, regardless whether or not the action space is occupied.

D157_PartyOrganizer.name: Party Organizer
D157_PartyOrganizer.description: As soon as the next player but you gains their 5th person, you immediately get 8 <FOOD> (not retroactively). During scoring, if only you have 5 people, you get 3 bonus <SCORE>.

D158_BeanCounter.name: Bean Counter
D158_BeanCounter.description: Each time you use an action space on round spaces 1 to 8, place 1 <FOOD> on this card. Each time this cards has 3 <FOOD> on it, move the <FOOD> to your supply.

D167_PureBreeder.name: Pure Breeder
D167_PureBreeder.description: You immediately get 1 <WOOD>. After each round that does not end with a harvest, you can breed exactly one type of animal. (This is not considered a breeding phase.)

D085_Reader.name: Reader
D085_Reader.description: As soon as you have 6 (7 in draft mode) occupations in front of you (including this one), this card provides room for one person.
D085_Reader.rules: In simultaneous draft mode, the occupation threshold is fixed at 7, regardless of draft pool size.

D093_SheepInspector.name: Sheep Inspector
D093_SheepInspector.description: Once per work phase, after you complete a person action, you can pay 1 <SHEEP> and 2 <FOOD> to return another person you placed home, unless it is on the __space:meeting-place|Meeting Place__ action space.

D094_HenpeckedHusband.name: Henpecked Husband
D094_HenpeckedHusband.description: Each time you take a __Build Rooms__ action with the second person you place, return the first person you placed home, unless it is on the __space:meeting-place|Meeting Place__ action space.

D095_SiteManager.name: Site Manager
D095_SiteManager.description: When you play this card, immediately build a major improvement. When paying its cost, you can replace up to 1 building resource of each type with 1 <FOOD> each.

D098_Transactor.name: Transactor
D098_Transactor.description: Immediately before the final harvest at the end of round 14, you can take all the building resources that are left on the entire game board.

E103_Wolf.name: Wolf
E103_Wolf.description: Pile (from bottom to top) 1 <CLAY>, 1 <WOOD>, and 1 <GRAIN> on this card. Each time you get a good matching the top item, you can move that item to your supply and get 1 <PIG>.

E109_BraidMaker.name: Braid Maker
E109_BraidMaker.description: Each harvest, you can use this card to exchange 1 <REED> for 2 <FOOD>. You can build the  __Basketmaker\\

E112_GrainThief.name: Grain Thief
E112_GrainThief.description: Each time you would harvest a grain field, you can leave the grain on the field and take 1 <GRAIN> from the general supply instead.

E123_ResourceHoarder.name: Resource Hoarder
E123_ResourceHoarder.description: Pile resources as depicted on this card. You can use the top item(s) when building a room, playing/building an improvement, or renovating. (From bottom to top: <STONE>, <CLAY>, <STONE>, <REED>, <WOOD>, <CLAY>)

E124_MayorCandidate.name: Mayor Candidate
E124_MayorCandidate.description: You immediately get 2 <WOOD> and 2 <STONE>. During scoring, you get 1 negative point for each <WOOD> and each <STONE> in your supply. You can no longer discard <WOOD> or <STONE>.

E130_Overachiever.name: Overachiever
E130_Overachiever.description: Each time you use a __space:wish-children,urgent-wish-children,modest-wish-children-56|Wish for Children__ action space, you can play 1 additional improvement by paying its cost minus 1 resource of your choice.

E133_ChampionBreeder.name: Champion Breeder
E133_ChampionBreeder.description: Each time you place 2 or 3+ newborn animals on your farm during the breeding phase of the harvest, you get 1 or 2 bonus <SCORE>, respectively.

E134_Omnifarmer.name: Omnifarmer
E134_Omnifarmer.description: Each harvest, you can place 1 harvested crop or 1 newborn animal on this card, irretrievably. Once this game, if there are 2/3/4/5 different goods on this, you get 3/5/7/9 bonus <SCORE>.

E148_Lazybones.name: Lazybones
E148_Lazybones.description: Place (up to) 1 <STABLE> each on __space:grain-seeds|Grain Seeds__, __space:farmland|Farmland__, __space:day-laborer|Day Laborer__, and __space:farm-expansion|Farm Expansion__. Build the <STABLE> at no cost when another player uses that action space.

E151_DeliveryNurse.name: Delivery Nurse
E151_DeliveryNurse.description: Once this game, if you have all types of animals, you can use any __space:wish-children,urgent-wish-children,modest-wish-children-56|Wish for Children__ action space even without room.

E153_StoneSculptor.name: Stone Sculptor
E153_StoneSculptor.description: Each harvest, you can use this card to exchange exactly 1 <STONE> for 1 bonus <SCORE> and 1 <FOOD>.

E155_Visionary.name: Visionary
E155_Visionary.description: If you play this card in round 4 or before, you get 1 <STONE>, 1 <VEGETABLE>, and 2 <PIG>. You cannot grow your family until round 11, unless all other players already have.

E159_OldMiser.name: Old Miser
E159_OldMiser.description: In the feeding phase of each harvest, each of your people requires 1 less <FOOD>. During scoring, your people are worth 2 points each instead of 3.

E161_ElderBaker.name: Elder Baker
E161_ElderBaker.description: This card is an action space for you only. When you use it, you get 3 <GRAIN>. You can build the __Stone Oven__ major improvement even when taking a __Minor Improvement__ action.

E162_Entrepreneur.name: Entrepreneur
E162_Entrepreneur.description: At the start of each round, you can move 1 <FOOD> to this card or discard 1 <FOOD> from it. If you do either, you get 1 building resource of a type you currently do not have.

E166_Roastmaster.name: Roastmaster
E166_Roastmaster.description: Each time you use the __space:traveling-players,traveling-players-56|Traveling Players__ or __space:fishing|Fishing__ accumulation spaces, you can move exactly 1 <FOOD> from that space to the other to get 1 <CATTLE>.

E167_DairyCrier.name: Dairy Crier
E167_DairyCrier.description: When you play this card, each player (including you) can choose to get 2 <SHEEP> or 2 <FOOD>; you also get 1 <CATTLE>.

E085_MasterTanner.name: Master Tanner
E085_MasterTanner.description: For each <PIG> or <CATTLE> you turn into <FOOD>, you can place 1 of that <FOOD> on this card. While its <FOOD> equals your number of rooms, this card provides room for 1 person.

E086_PenBuilder.name: Pen Builder
E086_PenBuilder.description: At any time, you can discard 1 <WOOD> from your supply. This card can hold two animals of any type for each <WOOD> discarded this way.

E090_DungCollector.name: Dung Collector
E090_DungCollector.description: Each time you get 2 or more newborn animals, you can pay 1 <FOOD> to plow 1 field.

E091_PlowBuilder.name: Plow Builder
E091_PlowBuilder.description: You can build the Joinery when taking a __Minor Improvement__ action. If you use the Joinery (or an upgrade thereof) during the harvest, you can pay 1 <FOOD> to plow 1 field.

E092_FieldDoctor.name: Field Doctor
E092_FieldDoctor.description: Once this game, if you live in a house with exactly 2 rooms surrounded by 4 field tiles, you can use any __space:wish-children,urgent-wish-children,modest-wish-children-56|Wish for Children__ action space even without room.

E093_Motivator.name: Motivator
E093_Motivator.description: On your first turn each round, if you have no unused farmyard spaces, you can place a person from your supply.

E094_Prophet.name: Prophet
E094_Prophet.description: When you play this card, immediately take a __Renovation__ action. Afterward, you can take a __Build Fences__ action. (Both actions require their usual cost.)

A095_Angler.description: Each time after you use the __space:fishing|Fishing__ Accumulation space while there are at most 2 <FOOD> on that space, you get a __Major or Minor Improvement__ action.

A113_HeresyTeacher.description: Each time you use a __space:lessons,lessons-3,lessons-4,lessons-56-2f,lessons-56-variable|Lessons__ action space, you get 1 <VEGETABLE> in each of your <FIELD> with at least 3 <GRAIN> and no <VEGETABLE>. Place the <VEGETABLE> below the <GRAIN>.

A114_SeasonalWorker.description: Each time you use the __space:day-laborer|Day Laborer__ action space, you get 1 additional <GRAIN>. From round 6 on, you can choose to get 1 <VEGETABLE> instead.

A121_ClayPuncher.description: When you play this card and each time after you use a __space:lessons,lessons-3,lessons-4,lessons-56-2f,lessons-56-variable|Lessons__ action space or the __space:clay-pit|Clay Pit__ accumulation space, you get 1 <CLAY>.

A122_PanBaker.description: Each time you use the __space:grain-utilization|Grain Utilization__ action space, you also get 2 <CLAY> and 1 <WOOD>.

A128_RiparianBuilder.description: Each time another player uses the __space:reed-bank|Reed Bank__ accumulation space, you can build a room: if you build a <CLAY>/stone room, you get a discount of 1 <CLAY>/2 <STONE>.

A129_Swagman.description: Immediately after each time you use the __space:farm-expansion|Farm Expansion__ or __space:grain-seeds|Grain Seeds__ action space, you can use the respective other space with the same person (even if it is occupied).

A130_MummysBoy.description: Once per round, when placing a person after your first two, you can place it on the action space with your 2nd person and use that space again, unless it is on the __space:meeting-place|Meeting Place__ action space.

A138_Harpooner.description: Each time you use the __space:fishing|Fishing__ space you can also pay 1 <WOOD> to get 1 <FOOD> for each person you have, and 1 <REED>

A139_HollowWarden.description: When you play this card, you immediately get a __Major Improvement__ action to build a Fireplace. Each time you use the __space:hollow,hollow-4,hollow-56|Hollow__ accumulation space, you also get 1 <FOOD>.

A140_ShovelBearer.description: Each time you use the __space:clay-pit|Clay Pit__ or __space:hollow,hollow-4,hollow-56|Hollow__ accumulation space, you also get a number of <FOOD> equal to the amount of <CLAY> on the respective other accumulation space.

A141_TurnipFarmer.description: At the start of the returning home phase of each round, if both the __space:day-laborer|Day Laborer__ and __space:grain-seeds|Grain Seeds__ action spaces are occupied, you get 1 <VEGETABLE>.

A142_Cordmaker.description: Each time any player (including you) takes at least 2 <REED> from the __space:reed-bank|Reed Bank__ accumulation space, you can choose to take 1 <GRAIN> or buy 1 <VEGETABLE> for 2 <FOOD>.

A147_AnimalDealer.description: Each time you use the __space:sheep-market|Sheep Market__, __space:pig-market|Pig Market__, or __space:cattle-market|Cattle Market__ accumulation space, you can buy 1 additional animal of the respective type for 1 <FOOD>.

A149_HouseArtist.description: Each time you use the __space:traveling-players,traveling-players-56|Traveling Players__ accumulation space, you also get a __Build Rooms__ action. Each room you build during the action costs you 1 <REED> less.

A150_Stagehand.description: Each time another player uses the __space:traveling-players,traveling-players-56|Traveling Players__ accumulation space, you can take your choice of a __Build Fences__, __Build Stables__, or __Build Rooms__ action.

A152_NightSchoolStudent.description: Each returning home phase in which no player returns a person from a __space:lessons,lessons-3,lessons-4,lessons-56-2f,lessons-56-variable|Lessons__ action space, you can play an occupation for an occupation cost of 1 <FOOD>.

A155_Conjurer.description: Each time you use the __space:traveling-players,traveling-players-56|Traveling Players__ accumulation space, you get an additional 1 <WOOD> and 1 <GRAIN>.

A157_Bohemian.description: At the start of each returning home phase, if at least one __space:lessons,lessons-3,lessons-4,lessons-56-2f,lessons-56-variable|Lessons__ action space is unoccupied, you get 1 <FOOD>.

A158_CulinaryArtist.description: Each time another player uses the __space:traveling-players,traveling-players-56|Traveling Players__ accumulation space, you can exchange your choice of 1 <GRAIN>/<SHEEP>/<VEGETABLE> for 4/5/7 <FOOD>.

A159_JoineroftheSea.description: Each time another player uses the __space:fishing|Fishing__/__space:reed-bank|Reed Bank__ accumulation space, you can give them 1 <WOOD> to get 2 <FOOD>/3 <FOOD> from the general supply.

A160_Lutenist.description: Each time another player uses the __space:traveling-players,traveling-players-56|Traveling Players__ accumulation space, you get 1 <FOOD> and 1 <WOOD>. Immediately after, you can buy exactly 1 <VEGETABLE> for 2 <FOOD>.

A163_BuildingExpert.description: Each time you use the __space:resource-market,resource-market-4,resource-market-56,moor-resource-market-12|Resource Market__ action space with the 1st/2nd/3rd/4th/5th person you place, you also get 1 <WOOD>/<CLAY>/<REED>/<STONE>/<STONE>.

A168_AnimalTeacher.description: Immediately after each time you use a __space:lessons,lessons-3,lessons-4,lessons-56-2f,lessons-56-variable|Lessons__ action space, you can also buy 1 <SHEEP>/<PIG>/<CATTLE> for 0/1/2 <FOOD>.

A172_BoatPainter.description: At the end of each work phase, if both the __space:fishing|Fishing__ and __space:traveling-players,traveling-players-56|Traveling Players__ accumulation spaces are occupied, you get your choice of 1 <GRAIN> or 2 <FOOD>.

A179_MountainShepherd.description: Each time you use either __space:western-quarry,eastern-quarry|Quarry__ accumulation space, you immediately get an additional 1 <SHEEP> from the general supply.

A180_AnimalBrander.description: Each time you use the __space:animal-market-56|Animal Market__ action space, you can pay 1 <FOOD> to use the same option twice (instead of once).

B087_Cottager.description: Each time you use the __space:day-laborer|Day Laborer__ action space, you can also either build exactly 1 room or renovate your house. Either way, you have to pay the cost.

B090_CooperativePlower.description: Each time you use the __space:farmland|Farmland__ action space while the __space:grain-seeds|Grain Seeds__ action space is occupied, you can plow 1 additional <FIELD>.

B091_AssistantTiller.description: Each time you use the __space:day-laborer|Day Laborer__ action space, you can also plow 1 <FIELD>.

B092_LittleStickKnitter.description: From Round 5 on, each time you use the __space:sheep-market|Sheep Market__ accumulation space, you can also take a __Family Growth with Room Only__ action.

B094_StockProtector.description: Each time before you use the __space:fencing|Fencing__ action space, you get 2 <WOOD>. Immediately after that __space:fencing|Fencing__ action, you can place another person.

B116_Shoreforester.description: When you play this card and each time 1 <REED> is placed on an empty __space:reed-bank|Reed Bank__ accumulation space in the preparation phase, you get 1 <WOOD>.

B121_Geologist.description: Each time you use the __space:forest|Forest__ or __space:reed-bank|Reed Bank__ accumulation space, you also get 1 <CLAY>. In games with 3 or more players, this also applies to the __space:clay-pit|Clay Pit__.

B128_Plumber.description: Each time after you use the __space:major-improvement|Major Improvement__ action space, you can take a __Renovation__ action, paying 2 <CLAY> or 2 <STONE> less for the renovation.

B130_FullPeasant.description: Each time after you use the __space:grain-utilization|Grain Utilization__ or __space:fencing|Fencing__ action space while the other is unoccupied, you can pay 1 <FOOD> to use the other space with the same person.

B142_Greengrocer.description: Each time you use the __space:grain-seeds|Grain Seeds__ action space, you also get 1 <VEGETABLE>.

B143_ClayWarden.description: Each time another player uses the __space:hollow,hollow-4,hollow-56|Hollow__ accumulation space, you get 1 <CLAY>. In a 3-/4-player game, you also get 1 additional <CLAY>/<FOOD>.

B144_Collier.description: Each time after you use the __space:clay-pit|Clay Pit__ or __space:hollow,hollow-4,hollow-56|Hollow__ accumulation space, you get 1 <WOOD>. On __space:clay-pit|Clay Pit__ you also get 1 additional <REED>.

B150_LargeScaleFarmer.description: Each time after you use the __space:farm-expansion|Farm Expansion__ or __space:major-improvement|Major Improvement__ action space while the other is unoccupied, you can pay 1 <FOOD> to use that other space with the same person.

B152_JuniorArtist.description: Each time after you use the __space:day-laborer|Day Laborer__ action space, you can pay 1 <FOOD> to use an unoccupied __space:traveling-players,traveling-players-56|Traveling Players__ or __space:lessons,lessons-3,lessons-4,lessons-56-2f,lessons-56-variable|Lessons__ action space with the same person.

B155_ArtTeacher.description: When you play this card, you immediately get 1 <WOOD> and 1 <REED>. Each time you pay an occupation cost, you can use <FOOD> from the __space:traveling-players,traveling-players-56|Traveling Players__ accumulation space.

B156_StorehouseKeeper.description: Each time you use the __space:resource-market,resource-market-4,resource-market-56,moor-resource-market-12|Resource Market__ action space, you also get your choice of 1 <CLAY> or 1 <GRAIN>.

B158_DistrictManager.description: At the end of each work phase, if you used both the __space:forest|Forest__ and __space:grove,grove-56|Grove__ accumulation spaces, you get 5 <FOOD>.

B160_PubOwner.description: When you play this card and at the end of each work phase in which the __space:forest|Forest__, __space:clay-pit|Clay Pit__, and __space:reed-bank|Reed Bank__ accumulation spaces are all occupied, you get 1 <GRAIN>.

B166_CattleFeeder.description: Each time you use the __space:grain-seeds|Grain Seeds__ action space, you can also buy 1 <CATTLE> for 1 <FOOD>.

B170_CorralBuilder.description: When the __space:pig-market|Pig Market__ and __space:cattle-market|Cattle Market__ action space cards are each revealed (and placed on the round space), you can immediately <FENCE> exactly 1 farmyard space without playing <WOOD>.

B171_GreenhouseBuilder.description: This is an action space for you only. It provides a choice of __space:fencing|Fencing__, __space:house-redevelopment|House Redevelopment__, or __space:vegetable-seeds|Vegetable Seeds__ if the corresponding action space is already in play.

B174_RiverbankGardener.description: Each time you use the __space:riverbank-forest-56|Riverbank Forest__ accumulation space, you also get 1 <VEGETABLE>.

B176_VillageIdiot.description: The Village Idiot is your lone occupation. Each time another player uses the __space:meeting-place|Meeting Place__ action space, you get 1 <WOOD> and 1 <FOOD>.

B178_TagAlong.description: Immediately after each time another player uses the __space:resource-market,resource-market-4,resource-market-56,moor-resource-market-12|Resource Market__ action space, you can also place a person there to take the action as well.

C090_FieldWatchman.description: Each time you use the __space:grain-seeds|Grain Seeds__ action space, you can also plow 1 <FIELD>.

C091_PlowHero.description: Each time you use the __space:farmland|Farmland__ or __space:cultivation|Cultivation__ action space with the first person you place in a round, you can plow 1 additional <FIELD> for 1 <FOOD>.

C097_SeedResearcher.description: Each time any people return from both the __space:grain-seeds|Grain Seeds__ and __space:vegetable-seeds|Vegetable Seeds__ action spaces, you get 2 <FOOD> and you can play 1 occupation, without paying an occupation cost.

C112_Thresher.description: Immediately before each time you use the __space:grain-utilization|Grain Utilization__, __space:farmland|Farmland__, or __space:cultivation|Cultivation__ action space, you can buy 1 <GRAIN> for 1 <FOOD>.

C121_ClayKneader.description: When you play this card, you immediately get 1 <WOOD> and 2 <CLAY>. Each time after you use __space:grain-seeds|Grain Seeds__ or __space:vegetable-seeds|Vegetable Seeds__ action space, you get 1 <CLAY>.

C126_Excavator.description: Each time after you use the __space:day-laborer|Day Laborer__ action space, you get 1 additional <WOOD> and <CLAY>, and you can buy 1 <STONE> for 1 <FOOD>.

C129_SecondSpouse.description: You can use the __space:urgent-wish-children|Urgent Wish for Children__ action space (from round 12-13) even if it is occupied by the first person another player placed.

C130_OutskirtsDirector.description: Each time you use the __space:grove,grove-56|Grove__ or __space:hollow,hollow-4,hollow-56|Hollow__ accumulation space, you can place 2 <REED> from the general supply on the other space. If you do, you can immediately place another person.

C131_PrivateTeacher.description: Each time you use the __space:grain-seeds|Grain Seeds__ action space when any __space:lessons,lessons-3,lessons-4,lessons-56-2f,lessons-56-variable|Lessons__ action space is occupied, you can also play an occupation for an occupation cost of 1 <FOOD>.

C141_SheepProvider.description: Each time any player (including you) uses the __space:sheep-market|Sheep Market__ accumulation space, you get 1 <GRAIN>.

C145_ForestReviewer.description: Each time after any player (including you) uses the unoccupied __space:grove,grove-56|Grove__ or __space:forest|Forest__ accumulation space while the other of the two is occupied, you get 1 <REED>.

C147_Cowherd.description: Each time you use the __space:cattle-market|Cattle Market__ accumulation space, you get 1 additional <CATTLE>.

C150_ParrotBreeder.description: On your turn, if you pay 1 <GRAIN> to the general supply, you can use the same action space (unless it is the __space:meeting-place|Meeting Place__ action space) that the player to your right has just used on their turn (not retroactive).

C151_SowingDirector.description: Each time after another player uses the __space:grain-utilization|Grain Utilization__ action space, you get a __Sow__ action.

C152_Puppeteer.description: Each time another player uses the __space:traveling-players,traveling-players-56|Traveling Players__ accumulation space, you can pay them 1 <FOOD> to immediately play an occupation without paying an occupation cost.

C159_FishermansFriend.description: At the start of each round, if there is more <FOOD> on the __space:traveling-players,traveling-players-56|Traveling Players__ than on the __space:fishing|Fishing__ accumulation space, you get the difference from the general supply.

C164_GermanHeathKeeper.description: Each time any player (including you) uses the __space:pig-market|Pig Market__ accumulation space, you get 1 <SHEEP> from the general supply.

C167_CattleBuyer.description: Each time another player uses the __space:fencing|Fencing__ action space, you can buy exactly 1 <SHEEP>/<PIG>/<CATTLE> from the general supply for 1/2/2 <FOOD>.

C168_AnimalCatcher.description: Each time you use the __space:day-laborer|Day Laborer__ action space, instead of 2 <FOOD>, you can get 3 different animals from the general supply. If you do, you must pay 1 <FOOD> each harvest left to play.

C173_TopOuter.description: Each time the __space:house-building-56|House Building__ action space on the game board extension is used, you get all of the <FOOD> from the __space:traveling-players,traveling-players-56|Traveling Players__ accumulation space.

C175_VillageTeacher.description: Immediately after each time you use a __space:lessons,lessons-3,lessons-4,lessons-56-2f,lessons-56-variable|Lessons__ action space, if this is the 1st/2nd/3rd occupied __space:lessons,lessons-3,lessons-4,lessons-56-2f,lessons-56-variable|Lessons__ action space that round, you get 1 <FOOD>/<GRAIN>/<VEGETABLE>.

C176_Cleanacre.description: Each time you use the __space:farmland|Farmland__, __space:cultivation|Cultivation__, or __space:farm-supplies-6|Farm Supplies__ action (the latter only being available with 6 players), you also get 2 <CLAY>.

D090_PlowMaker.description: Each time you use the __space:farmland|Farmland__ or __space:cultivation|Cultivation__ action space, you can pay 1 <FOOD> to plow 1 additional <FIELD>.

D109_SowingMaster.description: When you play this card, you immediately get 1 <WOOD>. Each time after you use the __space:grain-utilization|Grain Utilization__ or __space:cultivation|Cultivation__ action space, you get 2 <FOOD>.

D110_FishFarmer.description: Each time there is 1/2/3+ <FOOD> on the __space:fishing|Fishing__ accumulation space, you get an additional 2 <FOOD> on the __space:reed-bank|Reed Bank__/ __space:clay-pit|Clay Pit__/ __space:forest|Forest__ accumulation spaces.

D112_YoungFarmer.description: Each time you use the __space:major-improvement|Major Improvement__ action space, you also get 1 <GRAIN> and, afterward, you can take a __Sow__ action.

D130_RecreationalCarpenter.description: At the end of each work phase in which you did not use the __space:meeting-place|Meeting Place__ action space, you can take a __Build Rooms__ action without placing a person.

D139_Chairman.description: Each time another player uses the __space:meeting-place|Meeting Place__ action space, both they and you get 1 <FOOD> (before taking the actions). If you use it, you get 1 <FOOD>.

D141_SeedSeller.description: When you play this card, you immediately get 1 <GRAIN>. Each time you use the __space:grain-seeds|Grain Seeds__ action space, you get 1 additional <GRAIN>.

D142_PotatoPlanter.description: At the end of each work phase in which you occupy the __space:clay-pit|Clay Pit__ or __space:reed-bank|Reed Bank__ accumulation space while the respective other is unoccupied, you get 1 <VEGETABLE>.

D144_WaterWorker.description: Each time after you use any of the __space:fishing|Fishing__, __space:reed-bank|Reed Bank__, __space:day-laborer|Day Laborer__ spaces or the action space of round 4, you get 1 additional <REED>.

D147_TrapBuilder.description: Each time you use the __space:day-laborer|Day Laborer__ action space, place 1 <FOOD>, 1 <FOOD>, and 1 <PIG> on the next 3 round spaces, respectively. At the start of these rounds, you get the good.

D149_CasualWorker.description: Each time another player uses a __space:western-quarry,eastern-quarry|Quarry__ accumulation space, you can choose to get 1 <FOOD> or build a <STABLE> without paying <WOOD>.

D156_RetailDealer.description: Place 3 <GRAIN> and 3 <FOOD> on this card. Each time you use the __space:resource-market,resource-market-4,resource-market-56,moor-resource-market-12|Resource Market__ action space, you also get 1 <GRAIN> and 1 <FOOD> from this card.

D171_SeniorTeacher.description: Each time another player pays <FOOD> on a __space:lessons,lessons-3,lessons-4,lessons-56-2f,lessons-56-variable|Lessons__ action space, you get exactly 1 of that <FOOD>.

D174_LoessGardener.description: Each time you use the __space:clay-pit|Clay Pit__ accumulation space, you can also buy 1 <VEGETABLE> for 1 <FOOD>.

D178_SubstituteTeacher.description: Each time all three __space:lessons,lessons-3,lessons-4,lessons-56-2f,lessons-56-variable|Lessons__ action spaces are occupied, you can use this card with a person to get your choice of 1 building resource or 1 crop of each type.

E095_Miller.description: You can immediately build a <BAKE>-improvement by paying its cost. Each time another player uses the __space:grain-seeds|Grain Seeds__ action space, you can take a __Bake Bread__ action.

E115_SeedServant.description: Each time after you use the __space:grain-seeds|Grain Seeds__ action space, you can take a __Bake Bread__ action. Each time after you use the __space:vegetable-seeds|Vegetable Seeds__ action space, you can take a __Sow__ action.

E121_HillCultivator.description: Each time you use the __space:grain-seeds|Grain Seeds__ or __space:vegetable-seeds|Vegetable Seeds__ action space, you also get 2 or 3 <CLAY>, respectively.

E129_Imitator.description: If you have a person on the __space:day-laborer|Day Laborer__ action space, you can use non-accumulating round 1-9 action spaces even if they are occupied.

E131_MarketMaster.description: Immediately after each time you place your last person in a round on the __space:traveling-players,traveling-players-56|Traveling Players__ accumulation space, you can play 1 occupation for an occupation cost of 1 <FOOD>.

E137_FlaxFarmer.description: Each time you use the __space:reed-bank|Reed Bank__ accumulation space, you also get 1 <GRAIN>. Each time you use the __space:grain-seeds|Grain Seeds__ action space, you also get 1 <REED>.

E141_VegetableVendor.description: Each time you use the __space:major-improvement|Major Improvement__ or __space:vegetable-seeds|Vegetable Seeds__ action space, you also get 1 <VEGETABLE> or a __Major or Minor Improvement__ action, respectively.

E152_BargainHunter.description: At the start of each round, you can place 1 <FOOD> from your supply on the __space:traveling-players,traveling-players-56|Traveling Players__ accumulation space to play a minor improvement by paying its cost.

E160_KelpGatherer.description: Each time another player uses the __space:fishing|Fishing__ accumulation space, they get 1 additional <FOOD> and you get 1 <VEGETABLE>.

OLD_BI14_LinenWeaver.name: 亚麻城织布工
OLD_BI14_LinenWeaver.description: 每回合开始时，将此卡传给下家，该回合视作他已打出的职业卡。拥有此卡的玩家打出发展卡时可以少花费1木。如果你是最先打出此卡的玩家，则改为木头、砖头、芦苇、石头均少花费1个。

OLD_BI15_Vampire.name: 吸血鬼
OLD_BI15_Vampire.description: 此卡只能在你的上家刚使用完积累行动格，接着轮到你的轮次时打出。你立即执行相同的行动并从游戏供应区获得该格被使用前的资源。

OLD_BI16_InstituteFounder.name: 研究所创始人
OLD_BI16_InstituteFounder.description: 打出此卡时，你可以支付1份食物购买1份小麦。每次丰收时节的喂养阶段，你的第4、5位家庭成员每位只需要吃1食物。

OLD_BI17_WhiteBrazilian.name: 足球射手
OLD_BI17_WhiteBrazilian.description: 你只能在你农场上方的一排5格都未被使用时打出此卡。在这排最左边1格和最右边1格分别放1个马厩和1只猪。你有3次机会用手指弹那只野猪。如果弹进了马厩那格(局部进入即可)，你保留马厩和野猪。否则只留下马厩。

OLD_BI18_AppleMan.name: 苹果农夫
OLD_BI18_AppleMan.description: 每个回家阶段，你可以支付1份蔬菜来执行一次“犁田”、“围栅栏”或“建造马厩”行动，而不需要派遣家庭成员。

OLD_BI19_Deaconess.name: 女执事
OLD_BI19_Deaconess.description: 如果你只有两名家庭成员，在第1/2/3/4/5/6个丰收时节的喂养阶段，你获得1/2/3/4/5/6份食物。

OLD_BI20_Survivalist.name: 生存主义者
OLD_BI20_Survivalist.description: 每个丰收时节的喂养阶段，你可以使用此卡将至多4个相异的建筑资源各转换成2食物，若如此做，你必须将1食物放到钓鱼积累行动格上。如果你使用钓鱼积累行动格时打出此卡，不可以发动此效果。

OLD_BI21_ChiefEditor.name: 总编
OLD_BI21_ChiefEditor.description: 下一次你使用钓鱼积累行动格时，额外获得2分。之后, 你每次使用钓鱼积累行动格时，额外获得1分。如果你使用钓鱼积累行动格时打出此卡，不可以立即发动此效果。

OLD_BI22_ProtestSinger.name: 抗争歌手
OLD_BI22_ProtestSinger.description: 你的每个农场空格能容纳1只动物，该农场空格视作未使用。这些动物不能以任何方式参与繁殖，可以转换为食物，可以移入你农场中其他位置。

OLD_BI23_SystemsTheorist.name: 系统理论家
OLD_BI23_SystemsTheorist.description: 每当你建造至少1个马厩时，额外获得1份食物。（同时建造多个马厩只能获得1份食物）游戏结束时, 若你有2/3/4个马厩两两相邻（包括对角相邻）,额外获得1/2/3分。

OLD_BI24_MemberofaCooperative.name: 合作社成员
OLD_BI24_MemberofaCooperative.description: 每当其他玩家执行“生娃”行动时，你从游戏供应区拿取1食物放在此卡上。限1次：在3/4/5位玩家的游戏中，你可以支付此卡上的3/4/5份食物将生儿育女行动格当成求子心切行动格使用。如果其他玩家执行“生娃”行动时，你打出此卡，可立即发动此效果。

OLD_C01_Governor.name: 统治者
OLD_C01_Governor.description: 从牌库中抽取4张职业卡，并从中选择其中2张加入手牌。如果满足条件，你可以立即免费打出其中1张。

OLD_C02_WeekendWorker.name: 周末工作者
OLD_C02_WeekendWorker.description: 每当你执行“翻修”行动后，你可以扩建1间房屋，费用为1芦苇+1个翻修前房屋等级对应的建筑资源+2个翻修后房屋等级对应的建筑资源。

OLD_C03_JackOfAllTrades.name: 万能博士
OLD_C03_JackOfAllTrades.description: 打出此卡后，你弃掉你的所有已打出的职业卡。每个回合开始时，你可以选择一张其他玩家打出的职业卡并支付给他1食物，该回合结束前你拥有该职业卡的效果。(不包含"打出此卡"和"游戏结束"的效果)之后如果你打出新的职业卡，你必须弃掉此卡。

OLD_C04_TeacherOfNations.name: 国家教师
OLD_C04_TeacherOfNations.description: 所有玩家打出每张职业卡的技能培训费都可以少花费1食物。每当其他玩家如此做，你获得1食物。职业卡额外的花费不会减少。比如：K291情圣。

OLD_C05_Hero.name: 英雄
OLD_C05_Hero.description: 打出此卡时，你立即获得3食物。限1次：你可以弃掉1只猪无需放置家庭成员执行1次“生娃(需要空房间)”行动。新生儿本回合不能行动。

OLD_C06_FortuneTeller.name: 预言家
OLD_C06_FortuneTeller.description: 打出此卡时，你获得1个石头。你可以立即观看之后3个未翻开的回合行动卡，并以任意顺序放回而无需按季节要求。你可以随时观看下一张未翻开的回合行动卡。

OLD_C07_Bureaucrat.name: 官僚
OLD_C07_Bureaucrat.description: 打出此卡时，从个人供应区放置3份食物到此卡上。（这3食物可以随时移入个人供应区）每回合限1次：你可以支付此卡上的1份食物来使用1个仅被一位家庭成员占用的行动格。（即使此家庭成员是属于你自己）新生儿是否是1位家庭成员

OLD_C08_Bagpiper.name: 风笛手
OLD_C08_Bagpiper.description: 打出此卡时，你获得2份食物。打出此卡的家庭成员立刻回家并视为未派遣，你可以在之后的轮次中继续派遣他。（如果该职业卡通过行动格打出，则该行动格视为未占据）

OLD_C09_OnlyChild.name: 独生子女
OLD_C09_OnlyChild.description: 打出此卡时，若距离游戏结束还有3/6/9个完整回合，则你立即获得1/2/3根木头。游戏结束时，如果你恰好有3名家庭成员，则你获得3分。

OLD_C10_Informer.name: 告密者
OLD_C10_Informer.description: 打出此卡时，翻面1张你已打出的职业卡，获得5食物/1头牛。该职业卡失效但算作1张职业卡。

OLD_C11_Robber.name: 强盗
OLD_C11_Robber.description: 每回合限1次：在其他玩家还有家庭成员未派遣时，你可以跳过你的1次家庭成员派遣获得1木头/1食物。你仍可在后续的轮次中派遣这个家庭成员。

OLD_C12_Nicholas.name: 大主教
